izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.datasimswitche.name: Data SIM Switcher
izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.datasimswitche.summary: Root Quick Settings tile to instantly switch your active mobile data SIM.
izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.datasimswitche.description:
A lightweight, purely root-based Quick Settings tile to switch the default mobile data SIM on dual-SIM Android devices.
 Unlike other implementations that rely on Shizuku and persistent background daemons, Data SIM Switcher uses topjohnwu's libsu to spawn a Root IPC service for the exact millisecond the tile is tapped. It is incredibly fast, survives reboots reliably, and uses zero background battery.
 Features:
 Zero Daemons: Uses on-demand Magisk/KernelSU root access.
 No Permissions Required: Bypasses Android's READ_PHONE_STATE restrictions entirely by doing all calculation logic natively in the root daemon.
 Dynamic Tile Subtitle: Displays the name of the currently active data SIM (Requires Android 10+).
 Smart Toggling: Automatically scans active slots, calculates the current default data SIM, cycles to the next one, and securely enables the cellular radio on the new SIM.
 Requires Root.

izzyondroid:com.kelani.sbdtracker.name: Kelani SBD Tracker
izzyondroid:com.kelani.sbdtracker.summary: Offline-first powerlifting tracker for Squat, Bench and Deadlift.
izzyondroid:com.kelani.sbdtracker.description:
Kelani SBD Tracker is a calm, offline-first powerlifting tracker for structured Squat, Bench Press and Deadlift training.
 It helps you plan, track and complete SBD workouts without accounts, ads, subscriptions, automatic analytics, telemetry or Kelani cloud sync. Your saved app data stays on your device unless you choose to export or share it. Optional Android calendar integration writes brief workout events to a calendar you select; its provider may sync them.
 Smart Training:
 Smart Training follows a level-specific ideal route with an optional SBD Meet Day and recovery afterwards. Beginner routes alternate training and recovery over a default 26-day cycle; other levels use 28 days. Feedback can adjust the calendar. The route remains visible in advance, while your best estimated 1RM determines the prescribed weights.
 Plans heavy, medium and light Squat, Bench Press and Deadlift work for your current level
 Prescribes warm-ups, top work, back-off work and accessories
 Moves the meet closer after Too easy and adds recovery after Too hard or failed work
 Choose a lighter Smart workout before starting and see recovery explanations when relevant
 Shows past, current and provisional future workouts across training cycles
 All Smart calculations run locally on your device
 Features:
 Choose Powerlifting or Powerbuilding, optional meet days and equipment weight limits
 Structured Squat, Bench Press and Deadlift training cycles
 Workout tracking with warm-ups, main work, back-offs and optional accessories
 Automatic progression based on completed training
 Rest timer with audio signals
 Meet Planner for squat, bench press and deadlift attempt selection
 Meet prep checklist for competition-day preparation
 Bodyweight and body composition logging
 1RM, estimated 1RM and strength statistics
 Perceived effort tracking for sets and completed workouts
 Exercise alternatives for lower-stress training periods
 Local data export and import, with optional daily backup history and a verified safety copy before restoring
 Completed cycles include a results review, progress since the start and a chart of your best recorded 1RM total
 Optional sync of future workouts to a selected Android calendar after you grant calendar access and start the first sync
 Program and Calendar share the remaining current cycle and at least four weeks ahead, extending into later cycles when needed; future plans can change
 Optionally remove Kelani calendar events when workouts are completed in the app
 Workout calendar events include a reminder at the start time; reminders you later change or remove in your calendar are preserved
 Workout events you manually delete in your calendar stay deleted during later syncs
 English, Catalan and Dutch interface
 Privacy and independence:
 No account required
 No ads
 No automatic analytics or telemetry
 No tracking
 No subscription
 No paywall
 Core training works offline
 Optional Android calendar integration uses calendar read and write permission; your chosen calendar provider may sync its events
 Kelani is made for practical long-term strength progress, not social media engagement.

izzyondroid:com.strawing.fuckdevicepolic.name: FuckDevicePolicy
izzyondroid:com.strawing.fuckdevicepolic.summary: render user restriction policy (e.g work profile policies) nonfunctional
izzyondroid:com.strawing.fuckdevicepolic.description:
FuckDevicePolicy is an Xposed module that lets you render some user restriction policies (set by Device Admin App or Work Profile, e.g. Microsoft Intune) nonfunctional. Especially some device-wide policies, even it is in the Work Profile but affected the outside whole android environment (Your Personal Profile).
 For example, since Android 10, a new feature for Work Profile added: DISALLOW_INSTALL_UNKNOWN_SOURCES_GLOBALLY , value is "no_install_unknown_sources_globally"). This allows the Work Profile App (For example, Microsoft Intune, aka Company Portal) disable the permission of installing APKs from unknown source GLOBALLY , even its inside the Work Profile, then you also can not install APKs in your personal profile! Another example of device-wide restriction is ensure_verify_apps , which can make Google Play Protect always enable.
 If you are facing these problem, just use this Xposed module.
 Check UserManager to get all restriction policy values (See [Constant Value]). Put those you want to disable in this module's App, one line one policy value. Use dumpsys device_policy (run via adb shell or root) to check what restriction policies applied on your device (under [userRestrictions:] section).
 Only apply this module to [System Framework] (which is the default scope setting), no need to apply to any other apps, especially DO NOT apply to Microsoft Intune, otherwise your Xposed and ROOT will be detected.
 Due to LSPosed's New XSharedPreferences , if you are using LSPosed, please Activate this module and reboot firstly, before edit and save your custom policies!!! (In another word, when you click the save button, this module should be activated, if you are using LSPosed). Otherwise your custom policies will not be saved correctly for LSPosed.

izzyondroid:com.vishaltelangre.nerdcalci.name: NerdCalci
izzyondroid:com.vishaltelangre.nerdcalci.summary: Calculator for nerds with variables, syntax highlighting, and file sessions
izzyondroid:com.vishaltelangre.nerdcalci.description:
NerdCalci is a powerful calculator designed for nerds and power users who need more than basic arithmetic.
 Features:
 Offline - Works without internet
 Variable support - Define variables and reuse them in calculations
 Percentage calculations - Natural syntax like "20% of 50000" or "15% off 1000"
 Unit conversions - Natural syntax like "10 m in feet" or "100 kmph to mph"
 Calendar-aware date and time engine with timezone support
 Custom functions - Define your own functions with multi-statement support and scope isolation
 Dynamic variables - Quickly compute block sums ( total ) and averages ( avg )
 Syntax highlighting - Color-coded numbers, variables, operators, and comments
 Smart error diagnostics - See human-friendly explanation of math or syntax errors
 Auto-completion - Smart suggestions for variable names
 Comments - Document your calculations with # comments
 Multiple files - Organize calculations in separate files with auto-save
 Tags - Organize files with custom tags
 Pin files - Keep frequently used files at the top
 Search - Search your files easily by name or tag
 Duplicate files - Create a copy of a file with a new name
 Undo/Redo - Up to 30 steps per file
 Backups - Automatically or manually backup your files to app storage or a custom folder
 Restore from backups - Restore your files from backups
 Copy with results - Copy calculations with their results
 Export - Share your calculations as a PNG image or a multi-page PDF
 Dark/light theme - System, dark, or light mode support
 Line numbers - Easy reference and navigation
 Perfect for:
 Quick calculations with reusable values
 Budget planning and financial calculations
 Unit conversions and formulas
 Educational purposes and learning
 Any scenario where you need to document and reuse calculation values
 NerdCalci combines the simplicity of a calculator with the power of a text editor. As a capable alternative to text-based calculators like Numi, Calca, and Soulver, it is ideal for developers, students, accountants, and anyone who frequently works with numbers.

izzyondroid:dev.zwander.mastodonredirect.name: Mastodon Redirect
izzyondroid:dev.zwander.mastodonredirect.summary: Deep linking proxy for Mastodon, to launch your selected client automatically
izzyondroid:dev.zwander.mastodonredirect.description:
Mastodon Redirect is a simple app for automatically launching fediverse links in your preferred Mastodon client. Currently, most domains on instances.social are supported.
 Mastodon Redirect supports most active and alive instances, but excludes dead instances and instances that haven't had any activity recently. This is to keep the list as short as possible and avoid crashes.
 Mastodon Redirect currently supports the following clients:
 Elk (PWA: Stable or Canary) 
 Fedilab (F-DROID or Play Store) 
 Mastodon 
 Megalodon 
 Moshidon 
 Phanpy (PWA: Stable or Dev) 
 Subway Tooter 
 Tooot 
 Trunks (Native or Web) 
 Once you download the app, you can choose your client app and then enable all supported domains, so that when you tap a recognized link, it gets passed to Mastodon Redirect .

izzyondroid:eu.thedarken.wldonate.name: Wakelock Revamp - PowerManager
izzyondroid:eu.thedarken.wldonate.description:
Wake Lock gives you access to Android's Power- and WifiManager.
You can use it on any Android phone or tablet.
 Examples of what it can do for you:
 Force the PowerManager to keep the screen on
 Have the CPU still running in standby mode
 Ensure the Wifi connection keeps running at full performance

 WAKE_LOCK, to obviously be allowed to acquire wakelocks.

fdroid:com.cocode.battleship.name: Battleship
fdroid:com.cocode.battleship.summary: Offline naval combat against an AI opponent, with no ads and no account
fdroid:com.cocode.battleship.description:
Battleship is a local naval combat game for Android. It requires no network connection, no account and no tracking. Play against an AI opponent that uses a hunt/target algorithm with checkerboard parity.
The game is played on a 10x10 grid with a 5-ship fleet: Carrier, Battleship, Cruiser, Submarine and Destroyer. Ships are placed by tapping a cell; a separate button switches the ship between horizontal and vertical, and one tap deploys the whole fleet at random. Sinking an enemy ship unlocks a matching super weapon, such as area bombardment, cross-pattern saturation fire or a sonar sweep.
The app tracks career stats across games and app restarts, including 33 medals across four rarity tiers and 8 career ranks from Cadet to Fleet Admiral. All game audio is synthesized at runtime, so no audio files are bundled with the app.

With Insular, you can: 
 Isolate your Big Brother apps
 Clone and run multiple accounts simutaniuosly
 Freeze or archive apps and prevent any background behaviors
 Unfreeze apps on-demand with home screen shortcuts
 Re-freeze marked apps with one tap
 Hide apps
 Selectively enable (or disable) VPN for different group of apps
 Prohibit USB access to mitigate attacks with physical access
If your device is incompatible or not encrypted, you can skip this limitation manually. Please refer to the XDA post for details.
To uninstall and remove Insular completely, please first "Destroy Insular" in Settings - Setup - Click the recycle-bin icon besides Insular. If you have already uninstalled Insular app, please "Remove work profile" in your device "Settings - Accounts".
 PERMISSIONS 
 DEVICE-ADMIN: Device administrator privilege is required to create the Insular space (work profile), which serves as the fundamental functionality of Insular. It will be explicitly requested for your consent.
 PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS: Required to correctly recognize the running state of apps. It will be explicitly requested for your consent.
We will never collect any data and Insular have no Internet permission. Please read our privacy policy for more details.
 Differences from Island 
 all blobs (gms, crashlytics, etc) are removed to comply with F-droid's policy
 Internet access of this app is removed because we just don't need it
All features are preserved and will be synced upon Island's updates

fdroid:dev.xitee.sleeptimer.name: SleepTimer
fdroid:dev.xitee.sleeptimer.summary: Audio fade-out and screen lock at the end of a countdown. No ads, no internet.
fdroid:dev.xitee.sleeptimer.description:
A minimal, privacy-respecting sleep timer for Android. Starts a countdown that stops media playback, fades audio out, and optionally locks the screen when it ends — so you can fall asleep without your phone draining the battery or blaring podcasts at 3 AM.
No accounts, no ads, no trackers, no network access.
Features:
* Simple countdown timer with +/- step buttons and cancel directly from the notification (step is configurable, defaults to 5 minutes)
* Shows the exact wall-clock time at which the timer will end
* Stops audio and video playback across apps at the end of the timer
* Configurable fade-out duration before playback stops
* Optional screen lock when the timer ends — choose between Device Admin (standard Android lock, credential required to unlock) or Shizuku soft lock (simulates the power button, biometric unlock keeps working)
* Optional Wi-Fi and Bluetooth off when the timer ends (both via Shizuku, since modern Android blocks apps from toggling these directly)
* Six built-in themes (Midnight, Ocean, Ember, Light, Basic, AMOLED) with an optional drifting starfield behind the dial
* Haptic feedback for timer controls (can be disabled)
* Foreground service keeps the timer reliable even when the app is in the background
Privacy:
* No analytics, crash reporting, or telemetry
* No third-party SDKs (no Firebase, no Google Play Services, no ads)
* All settings are stored locally on your device
* No data leaves your device
The app does not request the INTERNET permission. It cannot connect to any network.
Open source under GPL-3.0-or-later: https://github.com/Xitee1/sleep-timer

fdroid:info.zverev.ilya.every_door.name: Every Door
fdroid:info.zverev.ilya.every_door.summary: Mobile OpenStreetMap editor for POI & micromapping
fdroid:info.zverev.ilya.every_door.description:
This editor does not make you think. Just go to a mall, and start Every Door. You'll see mapped shops around you: tap on the checkmark for any that are still there, and add shops that are not on the map. That's the entire process: you can keep your entire town up-to-date thanks to this simple editor.
There is also a micromapping mode for verifying and adding benches and street lamps. And an entrance mode for adding building attributes and entrances — which are merged automatically into building contours.
Every Door uses presets and other data from iD editor.

fdroid:io.github.picocrypt_ng.picocrypt_.name: Picocrypt-NG
fdroid:io.github.picocrypt_ng.picocrypt_.summary: Paranoid, offline file encryption with XChaCha20 and Argon2id.
fdroid:io.github.picocrypt_ng.picocrypt_.description:
Picocrypt-NG encrypts files locally — a community-maintained continuation of Picocrypt. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry, no network access (the app does not request the INTERNET permission).
XChaCha20 for encryption, with the key derived from your password by Argon2id. Every volume is authenticated, so tampering or corruption is detected on decryption.
Features:
- Encrypt a single file, multiple files, or a folder
- Optional keyfiles, with an option to require them in a fixed order
- Paranoid mode: extra cipher cascade and harder key derivation
- Reed-Solomon error correction to recover volumes from limited corruption
- Deniability mode: the encrypted volume appears as random data
- Optional compression
- Comments stored with the volume
- Optional verify-before-write integrity check
- Long operations continue in a foreground service when the app is backgrounded
Volumes are cross-platform with the desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux). A multi-file or compressed volume contains a single .zip inside; Android saves it without extracting.
Free software under GPLv3. The Android app is built from source: the native library is compiled from the Go sources in this repository, with no prebuilt binaries committed.

fdroid:xyz.iridiumion.plucklockex.description:
Lock your phone when snatched. An updated and improved derivative of PluckLock.
This polls the accelerometer in the background and will lock the phone if the

Zoho Scanner integrates with Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Expense, and more. Easily share scanned docs via email and other apps as well. flathub:app.eduroam.geteduroam.name: geteduroam
flathub:app.eduroam.geteduroam.summary: A geteduroam client for Linux. Geteduroam simplifies the process of connecting to eduroam
flathub:app.eduroam.geteduroam.description:
Geteduroam is a proposed extension of the NREN T&I services, aimed at increasing the update and use of eduroam by students and faculty members. The idea is to do away with the need for separate eduroam user accounts, and instead use national federated Id (through eduGAIN such as SURFconext, Swamid, FEIDE, HAKA, etc) to automatically generate eduroam login credentials in form of client certificates as needed. In addition, geteduroam will deliver apps for user devices that will automatically install and configure eduroam.
 Eduroam is seen as one of the most successful NREN services. eduroam service deployment is extensive, with nearly every campus in Europe having an eduroam Wi-Fi network. However, in terms of users who have eduroam installed correctly on their devices, the uptake is much less. This is believed to be the results of 1) users need a separate eduroam account, 2) users need to install and configure this account on their device, 3) the need to do so become apparent to users only when they are away from their home institution.
 At the time eduroam was developed, there was no simple way around this. Today, with the widespread adoption of federated Id and the global collaboration of such Id’s under eduGAIN, it is possible to develop what is essentially a more modern way on managing and deploying eduroam for users. This is the objective of the geteduroam project.

flathub:io.github.AllanChain.sane-break.description:
NOTE: Sane Break works best with X11 and KDE Wayland. It works on GNOME but less optimal. It
 also works on other Wayland compositors with wlr layer shell and idle notify protocols support.
 The Flatpak version does not support pausing breaks when specific programs are running.
 Sane Break is a cross-platform break reminder designed to help you take meaningful breaks without
 disrupting your workflow. It allows you to take ownership of when to stop and break, and aims to
 strike a balance between respecting your workflow and ensuring you take the breaks you need. Specifically,
 Sane Break uses a two-phase system:
 Phase 1: A small, unobtrusive reminder that encourages you to find a good stopping point.
 Phase 2: The reminder grows to full screen during the actual break.
 Transition to phase 2 happens when you stop working on your computer, or when you ignore the
 reminder and keep working for too long.

fedora-packages:scalapack/blacs-mpich.name: blacs-mpich
fedora-packages:scalapack/blacs-mpich.description: The BLACS (Basic Linear Algebra Communication Subprograms) project is an ongoing investigation whose purpose is to create a linear algebra oriented message passing interface that may be implemented efficiently and uniformly across a large range of distributed memory platforms. The length of time required to implement efficient distributed memory algorithms makes it impractical to rewrite programs for every new parallel machine. The BLACS exist in order to make linear algebra applications both easier to program and more portable. This package contains BLACS libraries compiled with mpich.

fedora-packages:blake3/blake3.name: blake3
fedora-packages:blake3/blake3.summary: Official C implementation of the BLAKE3 cryptographic hash function
fedora-packages:blake3/blake3.description: BLAKE3 is a cryptographic hash function that is: - Much faster than MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3, and BLAKE2. - Secure, unlike MD5 and SHA-1. And secure against length extension, unlike SHA-2. - Highly parallelizable across any number of threads and SIMD lanes, because it's a Merkle tree on the inside. - Capable of verified streaming and incremental updates, again because it's a Merkle tree. - A PRF, MAC, KDF, and XOF, as well as a regular hash. - One algorithm with no variants, which is fast on x86-64 and also on smaller architectures.

The last two modes use a helper tool, 'koan', that integrates with cobbler. There is also a web interface 'cobbler-web'. firefox-addons:986239.description:
This add-on register listener on webRequests (only for URLs marked in bookmarks as private). Original request is blocked and instead URL is open in a new private window (or in already opened if one exists).
Private bookmarks are those containing keyword defined in preferences page (default is "private"). Keyword must be included in the title field of a bookmark. This is a bit inconvenient but current WebExtensions API does not support any other bookmark field. Once API is updated I will add support also for marking private bookmarks using TAGs.
You can trace progress of API development in here 
Happy private browsing!

firefox-addons:2817227.name: Webpage to Video
firefox-addons:2817227.summary: Converts web pages or local HTML files you are currently looking at into videos. The videos are produced in the mp4 (H264) format.
firefox-addons:2817227.description:
Don't just capture a static snapshot of a webpage—record how it moves and changes over time! 
Quickly convert any webpage or local HTML file into a high-quality MP4 video. This is the perfect solution for capturing dynamic content that standard screenshot tools simply cannot catch.
 Perfect for: 
 Capturing CSS animations and dynamic web designs for portfolios.
 Recording interactive charts, graphs, and live data dashboards.
 Documenting visual bugs or UI/UX issues for developers.
 Archiving webpages with moving elements or embedded media.
 How It Works: 
This extension securely reads the content of your current web page and sends it to GrabzIt's API for conversion. The final MP4 video is automatically downloaded in your browser.
 Getting Started & Pricing: 
Once installed, simply follow the instructions in the extension popup to create your free GrabzIt account and start converting.
 Free Tier: Core webpage-to-video conversions are free forever.

firefox-addons:2890660.name: Shop Ethical!
firefox-addons:2890660.summary: Adds Shop Ethical! ratings to brand names on online shopping sites to help you choose more ethical options.
firefox-addons:2890660.description:
The Shop Ethical! browser extension gives you the low-down on the environmental and social record of companies behind common brands you buy in Australian supermarkets and beyond. Shop online with a clear conscience!
Key Features:
👩🏻💻See brand ratings right where you're doing your shopping, on sites like Woolies, Coles, Amazon, etc.
📊 We do the work for you - we've gathered information from over 90 sources to give you a clear picture of a company's ethical track record
✅Simple A-F rating system makes it easy to see at a glance which are the better picks
❗Please note, to get full access to the extension, you'll need to be a Shop Ethical! subscriber, which costs $5/month. You can cancel any time and you'll still be able to use the extension, you just won't get data updates.
⭐How it works:
The most comprehensive digital guide to ethical shopping in Australia, Shop Ethical! has been designed to provide consumers with the easiest way to make informed purchasing decisions.
The Shop Ethical! browser extension features the most up to date data from the Shop Ethical! website - automatically updated daily.
Instantly see ratings for over 7,500 brands, so you can make an informed and ethical decision whenever they shop.
Hover over the rating to see more information about which company owns the brand and country of ownership, and click through to see our full company profiles from ethical.org.au .
⭐Why you should use our ratings:
By shopping ethically consumers can send a strong message for change and help support the practices that make our world a better place to live in.
Company ratings are based on information gathered from over 90 sources, including the work of organisations such as Greenpeace, Ethical Fashion Guide, WWF, Fairtrade and Amnesty International.
Our ratings use assessments from 4 broad categories:
- Social
- Environment
- Animal
- Business ethics
... with over 20 subcategories like Factory Farming, Palm Oil, Product Safey, Worker Rights, and Corporate Conduct.
⭐More about us:
The Shop Ethical! ratings are also available as an app on iOS or Android, and website ( ethical.org.au ), but the browser extension puts our ratings right where you are doing your shopping. 
⭐Tips for using the extension:
You'll need to be a Shop Ethical! subscriber to get access to the full data - find out more at ethical.org.au/browser-extension . The cost is just $5 per month which helps to fund our small team in the work we're doing. You can unsubscribe any time, and you'll still be able to use the extension, but you won't get any more data updates.
Sometimes, brand names are also common words (think Apple!). So, you may sometimes see some "false positives" as you're browsing. Use your common sense to work out whether it's really a brand name in context.

bluejetty:00123996:ios.description:
Build your Kingdom, train your Dragons and start destroying things today. Goblins! Skeletons! People with weird Moustaches! Battle them all in this RTS mobile MMO kingdom game! Now with 4x more content. Feel the thrill of real time crusades!
The ultimate Kingdom Empire game on the planet. Find the best strategy to attack the Enemies' Kingdoms. Either defeat them or be defeated. This is a real-time City building & strategy game that looks easy but requires substantial brainpower. Most wardragons Kingdom Empire games are fun but this city building game is on another level. The most fun and addicting War strategy Kingdom building game is right on your sight waiting for you to join.
Rip through the realm competition and shed some blood, sweat, and tears by engaging in medieval kingdom game battles using your kingdom guard and their mighty Dragons! You won’t have a chance to rest once you’re done terrorizing your neighbors either because new Raids and Dragon Booty equipment have been added to your kingdom’s arsenal. Increase that fire power today & Create your own empire in this city building game and see the rise of your kingdom!
Kingdoms of Heckfire is a multiplayer war strategy game. As a king, you need to build and upgrade a variety of buildings to build your stronghold, gradually building a mighty dragon army to defend your empires. This online wardragons Empire game is very special, it implements fresh and interesting rules, well-designed city Building game mechanics that allow you to enjoy the fun of a real war strategy game. Make your Kingdom rise & become one of the best world warriors.
A treasure trove of new features has been added in this army MMO Empire building game. Check out the 4x more kingdom game content we’ve been working on below!
FEATURES of Kingdoms of Heck Fire - Wardragons Empire Games
• A medieval inspired real time, open world map filled with dragon monsters and pvp players from around the world!
• Hatch and raise a powerful Dragon army to strike fear into your enemy's hearts to build a kingdom for a king!
• Complete epic quests issued by a myserious wizard who lives in your kingdom!
• Engage in kingdom games by creating powerful Clans and Alliances to rule the realms of Heck Fire!
• Train your kingdom guard with new Dragon Booty equipment upgrades, adding further RTS strategy depth to your gameplay! If your PVP enemies want fire and blood, they can expect both!
• Up your kingdom game! Construct medieval buildings faster with the added Second Kingdom Builder mechanic then dominate in city building PVP battles!
• Battle well groomed Titan monsters for massive amounts of medieval loot! Possibly even rare treasure for raining hellfire on the competition!
• Can’t stand enemy fire, get out of the realm with our new Realm to Realm Transfer Token! Elevate your kingdom game by starting fresh in a different realm with new threats and rewards. Once you upgrade enough, use the Realm Transfer Token to explore other realms and chase your enemy’s kingdom down!
• Fresh kingdom and Clan wide Raids await with increasing MMO strategy difficulty!
• Rise through the ranks with dynamic Event schedules! Build up your empire wins and compete in elite SLG style gameplay leaderboards!
• Tournaments and evolving PVP mechanics such as Dragon lethality weaknesses ensure this army MMO will constantly challenge your kingdom games strategy. So stay on your toes or RIP!
Rise to the occasion and defeat your competition if you dare!
For more information:

bluejetty:00128794:ios.name: Doll House Games for Kids
bluejetty:00128794:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00128794:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Kids Play House - is an imaginative and learning open-ended game for little kids of pre and primary school age. A beautiful digital playground where kids are free to express creativity and play their own stories. The four sweetest animals invite your kids to discover their cozy house with lots of lovely details and fun activities. 
Some of them:
 - Have a tea or milkshake party
 - Get creative - dance and play guitar
 - Take care of bath routines for your little friends
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00016527:ios.summary: Greetings adventurer! Welcome to the Age of Revenge — a free retro-style MMO RPG with a catching story and simple idle rpg gameplay. Dive into the age of magic with this fantasy rpg adventure game. Embark on a journey across far-away foreig
bluejetty:00016527:ios.description:
Greetings adventurer! Welcome to the Age of Revenge — a free retro-style MMO RPG with a catching story and simple idle rpg gameplay. Dive into the age of magic with this fantasy rpg adventure game. Embark on a journey across far-away foreign lands, battle with dangerous beasts and dungeon bosses, level up your weapon, and achieve might and power previously only known to gods!
EXPLORE THE WORLD
Centuries ago, the First Empire of the human race had fallen. The lands were ravaged by a powerful dark force, which our brave heroes of the Second Empire are trying to stop from spreading. You too will join the ranks of these heroes in this turn based rpg.
Set off on dangerous quests: to the mysterious Thicket or to the perilous Land of Fire, to the foresaken Subterranean Kingdom or to the cryptic Heart of Darkness. Take a stand in this turn based rpg against the magical beings that inhabit these lands and learn the secrets of the Old Empire. 
Explore dungeons to find potent artefacts and use them to gain unbelievable power and win the mighty dungeon bosses.
LEVEL UP YOUR CHARACTER
Train, learn new combat skills, upgrade your equipment and customize your character with new armor. Find rare weapons and test your skills against other players in the role playing PvP arena.
JOIN A CLAN
Join one of the many existing clans or create your own with your own rules. Battle against powerful dungeon bosses with a team, and share the plentiful loot. Build citadels, libraries, and other buildings with your clan and receive useful bonuses.
MAKE NEW FRIENDS
Meet hundreds of other players and work collectively to survive the orc invasion. Have discussions in the chat, on our forums, or within your clan. Find new friends and complete quests together.
ENJOY FANTASTIC ADVENTURE 
Intuitive classic rpg mechanics and simple clicker role play game play. 
FIND WHAT YOU LIKE
This rpg adventure game has a lot of immersive features in it:
– Advanced character leveling
– Large bestiary
– Dungeons with bunches of treasures
– Themed quests
– Arena for PvP battles
– Clan battles
– Realistic graphics
Plunge into the dark fantasy of this roleplay game, enjoy the best of idle rpg games and fantasy rpg games.

bluejetty:00086450:ios.description:
Meet Smitten, the dating app that makes meeting people actually fun.
Dating shouldn’t feel like a job.
Conversations shouldn’t feel scripted.
And getting to know someone should feel exciting again.
That’s where Smitten comes in.
We bring personality, humor, and spontaneity back to dating through playful profile moments, interactive games, and better ways to discover people who match your vibe.
“We’re not like other dating apps.”
Here’s why…
1. Find people who match your vibe.
Instead of endlessly swiping, tell us the kind of energy you’re looking for and explore people who fit your preferences.
For example:
• “Outdoorsy and adventurous”
• “Confident and ambitious”
• “Coffee lover with a great sense of humor”
• “Creative, social, and spontaneous”
2. Explore personality-first profiles.
Discover people through their humor, opinions, quirks, highlights, and unique perspective. Smitten helps you connect beyond just photos.
3. Make dating feel more natural.
Smitten is designed to help conversations flow more easily through interactive prompts, games, and shared experiences that break the ice naturally.
4. Actually get to know people.
Smitten profiles include personality games, fun prompts, live photo moments, and conversation starters that help people show who they really are.
5. No more dead-end chats.
Matches expire after 10 days if nobody messages, encouraging real conversations and helping reduce ghosting. Smitten also adds game results directly into chats to make starting conversations easier.
What if dating felt more like playing a game?
Guessary
Guess fun facts about other people and discover surprising details about their personality. A fun, effortless icebreaker.
Lie Detector
Two truths and a lie — you know the game. Spot the lie, challenge each other, and kick off the conversation.
Wavy
Rate hot takes on a slider, then compare answers to see whether you instantly click or lovingly disagree.
Unlock Smitten Premium
Upgrade your experience with premium features:
• See who likes you
• Undo accidental likes
• Unlimited likes
• Read receipts
• Incognito mode for more privacy
It’s a wild world out there, so we’ve added tools to help keep dating comfortable and safe:
• Pause your profile anytime
• Control your visibility
• Connect at your own pace
Just one final piece of advice:
Don’t settle for boring dating apps.
Try Smitten.
The app is free to use. Optional premium features are available. Terms apply:
https://www.websitepolicies.com/policies/view/d4cOtUMF

Start from a small asteroid absorbing other asteroids to form a solar system.

bluejetty:00159819:ios.name: Pofi Create: 3D Pose Reference
bluejetty:00159819:ios.summary:
Draw what you imagine, with a reference you can shape.
Pofi Create helps illustrators, comic artists and drawing enthusiasts build the 3D references their artwork needs. Start with a character, a pose or a ready-made scene. Arrange your su
bluejetty:00159819:ios.description:
Draw what you imagine, with a reference you can shape.
Pofi Create helps illustrators, comic artists and drawing enthusiasts build the 3D references their artwork needs. Start with a character, a pose or a ready-made scene. Arrange your subjects, find the camera angle and explore the light, so the picture in your head becomes easier to study and draw.
Pose it. Frame it. Light it. Draw it.
• FIND THE PIECES FOR YOUR NEXT DRAWING
Build a scene with characters, animals, props and environments. Explore separate hands and feet, heads and art-study models, plus effects and alternate appearances. A growing collection of over 100,000 resources gives you starting points for solo poses, groups, interactions and hands holding props.
Library expansions include 24 added model categories and 32 motion series. Supported models have built-in poses, expressions and appearance options; structural guides help you understand form.
• SHAPE THE POSE YOU NEED
Start with standing, sitting, running or action poses, then refine supported models. Around 80 preset hand poses help you study difficult fingers and grips without starting from scratch. Advanced controls offer up to 150 controllable joints on supported character rigs, detailed hand and toe adjustment, and over 100 facial parameters on selected characters. IK moves connected limbs from a target; FK turns individual joints. Body flexibility, joint limits and IK blending help with finer adjustments. Driver sliders change supported props and effects. Available controls vary by resource.
• START WITH A COMPLETE SCENE
Scene templates bring models, composition, cameras and lighting together, so you can study how the whole picture works.
Static: open a ready-made composition with poses and light.
Motion: play or pause existing animations to study body movement, camera changes and lighting.
Annotated: use notes and dedicated views to understand structure and details.
Interactive: tap to switch poses, scenes and existing animations.
With Pro, adjust and save your own reference scenes for later drawings.
• SEE THE ANGLE BEFORE YOU DRAW
Explore standard, wide-angle and fisheye lenses to plan perspective and distortion. Choose a solid background, an HDR sky or your own image. Depth of field helps you preview foreground and background blur, making spatial relationships easier to study.
• SEE HOW LIGHT SHAPES THE FORM
Try studio lighting presets, use an HDR environment, or adjust three directional lights independently. Change direction, color and shadows for key, fill and rim lighting. Compare how different setups reveal a face, a pose or a prop before you paint the shadows.
• BUILT FOR YOUR DRAWING WORKFLOW
Use Pofi Create for illustration, manga, comics, figure drawing and storyboard planning. Existing motion scenes also help with animation studies; portrait poses, staging, clothing and accessories provide references for photography and fashion.
A new 3D engine and streamlined controls support detailed observation. Cloud saving and sync keep saved work available on supported devices and platforms. The Pofi series has over 10 million combined installs across all platforms.
Export JPG or transparent PNG snapshots to use alongside your drawing app.
• RESOURCES AND FEATURES ARE SEPARATE
Free to download, with some free resources. Buy individual resources with P-coins for permanent access; they remain available after Pro expires. Advanced controls, lighting and custom-scene saving require Pro.
Ultra provides access to all resources without individual P-coin purchases. Check the purchase page for pricing, duration, included features and renewal terms. Ultra access differs from permanently purchasing each resource.
• CONNECT WITH POFI
X / Instagram: @PofiCreate
Discord: https://discord.gg/q3VqR98Vkg
Email: create@pofiart.com
Terms of Use: https://create.pofiapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://create.pofiapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00144859:ios.description:
Coaching app for athletes looking to take their running to the next level. 
How it works
Athletes: Get an invite from a coach or choose one coaching option.
• Adaptive Trainer (14-Day Free Trial)
• Goal Race Plan
• Match with a Private Coach
Coaches: Start your 30-day free trial and learn how to manage your athletes at https://vdoto2.com/vdotcoach
Popular Features
• Assess your current running fitness (VDOT)
• Built-in personalized training paces
• Sync training calendar with GPS data from Apple Health, Coros, Garmin or Strava
• Sync workouts/pace targets to Apple Watch, Coros or Garmin for real-time guidance
• Adapt your training based on your improvement
• Work with your coach, communicate and adjust training
Truly Personalized
Unlike most running apps, VDOT knows you. It understands the type of runner you are, what you're training for, and how to maximize your efforts. It also gives you more control over your training, leveraging your feedback to deliver real-time data which fine tunes your training and leads to continuous progression. With fully automated, truly personalized and highly-adaptive training, VDOT helps you achieve measurable improvement — all in an effort to make you the best runner you can be.
Intelligent Training
With a focus on training over tracking and coaching over running, VDOT offers access to the highest quality, Olympic-style training for runners of all levels-right from any mobile device. Designed to help runners train correctly and more intelligently, VDOT elicits maximum benefit while reducing the required effort. These high-quality workouts promote healthy, responsible, and beneficial sessions while simultaneously preventing overtraining.
Olympic Pedigree
V.O2 was built from the foundation of a scientifically-validated training methodology. Based on former Olympian, author, and legendary running coach Jack Daniels’ exercise science principles, the methodology not only benefits runners of all ages and abilities when it comes to improving their running fitness but it also serves as the best measure of running economy across a variety of runners and events, making it an ideal way to compare performances. High-school, college, Olympic and non-elite runners have all trained, ran, and succeeded with the VDOT methodology.
-”Dr. Jack Daniels has had a bigger influence on training-for-running than anyone. He might be considered the Albert Einstein of the sport." - Runner’s World Magazine

Navigate the road with ease by conquering the world of road signs. Our app's extensive collection of questions ensures you're well-versed in recognizing and understanding road signs – a crucial skill for any driver.

bluejetty:00127470:ios.summary:
How loud is it, really? The neighbor's bass at 2 a.m. The workshop that leaves your ears ringing. Decibels gives you a number you can trust — and, when you need it, the evidence to back it up.
Decibels is a precision sound level meter buil
bluejetty:00127470:ios.description:
How loud is it, really? The neighbor's bass at 2 a.m. The workshop that leaves your ears ringing. Decibels gives you a number you can trust — and, when you need it, the evidence to back it up.
Decibels is a precision sound level meter built like a real instrument: the IEC 61672 mathematics professionals use, per-device calibration verified against a laboratory-validated reference, and a design that shows what the noise is doing, not just how loud it is.
A · C · Z WEIGHTING · FAST · SLOW · IMPULSE · Leq · LCpeak · SEL
THE REAL MATHS, IN A REAL METER.
MEASURE LIKE AN INSTRUMENT
Every reading is a true IEC-weighted level. Choose A, C or Z weighting and Fast, Slow or Impulse response. Sessions record the energy-averaged Leq, the loudest moment, the C-weighted peak, sound exposure level (SEL) and the L10, L50 and L90 statistical levels used in environmental noise reports. An overload lamp shows when the microphone is clipping, and readings below the microphone's own floor are flagged, not faked. Fine-tune against any reference meter with the built-in guide.
SEE WHAT THE NOISE IS
A number says it's loud; the spectrum says it's a fridge compressor, a bass line or a siren. Switch the meter to a live FFT spectrum analyzer, 1/3-octave bands, or a scrolling spectrogram waterfall that paints frequency against time and identifies a sound by its shape.
NIGHT MODE
Start it at bedtime, set your wake-up time, and put the phone down. In the morning a quiet-hours report shows your night hour by hour: how quiet it was, when the loud moments happened, and how loud they were. Light on battery.
KEEP THE EVIDENCE
Set a threshold and get notified when noise crosses it. Turn on Evidence Clips and Decibels saves a 30-second recording around each event — 10 seconds before, 20 after — stored only on your phone, playable from the session, and shared only when you choose. Built for noise complaints.
PROTECT YOUR HEARING
An exposure dosimeter tracks your daily noise dose against NIOSH, OSHA and EU 2003/10/EC limits: dose percentage, time-weighted average and safe time remaining at the current level. Export sessions to Apple Health as environmental audio exposure.
ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
A Live Activity keeps the meter on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while you record, Stop button included. Widgets show your last reading and today's dose. Share a session card in one tap, or export CSV data and PDF reports.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Audio is analysed on your device and never leaves it unless you share a clip or card yourself. Evidence Clips are off by default and require explicit consent.
FREE
- Live meter with A/C/Z weighting, Fast/Slow/Impulse response
- Leq, Max, Min, C-weighted peak and overload indicator
- Calibration trim and reference-meter guide
- Sessions with chart, notes, tags and location (last 10)
- One threshold alert
- Live Activity, widgets, light and dark themes
DECIBELS PRO
- Unlimited session history
- Spectrum analyzer, 1/3-octave bands and spectrogram waterfall
- Night mode with quiet-hours reports
- Evidence Clips
- Exposure dosimeter (NIOSH · OSHA · EU) and Apple Health export
- CSV and PDF export, share cards
Decibels Pro is available as a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://realvision.app/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00090343:ios.description:
alQibla provides you with an easy tool to precisely determine the direction of qibla from any location around the world and calculate the prayer times for your city.
Features:
1. Prayer Times based on your calculation method & location.
2. Prayer Times Notifications based for all prayers.
3. Notifications can have different Adhan for each prayer.
4. It uses iPhone's built in location services to determine your location and gives you the direction to Qibla on a Map.
5. Find the Qibla direction from any address using the search feature.
6. It also allows you to find Prayer Times for the following calculation methods:
-Ja'fari Ithna Asheri 
-University of Islamic Sciences, Karachi 
-Islamic society of North America (ISNA) 
-Muslim World League (MWL) 
-Umm al-Qura, Makkah 
-Egyptian General Authority of Survey 
-Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran
7. Prayer times tuner to make adjustments and share monthly or yearly prayer timetable with your friends/family/relatives.
8. Includes a graphical compass for iPhone 3Gs + devices with the compass hardware.
9. Hijri Calendar with important events.
Search could use the following formats: 
1. Full address or Zip code (example: NJ 08544)
2. Cities, states, and continents (examples: France, Tehran)
3. Famous places (example: Masjid Ul Haram)
4. Coordinates (example: +38 34′ 24″, -80 32′ 57″)
Requirements:
1. iOS 15.0+ installed with Location Services (Settings > General > Location Services) turned ON.
2. Also requires either a WiFi or a mobile network to load the map tiles.
3. For prayer time adhan notifications iOS15.0+ is required.

bluejetty:00152553:ios.summary:
Your face is a time machine with EDNA. Our advanced technology generates a stunning photo of your ancestors and reveals your true origin story. See who you really are. All from just one selfie.
Forget boring family trees that end in names
bluejetty:00152553:ios.description:
Your face is a time machine with EDNA. Our advanced technology generates a stunning photo of your ancestors and reveals your true origin story. See who you really are. All from just one selfie.
Forget boring family trees that end in names on a chart. We offer a tangible connection. Our technology renders a lifelike, era-authentic portrait of ancestors you’ve never met, capturing a plausible likeness with a strangely familiar face. It’s a jaw-dropping, shareable moment of connection when you see your own eyes, your smile, looking back at you from another time. This is the family photograph that was never taken.
But the portrait is just the beginning. It’s your entry point into a complete Ancestral Report, a deep dive into the elements that define your heritage.
First, discover your true origins with a detailed, percentage-based breakdown of your nationality. Go beyond continents to see the specific blend of cultures that make up your unique identity, revealing connections you never knew existed. Then, we reveal their story. Learn about the specific city your ancestors likely called home, the authentic craft they dedicated their lives to, and even the historical diet that fueled their world.
Your origin story doesn't just end in the past—it echoes in your present. The resilience of a frontiersman, the precision of an artisan, the creativity of a storyteller; these are more than historical facts, they are potential traits within you. We connect your heritage to your life today, offering unique insights for modern careers and lifestyles that may align with these ancestral strengths. It’s a powerful new way to understand your own passions and potential.
Join a growing community of people discovering themselves in a completely new way. The stories and portraits generated by EDNA are sparking conversations, connecting families, and helping people see their own identity in a richer, deeper light. It's a unique experience everyone is talking about.
This isn’t a guess. Our analysis is powered by a vast database of real historical records, cultural trends, and geographic data. This robust framework allows us to create a narrative that feels both magical and deeply plausible. We are committed to your privacy; your photo and personal data are always secure and are never shared.
To analyze your photos and create your unique ancestral story, you’ll need a True Heritage Pro subscription. The Pro subscription allows you to unlock full access to detailed reports, including Explore Your Ancestors, Explore Your Origins, Your Ideal Partner, and Your Past Life. Please note that photo analysis and viewing the complete content of any generated reports are premium features available only to subscribers
Subscriptions:
To access all premium content we have subscription packages. Subscription periods are 1 week and 1 year. Every week or year your subscription renews.
1 week subscription price is $5.99 and 1 year price is $29.99.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless cancelled at least one day before the renewal date within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. You can manage and cancel your subscription by going to your account settings in the App Store
Download True True Heritage & Ancestry: EDNA now and finally meet your ancestors.
--

bluejetty:00184179:ios.description:
Compounder lets you easily calculate the power of compound interest to reach your financial goals—whether for savings, investments, or retirement planning. 
What is compound interest? Compound interest is the interest calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods. This powerful tool can make a big difference over time!
Example:
Imagine starting with $1,000 in savings, contributing $500 monthly at an 11% annual return. After 40 years, that account could grow to $4.38 million! Even small, regular contributions—like the average American car payment—can build lasting wealth.
Features:
 Quickly calculate compound interest with flexible settings.
 Factor in periodic withdrawals or additional contributions to see how they affect your growth.
 Easy-to-use interface, designed for anyone wanting to understand and harness compound interest, without needing a finance background.
You don’t need to be a Wall Street broker to become a millionaire. Start planning your financial future with Compounder today!

bluejetty:00115330:ios.description:
Scrambly is a walking rewards app that helps people earn cash and gift card rewards from their daily steps. Track your movement, reach step goals, join challenges, and turn everyday activity into rewards.
Whether you’re walking to work, running errands, taking a daily walk, or simply trying to stay more active, Scrambly gives your steps more value.
EARN REWARDS FOR WALKING
Earn points from the steps you already take throughout your day. Keep your phone with you, track your movement, and build your rewards as you stay active.
Scrambly is designed for people who want to:
*Earn rewards from everyday walking
*Track daily steps and activity
*Reach step goals
*Join walking challenges and competitions
*Redeem earnings for cash or gift cards
HOW DOES SCRAMBLY REWARD YOUR STEPS?
Track your daily movement with Scrambly. As your steps add up, you earn points that build toward rewards.
Walking to work, shopping, taking the dog out, or going for an evening walk can all contribute to your progress.
HOW CAN YOU EARN MORE?
Take part in ongoing competitions, step challenges, and limited-time bonuses. These give you additional opportunities to earn while helping you stay motivated and active.
HOW CAN YOU REDEEM YOUR REWARDS?
Convert your points into digital rewards or cash.
Withdraw earnings starting from $1, with redemption options available in as little as 3 hours.
PREMIUM FEATURES
Premium gives you access to enhanced earning opportunities, additional rewards, and more flexibility when using Scrambly.
Premium Annual Subscription: $79.99
Premium Monthly Subscription: $7.99
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or turn off auto-renewal anytime in your account settings.
Renewal charges are applied within 24 hours before the current period ends.
If you cancel, your subscription remains active until the end of the billing period. No refunds are provided for unused time.
IS SCRAMBLY RIGHT FOR YOU?
Scrambly is designed for people who already walk throughout their day or want extra motivation to stay active. Your commute, errands, daily walks, and step goals can all become opportunities to earn rewards.
START WALKING TODAY
Connect your step tracker and start turning your daily activity into rewards. Your movement has value.
For help or questions, contact us at support@scrambly.io

bluejetty:00017179:ios.description:
"In a time of gun and sword, the magical stone that maintains the balance of the world is stolen by high-tech aliens. The world is hanging on a thin thread. It all depends on you retrieving the magical stone…"
We honestly can't keep making it all up. Let's just shoot some alien minions!
This is the shooter game that features extremely easy and intuitive control. Its super smooth and enjoyable gameplay, mixed with rogue-like elements, will get you hooked from the very first run!
Features:
* 20+ unique heroes—a rogue, an elf archer, a magician... There is always an option that goes perfectly with your playstyle.
* 400+ weapons—guns, swords and shovels... Numerous ways to nuke the pestering monsters from orbit!
* Randomly generated dungeons—dark forests populated by goblins, medieval chateaus infested with zombies… Raid on a profusion of monster dens to loot treasures and bump into different NPCs.
* Auto-aim mechanism for super intuitive control. Dodge, fire, cast skill—score super combos effortlessly with a few taps. Controller supported.
* Multiplayer mode available! Team up with friends around the world for an online co-op adventure, or get together with your gang for an offline multiplayer LAN game.
* Assorted game modes and features. Prefer brain over brawl? Work out strategy to hold out against constant attacks in the tower defense mode!
A pixel roguelike shoot'em up with offline option that combines action and survival. Pick up the gun and start your dungeon adventure!

bluejetty:00063739:ios.description:
Have you ever watched a trailer for a new movie you wanted to see, but completely forgotten about it? Or you can't find where to watch, stream, rent or buy a movie?
Then Movies+ is the simple movie tracker is the app for you! You can't stream or watch any movies in this app, it's just an informational tool.
Movies+ adds to your movie watching experience by keeping you up to date with the latest info, tracking your watched status and alerting you to changes to all your favourite movies.
Simply search or browse for movies you want to watch, then add them to you watch list and we'll do all the hard work for you, we constantly check for production changes, new cast members and release date announcements or changes, then we let you know of any important changes to your favourite upcoming movies.
Never forget about a movie or be stuck looking for something to watch again! Movies+ will help you find out where to watch, stream, rent or buy all your favourite movies.
 - See similar movie recommendations,
 - Find out where to watch, stream, rent or buy movies,
 - Alerts for production changes, new cast/crew, and release date announcements, 
 - View trailers, and movie clips,
 - Mark movies watched/unwatched,
 - See all release dates, Theatre, DVD and Streaming,
 - View Movie details,
 - See Popular, Now Playing and Upcoming Movies,
 - Night/Dark mode,
Movies+ is funded by ads, if you choose to purchase Movies+ Pro to hide these ads, Premium notifications, and unlimited favourites and follows, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Purchasing Movies+ Pro will not allow you to stream or watch any content, shows, or movies.
Privacy policy: https://moviesplus.app/support/privacy
Terms of use: https://moviesplus.app/support/terms

bluejetty:00132399:ios.summary: Tser is a transgender dating and chat app designed specifically for the transgender community, including trans women, trans men, and genderqueer individuals. Our app is a safe haven for transgender singles, crossdressers, and feminine-prese
bluejetty:00132399:ios.description:
Tser is a transgender dating and chat app designed specifically for the transgender community, including trans women, trans men, and genderqueer individuals. Our app is a safe haven for transgender singles, crossdressers, and feminine-presenting people. Join us and discover a non-judgmental, inclusive space where you can freely express your identity. Tser is free to download and easy to use.
Why Choose Tser?
1.A Non-Judgmental Environment:
Tser stands out as a dedicated dating and social network for transgender individuals and their cisgender allies. With team members who are themselves part of the transgender community, we are committed to fostering a supportive environment where transgender singles, including FTM and MTF individuals, can find companionship and love. Here, you can connect with transgender people, crossdressers, non-binary, and intersex individuals without fear of discrimination.
2. Connect Locally and Globally:
Our app enables you to create a personal ad and search for transgender singles both nearby and around the world. Engage in conversations with other trans individuals globally, expanding your horizons and building connections in places like the UK, UAE, Singapore, and Australia.
3. An All-Inclusive Transgender Community:
Tser aims to be an LGBTQ-friendly hub, welcoming everyone from the LGBTQ+ community. Whether you're seeking T4T dating, new friendships, or support within the trans community, Tser provides a platform for all.
Join Tser today to experience a world where gender diversity is celebrated and everyone can find their match, whether it’s for a casual date, a lasting relationship, or meaningful friendships. Please note that you must be 18 years old or older to join Tser.
Auto-renewable subscriptions policy:
If you choose to purchase 1-month, 3-month or 6-month subscription on Tser, payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase, and subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The prices of the auto-renewable subscriptions are: $12.99 for 1 month, $26.99 for 3 months and $45.99 for 6 months. Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
For more information, please check our Terms of Use: https://tser.app/terms.html and Privacy Policy: https://tser.app/privacy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us at support@tser.app.

Welcome to Roy Story, a charming puzzle game where match 3 levels, powerful blast mechanics, exciting quests, and beautiful areas come together in one magical journey.

Connect your car with the app or pair it with DIMO hardware (like a smart home device for your car) and instantly connect and interact. With DIMO, you can access the DIMO Marketplace where you can book maintenance, track your car’s value, and understand its health. 
Connect your car in minutes
For millions of drivers who already have a connected vehicle app and subscription (including Teslas), connecting their car is possible in minutes. Create an account, add your car, and the app will guide you on how to connect.
Collect your data
DIMO allows you to store a historical record of your vehicle data, which will become more and more useful for service appointments, transactions, and other services you might access with your car.
Protect your privacy
We value privacy, and we know our users do too. You can set privacy zones that obscure exact location data in the app easily and on a per-car basis, making the privacy settings highly customizable.

Two sinister elders are hunting you down, and their twisted idea of fun is a deadly hide-and-seek. To survive, you must hide, craft weapons, solve puzzles, and find a way out of the cursed house.

Will you outsmart the creepy elders and survive the night, or will you become their next victim?

bluejetty:00186987:ios.summary:

It has been doing that since the App Store opened in 2008, when it re
bluejetty:00186987:ios.description:
iSeismometer turns your iPhone or iPad into a seismograph. Set it on a table, tap the desk, and watch the ground move. You will be surprised how sensitive your phone is.
It has been doing that since the App Store opened in 2008, when it reached #1 in Education in Japan, Austria, Finland, and Greece. Version 1.7 is a complete rebuild: faster, clearer, and finally a real instrument.
LIVE SEISMOGRAPH
• Three axes at up to 100 samples per second, drawn like a strip-chart recorder
• Scroll back through up to an hour of history while it keeps recording
• Gravity filter with a real corner frequency, so slow tilt disappears and earthquakes stay
• Live spectrum: see the frequency of footsteps, a washing machine, or a passing truck at a glance
• Dark mode and a full iPad layout
EVENT DETECTION
• A seismologist's STA/LTA trigger flags every tremor with its peak acceleration, duration, and dominant frequency
• Three sensitivity levels, from "only real shakes" to "every footstep"
• Events are shaded on the traces and listed so you can jump straight to them
RECORDINGS
• Every session is saved automatically as compact raw data, split into hourly files
• Browse by day, open any recording, scrub to its events, and see its spectrum
• Export CSV, or pick up the raw files in the Files app and in Finder
• Keep them for a day, a week, a month, or forever
WAS THAT AN EARTHQUAKE?
• Live USGS feed on a globe, filtered by time window and magnitude
• Tap a quake for its depth, time, and the official USGS page
STREAM TO YOUR MAC
• Open iSeismometer on a Mac on the same Wi-Fi and your phone finds it by itself
• The Mac shows every device streaming to it side by side, with its own recordings and event detection
• Reconnects on its own after the screen locks, the network drops, or the Mac restarts
Made for fun and for learning. A phone carries a MEMS accelerometer, not a broadband seismometer, so it feels footsteps and trucks far better than distant earthquakes. Put it on a solid floor, plug it in, keep the screen awake, and you have a home seismic station. iSeismometer is not a substitute for official earthquake early warnings or emergency alerts.
Questions and ideas: info@objectgraph.com
"This is a novelty app but one that also helps you learn something new... one of those things that is very captivating once you've looked at it once." — The Independent Guide to the iPhone 3GS

Zengin Arşiv: En sevilen yerli komedi, romantik, polisiye ve dram dizilerine; fragmanlara ve çok özel sahnelere anında eriş.
İnternet erişimin olduğu her yerde; en popüler içerikleri ücretsiz, tam bölümleriyle ve en yüksek kalitede izlemek için doğru yerdesin.
Hemen indir, eğlencenin tadını çıkar. Çünkü burası Senin Starın!

bluejetty:00070297:ios.description:
“All Mixed Up!” is not your average word scramble game! Can you find the surprise answer to the provided clue? Unscramble words to build up the letters you will need to solve the puzzle. Along the way perhaps you can answer questions such as what is required to make an omelet? Or where should one never throw stones? Or what do you call a control freak?
You’ll challenge your brain unscrambling words and have a lot of fun along the way! Here’s a small sample of some of the entertaining puzzle solutions:
Tip Of The Tongue
Step Up To The Plate
Let Off The Hook
Bet The Farm
Music To My Ears
Piece of Cake
…and hundreds more!
PLUS: Come back to the game every day for a new daily challenge puzzle!
FEATURES:
- Over A THOUSAND unique and interesting puzzles.
- A NEW puzzle EVERY DAY.
- Fun and interesting solutions.
- Intuitive and simple controls.
- Regular updates.
HOW TO PLAY:
Unscramble the four words in the top-half of the puzzle by dragging or tapping on the letter tiles into the letter slots. Certain slots are denoted with a star inside of them. Tiles placed here get copied to the pool of tiles you’ll use for the final puzzle. Use the clue to figure out how to arrange the tiles. Stuck? No problem, you can get a hint which will move a tile to the correct spot.
Happy Puzzling!
Your friends at DexCheck.

- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via iTunes Account Settings. However, the current active subscription period cannot be canceled.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00072725:ios.description:
Studyable is the #1 AI study app, powered by the most advanced AI that can solve any question for any subject, including word & geometry problems. 
Simply take a photo or type your question, and get instant step-by-step answers. Plus, chat with your personal AI tutor that's designed for homework and assignment help.
· Take photos of your questions (including word & geometry problems) and get instant step-by-step solutions.
· Studyable can plot graphs of equations.
· Chat with your personal AI tutor that can see images, browse the web, and perform calculations.
· Generate entire flashcard sets from your notes for every subject.
SUPPORTED MATH TOPICS INCLUDE
Algebra
- Algebraic expressions
- Equations and inequalities
- Systems of linear equations
- Quadratic equations
- Polynomials
- Rational expressions
- Radical expressions
- Exponential and logarithmic functions
- Complex numbers
- Geometry
Points, lines, and angles
- Triangles
- Quadrilaterals
- Circles
- Polygons
- Solids in space (3D Geometry)
- Coordinate Geometry
- Trigonometry in right triangles
- Sine, cosine, tangent (and their reciprocals and inverses)
- Laws of sines and cosines
- Trigonometry
Radian measure
- Trigonometric functions (graphing and properties)
- Trigonometric identities
- Solving trigonometric equations
- Inverse trigonometric functions
- Applications of trigonometry
- Polar coordinates and complex numbers
Calculus
- Limits
- Continuity
- Differentiation
- Applications of differentiation
- Integration
- Applications of integration
- Differential equations
- Probability and Statistics
Basic probability principles
- Conditional probability
- Random variables and probability distributions
- Statistical data analysis
- Statistical inference and interpretation
Discrete Math
- Set theory
- Combinatorics (counting, permutations, combinations)
- Graph theory
- Boolean algebra and logic
- Basic number theory
Pre-Calculus
- Functions and their graphs
- Polynomial and rational functions
- Exponential and logarithmic functions
- Trigonometric functions
- Analytic Trigonometry
- Analytic Geometry
- Sequences, series, and probability
Plus, most other high school subjects are supported, such as Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, etc.), History, Languages, English, Geography, Social Studies, Computer Studies, Engineering, Business, Economics, and more.
If you need help with the app, or you have feedback/suggestions, email us at support@studyable.app.
TERMS OF USE: https://studyable.app/terms
PRIVACY POLICY: https://studyable.app/privacy

bluejetty:00062701:ios.description:
Features:
- Launch Schedule of Rocket Launches from around the world
- Space-related articles, events, and FAQ
- View the live launch video feed
- Add launches to your phone's calendar
- Launch Notifications
- Light/Dark Themes
- 12 & 24 time setting
- Find the best place to watch the launches in person
- Countdown to the next space launch
- Filter by launch sites and agencies/companies
- Get space agency and mission details
Embark on an interstellar journey with the Space Launch Schedule app, affectionately known as "Rocket Monkey" or "Space Monkey." Our app is your all-in-one gateway to an extensive and up-to-date list of upcoming space rocket launches happening worldwide. Customize your space adventure by tailoring the app to display only the launch sites and space agencies that captivate your curiosity.
Dive into the captivating world of space travel as you explore a rich collection of rocket launch videos sourced from various corners of our planet. Each video is a window into the awe-inspiring spectacle of these launches, bringing you closer to the marvels of outer space.
For the ardent space enthusiast, we offer in-depth information about the launch sites, including their geographical details and historical significance. Delve into the specifications of the rockets themselves, gaining insights into the cutting-edge technology propelling humanity into the cosmos. Discover the intricate details of each mission, from its objectives to the spacecraft involved.
Our app is your passport to the future of space exploration, connecting you with the pioneering space launch companies shaping the cosmos. Whether it's SpaceX, ULA, Blue Origin, Rocket Lab, or NASA, you'll find comprehensive profiles for these trailblazers, enabling you to stay updated on their latest endeavors.
With the Space Launch Schedule app, you can elevate your space exploration experience to new heights, making it a truly out-of-this-world adventure. Stay informed, stay inspired, and stay connected to the future of space travel.
Please send an email to support@kickstandtech.com with feedback.

bluejetty:00088799:ios.description:
Trade AI – Your AI Powered Trading Assistant
Navigating the financial markets can be overwhelming, but Trade AI simplifies the process with advanced AI-driven chart analysis. Whether you're trading stocks, forex, or cryptocurrencies, understanding market trends and technical patterns is essential for making informed decisions. Trade AI leverages powerful AI algorithms to analyze charts, identify key technical indicators, and provide actionable insights, all from a single image.
With Trade AI, you no longer need to spend hours analyzing charts manually. Our AI technology processes real-time trading data and delivers clear, data-backed insights that help traders make smarter, more confident decisions.
How Trade AI Works:
1. Upload or capture an image of a trading chart (stock, forex, or crypto)
2. AI scans for patterns, trends, and key indicators such as support and resistance levels, moving averages, and price action
3. Receive AI-generated insights tailored to your trading strategy, helping you interpret market conditions and potential trade opportunities
By using Trade AI, traders of all experience levels can enhance their chart analysis skills, recognize technical analysis patterns, and optimize their trading approach.
Who Can Use Trade AI?
Whether you're a beginner exploring stock trading or a seasoned forex trader, Trade AI is designed to support a wide range of market participants. If you're looking for a fast, AI-powered way to analyze stocks, forex charts, and crypto trends, this app provides the tools to help you stay ahead.
-Stock traders seeking AI-enhanced stock trading analysis
-Forex traders looking for AI-driven forex trading insights
-Technical analysis enthusiasts who want a second opinion on market trends
-Chart AI users interested in AI-assisted chart analysis
No matter your experience level, Trade AI helps you make more informed trading decisions by breaking down complex chart analysis into easy-to-understand insights.
Why Choose Trade AI?
-AI-driven insights: Get automated technical analysis based on AI pattern recognition
-Quick and easy: Just upload an image of a stock, forex, or crypto chart to receive AI-generated insights
-Saves time: No need for manual chart analysis—let AI do the heavy lifting
-Supports multiple markets: Works for stocks, forex trading, and crypto markets
Disclaimer:
Trade AI does not provide financial or investment advice. The insights generated by the app are for educational purposes only and should not be used as the sole basis for making trading decisions. Stock trading and forex trading involve risk, and users should always conduct their own research and consult with a licensed financial professional before executing any trades.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/tradeai-tos
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/tradeai-privacy-policy
