bluejetty:00127412:ios.description:
« Great sleep companion » Zhou
« Perfect music for me to fell asleep » Camper
« Calming and easy to use » Crizana
◆ Sleep app made simple ◆
Mysa is the sleep companion for people who are stressed or having trouble to fall asleep. It provides soothing, peaceful music and sounds to lull you into deep restful sleep every night!
You can combine the music with nature and ambient sounds that you like. Try out all the different combinations that you can get and let Mysa fly you to the moon in your sleep!
Stress and anxiety can disturb our sleep. Lack of sleep and restful night can have profound negative effect on our health and well-being. Not enough sleep can make us more prone to sickness, make us more careless, decrease productivity, and make us more prone to even more stress and mental problems.
That’s why it’s important to build a simple habit of having enough sleep every day. However, we often have hard time falling asleep for many reasons (let’s say.. screen time!). There are so many people with insomnia or people who can’t have deep restful sleep that their body need.
So we create Mysa to help you overcome sleeping problems and make your sleep quality better.
=================
FEATURES OF MYSA:
=================
◆ Simple, clean, minimalist design with lovely background images
◆ Very simple to use
◆ Various carefully selected melodies to choose from
◆ Mix your chosen music with nature sounds
◆ Various nature & ambient sounds
◆ No WiFi nor any connection required
◆ Great for babies, kids, or adults
◆ Adjust how long you want to listen
◆ Adjust volume from the app
◆ Also good for meditation session or yoga
PRO TIP: It’s a good idea to build a good sleeping habit and restful aura in your room to help you sleep even better. Invest in good bedding, such as pillows, mattress, etc. Some people also enjoy warm bath to help them relax. Other people use aromatherapy. bluejetty:00017078:ios.description:
RoByte is a simple and easy to use Roku remote control that works with your Roku Player or Roku TV.
Features:
• Setup is a breeze. RoByte automatically scans your network to find your Roku.
• Easily change channels with one tap
• Adjust volume of your Roku or Roku TV
• Use your keyboard for quick text entry for channels like Netflix or Hulu
• RoByte is designed for iPhone as well as iPad
• Easily navigate without looking at your phone using the touchpad
• RoByte pairs with multiple Roku players.
RoByte Free features:
• Roku remote control
• Play/pause, fast forward, rewind
• Pair with multiple Roku devices
RoByte Premium features:
• Channel Switcher
• Volume Control
• Keyboard & Voice Search
• Touchpad
Help Guide:
If you are having issues, please do the following on your Roku TV:
Go to Settings -> System -> Advanced System Settings -> Control by mobile apps, and select "Enabled"
In order for RoByte to talk to your Roku, the following must be true:
1. Your Roku must be connected to your home's wifi network.
2. Your iPhone or iPad's wifi must be turned on and connected to the same network as the Roku.
Quick Tips:
• Most problems connecting to your Roku can be resolved by simply reinstalling RoByte.
• RoByte can only connect if you are on the same wifi network as your Roku device.
In most cases, RoByte will automatically scan and find your Roku device but there is a small case where if you have a more complicated setup, you may need to manually enter your Roku's IP address to connect. 
If you're still unable to connect to your Roku, theres a good chance there's an issue somewhere within your network. Most common cases are Roku devices getting disconnected from your home wifi if it gets unplugged. You can also try reinstalling RoByte to do a fresh scan.

There are many important moments in life that you will never want to miss, right? Countdown widget & Timer 321 will help you customize and track countdown events right on your home screen and lock screen with just a few taps.
Also if you want a great timer right on widget home screen, lock screen or StandBy, this is your choice!
Countdown widget® 321 is designed to include many widget styles, which are suitable for any event, or any of your personal styles. They’re very easy to customize, making your phone become eye-catching, impressive, and unique. Countdown widget® 321, from 2016, has helped thousands of people manage their life’s important events.
Advantages of the Countdown widget® 321:
+ WIDGETS on HOME SCREEN & LOCK SCREEN & STANDBY: Add as many events as you want
+ VARIOUS WIDGET STYLES: Birthday, retirement, a baby born, wedding…Those are not mere images like other widget apps, but are uniquely designed to fit for your events.

+ TIMER SOUND, COLOR customization.
+ COUNT UP: You can check how many days a specific event passed
+ REMINDER: With notification, any kind of events
+ Can insert PHOTO as widget wallpapers
+ Easy to change fonts, layouts
+ Change countdown unit on the widget
+ Change widget colors or gradient
In addition, the event sharing feature will help you spread the fun when counting down with family members, friends, and colleagues. For example, husband and wife count down the date of their child's birth, parents and siblings count down Christmas day, or count down product release date with colleagues.

+ Can switch from countdown to count up

+ Add a reminder

+ Add emoji ...
+ Customize your app like a pro

bluejetty:00031798:ios.name: Dice Puzzle - Dice Merge Game
bluejetty:00031798:ios.summary: Looking for a fun and challenging game that won't take up too much time? Classic board games can take hours to play and require a lot of setup. Dice Merge Puzzle is the perfect game to challenge your brain - while still having fun! With end
bluejetty:00031798:ios.description:
Looking for a fun and challenging game that won't take up too much time? Classic board games can take hours to play and require a lot of setup. Dice Merge Puzzle is the perfect game to challenge your brain - while still having fun! With endless gameplay, you can enjoy the game on your fingertips — anytime, anywhere!
If you're a fan of games like Ludo and Snake & Ladder and love to roll dice, then this dice puzzle is for you. Enjoy the match-3 puzzle by matching and merging the dice with a terrific board game. Match 3 dice game is easy to play, but tricky to master. The dice merge game has a lot to offer, trains the brain, relaxes after a long day at work, and much more. Adults and kids both will love to match and merge numbers and enjoy new dice merge puzzles for hours.
You may also know dice as "number cubes". This variant of the number cube game with the new addition of matching dice is all you need to pass the time in a fun way. You will feel as if you are playing a 3D game when playing this dice-matching game. The number merge puzzle is designed to suit all kinds of players. Download the dice puzzle game and play it daily to become a master player of this fantastic free block puzzle.
Interesting features of the dice merge game -
- Customize your dice and the block number cube the way you like.
- Enjoy gripping dice matching games by turning on sound and music.
- See your high score and climb up the leaderboard.
- You can tap to rotate the number cubes for a better winning strategy.
- You can play Dice Match 3 offline; it does not need an internet connection.
- The dice merge game offers storage space to save a number cube for later use.
- This game has mind-blowing powerups to help you if you are stuck.
- If you want to introduce your loved ones to this board game, you can share it with one tap.
A quick and easy guide to playing this dice puzzle game -
Dicedom has very easy gameplay. It is very similar to playing a match 3 game. When you place three number cubes with the same number adjacent to each other, they merge and become one number cube with a higher value. They come with different points one by one, pick a number cube strategically, and place them on the board to match with other cubes. Number cubes might come in a pair or alone. The objective is to merge three or more dice with the same dot or number horizontally or vertically, or both into a higher point. Dicedom also gives you storage space to save a number cube for later use.
Make smart game moves while matching and merging number cubes to get incredible power-ups. Like, merging the dice with higher points gives bigger powerups. Bomb power and rocket power help you clean the board faster while playing dice match games. You can continue playing and having fun unless the block puzzle board completely fills up. This matching 3 game is much better than playing any online merge dice game. Enjoy the beautiful graphics of this fun and addictive puzzle. Merge blocks to fill up the booster bar and gain a helpful power-up.
If you are looking for a simple brainy block puzzle game, Dicedom is the one for you. Download this amazing dice-matching puzzle game, play it, and relish it.

bluejetty:00015525:ios.description:
Skyscape's App is based on the print book from the most trusted names in NCLEX review: Linda Anne Silvestri and Angela Silvestri. 
Saunders Q & A Review for the NCLEX-RN® Examination offers more than 6,000 test questions, giving you all the Q&A practice you need to pass the NCLEX-RN examination!
"Try before you buy" - Download the FREE App, includes 100 practice questions.
App Features
* Study Mode (Attempt a question, see answer and the rationale)
* Create Quiz (Select topic, number of questions - Pause and resume anytime)
* 3 Preparedness quizzes
* Time Mode (Answer as many questions as possible in a set time to improve your speed)
* Study Goals (Set Goals with reminders)
* Stats (View details on topics mastered so you can focus on weak areas)
* Bookmark tricky questions and add notes - Creating flashcards
* ASK-AN-EXPERT - Nurse educators are on standby. Free service from Skyscape, response within 24 hours.
Purchase unlocks:
* Over 6,000+ practice questions
* Question categorized by: 
* Client needs
* Cognitive level
* Integrated process
* Content area
* Priority concepts
* UNIQUE! A detailed test-taking strategy and rationale
* Inclusion of all alternate item format questions to give users practice with mastering prioritizing, decision-making, and critical thinking skills.
* Multiple response
* Prioritizing [ordered response]
* Fill-in-the-blank
* Figure/illustration [hot spot]
* Chart/exhibit video
* Audio questions
* UNIQUE! Priority Nursing Action boxes list actions for clinical emergent situations requiring immediate action, including a detailed rationale and textbook reference.
* UNIQUE! Pyramid Alert! boxes spotlight important nursing concepts and procedures, and include tips and shortcuts for remembering key information.
* UNIQUE! Priority concepts call-outs highlight specific concepts related to nursing practice. Concepts have been updated to reflect the latest Giddens: Concepts for Nursing Practice text.
Educators - Make NCLEX prep part of the curriculum with hundreds of example questions
The Skyscape App/Platform includes a Web Dashboard
* Filter question bank
* Content area for "Content based" curriculum
* Priority concepts for "Concept based" curriculum
* Cognitive level
* Client needs
* Integrated Process
* Set assignments and view students progress - Contact Sales@skyscape.com for a no obligation demonstration
Students - Prepare for NCLEX "Anytime - Anywhere" with 6000+ practice questions
* The app tracks metrics on attempted questions so you can focus on your "Knowledge" gaps
* Correct answer after first attempt
* Correct answer after multiple attempts
* Bookmarked questions with notes
* After the Exam - Candidate Performance Report gives summary of how you performed in and description of the content area with a list of topics related to it. Your performance in each area is described in one of the following ways
* Above the Passing Standard
* Near the Passing Standard
* Below the Passing Standard
* Use the report and filters questions to brush-up on weak areas
Practice makes perfect with Saunders Q&A Review for the NCLEX-RN® Examination, 8th Edition offering more than 6,000 test questions, giving you all the Q&A practice you need to pass the NCLEX-RN examination! Each question enhances review by including a test-taking strategy and rationale for correct and incorrect answers. Questions are organized to match the Client Needs and Integrated Processes found in the most recent NCLEX-RN test plan. Q&A practice in the app has many study and testing options — including an option to select practice questions by health problem/medical diagnosis. From the most trusted names in NCLEX review Linda Anne Silvestri and Angela Silvestri.
ISBN 13: 9780323672849
Privacy Policy-https://www.skyscape.com/terms-of-service/privacypolicy.aspx 
Terms and Conditions-https://www.skyscape.com/terms-of-service/licenseagreement.aspx

Publisher: Elsevier Health Sciences Company

bluejetty:00084280:ios.description:
Geo Location Tracker is a comprehensive tool designed to help you stay connected with your loved ones, providing a seamless way to share and track locations. In today’s fast-paced world, keeping up with your family members’ and friends’ whereabouts can be challenging, but with this app, you can ensure that everyone stays in the loop, enhancing both communication and safety. 
Whether you’re coordinating a group meetup, ensuring your children’s safe arrival at school, or simply staying informed about your loved ones’ daily routines, this app simplifies the process by offering an intuitive interface and reliable functionality. By sharing your location with the people you trust most, you create a sense of accountability, trust, and reassurance within your circle. 
With advanced mapping and GPS technology, the app provides detailed location information, helping you track movements and plan effectively. Never worry about losing track of someone in a crowded space or during a busy day – the app ensures you can reconnect quickly and effortlessly. It’s not just about safety; it’s about fostering better communication and a stronger sense of community. 
Privacy and security are at the core of this app’s design. Location sharing is customizable, allowing users to determine who can see their movements and when. With encrypted data transmission and robust privacy controls, you can trust that your information is secure and accessible only to those you choose to share it with. 
The app isn’t just about utility; it’s about creating a sense of connection, reducing worry, and fostering peace of mind. Knowing that your loved ones are safe and reachable at any time brings a level of comfort and reassurance that is invaluable in today’s world. 
Whether you’re a parent wanting to ensure your kids’ safety, a friend looking to coordinate with your group, or simply someone who values staying connected, the Family & Friends Locator app is the perfect companion for your daily life. Strengthen your relationships, enhance communication, and prioritize safety with this essential app.

bluejetty:00131510:ios.name: Words Search: Word Game Fun
bluejetty:00131510:ios.summary:
Words Search: Your Passport to Word-Hunting Adventure!
Dive into a world of relaxing word search puzzles like never before. Words Search is your gateway to thousands of brain-teasing challenges and endless entertainment. Say goodbye to bor
bluejetty:00131510:ios.description:
Words Search: Your Passport to Word-Hunting Adventure!
Dive into a world of relaxing word search puzzles like never before. Words Search is your gateway to thousands of brain-teasing challenges and endless entertainment. Say goodbye to boring word games and hello to an immersive experience that tests your eye for letters while keeping you thoroughly amused. Prepare for an unforgettable word-hunting journey that’s both calming and mentally stimulating!
Install Words Search now for an instant ticket to a free word search odyssey that will sharpen your focus, vocabulary, and attention to detail.
Embark on a puzzle expedition where you scan the grid, connect letters, and uncover every hidden word! Words Search is ready whenever you are — on a break from work, at school, or while traveling — making it the ultimate rewarding pastime. Immerse yourself in beautiful nature-themed worlds and enjoy a delightful, relaxing word search experience the whole family can savor.
Word search fans, it’s time to flex your letter-finding skills! Ready for a free puzzle challenge? We dare you to unlock thousands of Words Search levels and journey through breathtaking landscapes — from sunlit seas and desert dunes to misty forests and snowy peaks!
With a massive library of puzzles to conquer, you’ll swipe across letter grids, discover hidden words, and spot bonus words for extra rewards. Each victory unlocks new chapters and fresh challenges while boosting your Brilliance score and expanding your vocabulary. Brace yourself for a journey through nature’s most stunning scenes, where the power of words reigns supreme!
WHY CHOOSE WORDS SEARCH?
Train your mind with thousands of word search puzzles that push your focus and language skills to the limit.
Progress through chapters and categories — how far can you climb?
Earn Brilliance with every word you find and watch your score grow with each newly discovered bonus word!
Collect coins and rewards as you play and complete levels.
PLAYING WORDS SEARCH IS A BREEZE:
Swipe across the letter grid in any direction to highlight hidden words — horizontally, vertically, and diagonally.
Stuck on a tricky word? Use powerful boosts: Light Bubble, Rocket, Propeller, or rotate the grid for a fresh perspective.
Running low on hints? Earn coins by finding bonus words or watch videos to keep your puzzle streak going.
WORDS SEARCH FEATURES AND PERKS:
Explore 3000+ levels across 50+ themed categories inspired by nature and landscapes around the world.
Enjoy distinctive, free word search challenges suitable for the entire family.
Immerstand yourself in captivating graphics and backgrounds that change with each new category and chapter.
Unlock new levels, bonus coins, and Brilliance as you keep finding words and completing puzzles.
Take on the Daily Puzzle, earn stars, and collect trophies for your achievements.
Build your Collection with stickers, frames, trophies, and custom highlighters.
Join seasonal live events — butterflies, treasure boxes, and more — for limited-time rewards.
Perfect for enhancing memory, focus, and expanding your lexicon.
Challenge your language skills with puzzles that rigorously test your knowledge and attention.
Join the Words Search community and enjoy the thrill of finding hidden words and unlocking new challenges every day! With our unique nature-themed categories, you can explore the world from the comfort of your home. Share your thoughts with us through reviews — we love hearing from our players!

bluejetty:00070868:ios.description:
Meet Escape Island, the unique sort puzzle game will present you a great experience and fun.
It is an easy to play addictive puzzle game that will relax you at the same time!
Sort the colored little men on the islands and get them together until each color is on the same land. It is a challenging and relaxing game to exercise your brain!
EASY GAMEPLAY
• Tap any island to pass little running men to their own color
• It works only if you can pass them if the island is linked to the same color and there is enough room on the island
• Do not get stuck
• If you get stuck you can undo your moves up to 5 times or restart the level
FEATURES
• Hundreds of challenging levels
• Free to play
• Pretty easy one finger control
Do you like mind games and color puzzles? We present to you the best and most unique 3D mind practicing game ever!
It's a challenging color puzzle and as much as it's fun with easy to play controls. Just sort the same colored little men on the same island and do not get stuck! If you get stuck, you can use the boosters or restart the level at any time to help you with getting little men together.
It is easy to figure out, just sort all the same colored men on the islands. Which level can you reach? Ready to break the world record?
Right now, install now and play this challenging and unique brain exercise game to have fun!
Enjoy Escape Island, committed to fun!
This game has a subscription-based premium feature package, it enables users to use the app without advertisements and with extra features. It's an auto-renewable subscription. The subscription period is weekly. Payment is charged to the App Store account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. You may turn it off in your Account Settings anytime.
Privacy Policy: https://pofudukgames.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://pofudukgames.com/terms-conditions

Your life. One app.

or medicine, or even need a personal assistant to run errands for you. Cari brings it all right to your doorstep in Kuwait. Think of us as your personal delivery hero – making more time
for the things you love.
Why You'll Love Cari:
• 30-MINUTE DELIVERY: Hungry or need something quick? Skip the wait and get it fast.
• UNLIMITED FREE DELIVERIES: Subscribe to Cari Unlimited and enjoy endless free deliveries and exclusive benefits. All of our restaurants are on Cari Unlimited! It’s the only subscription truly designed with foodies in mind.
• STRESS-FREE GROUP ORDERS: Ordering for the squad? We’ve got you covered with our easy Group Order feature.
• DAILY DEALS & NEW FLAVORS: Score special offers, and discover the freshest new restaurants daily.
• GET PAID TO EAT: That’s right! Earn cashback as you spend on limited offers and exclusive campaigns.
• BEYOND FOOD: New services such as Laundry, Fuel Up, CashDrop, House Keeping, Booking hotels, Booking flights and a Personal Assistant to help run any errand you might think of.
All the Loved Brands, Only a Tap Away:
In Kuwait:
• Burger Bliss: BBT, Thinnies, Johnny Rockets, Eighty Six, Beak, and more.
• Pizza Party: Pizza Hut, Yelo Pizza, Little Caesars Pizza, Caesar’s – need we say more?
• Sushi Sensations: Maki, Finger Sushi, Oishii Sushi, and beyond.
• Sweet Treats: UR Cookies, Melenzane, Marble Slab Creamery, and others.
• Local Legends: Tabel, Deboned, WK and more.
Cool Features You’ll Love:
• TRACK YOUR TREATS: Real-time order tracking so you know exactly when your delivery’s arriving.
• SAFE & SECURE PAYMENTS: Pay by credit card or cash on delivery - your choice.
• QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST: Fresh, high-quality meals and essentials delivered with a smile.
• GROUP ORDER GOODNESS: Simplify group dining with our seamless Group Order feature.
New Additions to Spice Things Up:
• Cari Unlimited: Available in Kuwait. Free delivery, exclusive discounts, and more!
• Personalized Picks: Discover top recommendations and local favorites tailored for you.
• Cari Cart: Transform your grocery shopping with our super convenient Cari Cart.

bluejetty:00184462:ios.description:
All calculators for cross stitch in one application.
The application helps embroiderers calculate the amount of materials needed for a new embroidery project, making planning faster and more accurate.
• Canvas calculator 
Allows you to determine the fabric size in centimeters or inches based on stitch count. 
Calculations support the most popular fabrics used for cross stitching.
• Muline calculator 
Helps calculate thread consumption for a specified number of stitches. 
The result may vary depending on embroidery technique, single crosses and stitching style. 
For more accurate results, a tolerance value can be applied.
• Stitches calculator 
Helps calculate the final embroidery size on the selected fabric for a given number of stitches in the pattern.
• Cost calculator 
Helps estimate how much a finished cross stitch project can cost based on the materials used.
Designed for cross stitchers, embroidery designers and needlework enthusiasts who want better planning, accurate calculations, and full control over their materials.

bluejetty:00015564:ios.summary:
Why should you join the countless Airmen who have already been promoted using this app? Read on...
1. PURCHASE ONCE, USE FOR A CAREER! PDG PROmote provides lifetime free updates. Why should you have to pay for a new app every time the stud
bluejetty:00015564:ios.description:
Why should you join the countless Airmen who have already been promoted using this app? Read on...
1. PURCHASE ONCE, USE FOR A CAREER! PDG PROmote provides lifetime free updates. Why should you have to pay for a new app every time the study guides are updated? You don’t pay $0.99 for these apps. You deserve lifetime updates. We know that your promotion is important to you but that doesn’t give us the right to take advantage of it. Should the Air Force resume testing for the SNCO ranks in the future, rest assured that we will include those ranks in the app too.
2. EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP! This app contains everything you need to prepare for your WAPS testing. We're serious. You never need to leave the app.
3. STUDY FOR THE SITUATIONAL JUDGMENT SECTION OF THE PFE! We've taken a different approach to help you prepare for the SJT. There are an unlimited number of situations you could encounter on the test. Instead of giving you scenarios you will not see on the exam, we teach you how to methodically think through any situation in order to pick the correct answer.
4. NOW WITH EPB SHIELD! You need to do more than score well on a test to get promoted in today's Air Force. EPB Shield helps you to track and evaluate your performance for your Enlisted Performance Brief.
5. ADAPTABLE TO EVERY LEARNING STYLE. Not everyone studies the same way. PDG PROmote provides all of the options you need to study in a manner that works best for you. Want to read the AFH 1 paragraphs? You can. Want to read condensed nuggets of information from AFH 1? You can. Want to study flashcard questions? You can. Want to study flashcard questions but with the answers always shown? You can. Want to listen to the slides, flashcards, or AFH 1 paragraphs on your way to work? You can. Want to listen and read at the same time? You can. Your mission is to master all the testable sections of AFH 1 and no other app offers you as many ways to do that.
6. JUST SIT BACK AND LISTEN. We made our audio even better. Sit back and listen to study slides, questions, and even AFH 1 paragraphs. Sure, it's synthetic audio but it’s a popular feature that many of our users use on their drive to and from work.
7. OUR SMART TESTS WILL SET YOU UP FOR SUCCESS. PDG PROmote knows which questions you have seen, answered correctly, gotten wrong, how many times you answered correctly, how many times you answered incorrectly, even how many consecutive times you answered a question correctly. It uses this information to always put the right questions in front of you on tests.
8. OPTIMIZE YOUR LIMITED STUDY TIME. You have a full-time job. We know you need to get the most out of your limited study opportunities. PDG PROmote makes it easy for you to maximize the effectiveness of your study sessions.
9. INTUITIVE DESIGN. PDG PROmote is simply the most intuitive and least frustrating AFH 1 study guide you will find. Experience the difference a great designed app can make.
10. OUR QUESTIONS ARE SIMPLY BETTER. Many of our users have commented to us that our questions aren't as simplistic as other apps. They make you think a little more. The actual exam seemed easier. PDG PROmote provides TOTAL COVERAGE of the AFH 1 based study guides.
PDG PROmote is an application aimed to prepare Airmen who are taking the Air Force Promotion Fitness Examination (PFE). Its sole source of reference is Air Force Handbook 1, dated 1 November 2024. Just select the appropriate study guide for the promotion grade that you are testing to and begin studying!

Welcome to Hole Rush – the ultimate black hole puzzle game where physics meets strategy and competition never stops.
Guide your hole through dynamic levels, devouring objects with satisfying physics to grow larger and dominate each challenge. Think strategically, move fast, and experience the most competitive hole game ever created.

Unique Game Modes:
- Melee Mode – Battle 3 players simultaneously! Swallow the most pieces and eat opponents whole for maximum points
- Key Hunt – Find hidden keys to unlock gates and discover secret areas in each level
- PVP Duels – Face opponents one-on-one in intense head-to-head battles
- Gem Frenzy – Race to collect sparkling gems in this fast-paced puzzle variant
- Clear the Board – Strategic gameplay where every piece matters
Core Features:
- Hundreds of brain-teasing puzzles with smooth, realistic physics
- Real-time multiplayer battles – no other hole game offers this intensity
- Global tournaments and daily competitive events
- Zen Mode for relaxing, oddly satisfying gameplay sessions
- Offline play – enjoy puzzle action anywhere
- Power-ups and tactical boosters for strategic advantage
What do our players say
- Perfectly tuned controls
- Satisfying physics
- Unmatched competitive depth
Whether you want to relax with zen puzzles or climb leaderboards in fierce PVP battles, Hole Rush delivers the most complete black hole experience.
Ready to dominate? Download Hole Rush and prove you're the ultimate Hole Master.

• Fast, smart, integrates many great add-ons,
bluejetty:00145590:ios.description:
RedApp Lite is a private browser, simply provides the fastest, most secure private browsing experience available and is especially more customizable than other private browsers.
Main features:
• Fast, smart, integrates many great add-ons, security and energy efficiency than other browsers.
• Search intelligently. Easily access shortcuts to search providers including Wikipedia, Twitter, YouTube, Amazon etc.
• Private browsing. Using Passcode/TouchID or FaceID protection helps you keep more privacy and security in your business.
• Tracking Protection. Let you identify advertisers and others who track your online behavior, and remove the cross‑site tracking data they leave behind.
• Privacy Protection. Be protected with leading privacy and security features such as HTTPS Everywhere (encrypted data traffic), script blocking, cookie blocking, and private tabs.
• Player Manager. You can play video links from YouTube, Vimeo while browsing. Play audio in background and without any annoying ads.
• Download Manager, File Manager and Sharing Manager. Let you download, manage files or links and share them to nearby devices. Use Wi-Fi or WebDAV sharing to let you transfer files directly to other nearby devices (mobile or PC).
• Widgets. Supports many useful widgets such as Calendar, Top Sites, Your Library, Video Meetings, Tracking Protection, Website Redirects, URL Shortcuts...
• Default Browser. From iOS 14, set RedApp Lite as your default browser! Select Settings - scroll down to select RedApp Lite - select RedApp Lite as the Default Browser App.
Additional Features:
• Appearance. Use system Light/Dark mode or choose a predefined theme.
• Theme Color. Change any text color you want.
• Toolbar Color. Select a color-coded predefined toolbar.
• Customize the toolbar. Allows adding or removing menu buttons.
• Address Bar. Displayed at Top or Bottom.
• Wallpapers. Set background image for New Tab.
• Allows customization of font-size.
• Reader Mode. Always on.
• Require Passcode/TouchID or FaceID when the screen is locked.
• Pop-up blocker.
• Saves battery and data.
• HTTPS everywhere (for security).
• Script blocking.
• Browsing history/Reading List/Bookmarks.
• Private tabs.
• Night Mode. Easily read in low light.
• Blocks cookie consent notifications by default.
• Use voice search in the browser.
• Import/export bookmarks to another browser.
AND you can explore other useful features in Settings.
RedApp Lite is a compact version of the RedApp browser. Therefore, if you want to experience all the other useful features, you can download RedApp here: https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/redapp-web-browser/id1409063862
Love the app? Rate us! Your feedback is music to our ears, and it helps us make RedApp Lite even better. Got a question? Please drop us a line at: mqmedia29@gmail.com

bluejetty:00152295:ios.description:
Introducing "Laundry Restock DIY," the ultimate organizing game designed to satisfy your organizational cravings and provide a soothing ASMR experience. Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of laundry management, restocking cleaning products, and creating a tidy haven for your customers. With its addictive my tidy life like gameplay and relaxing atmosphere, this game is perfect for all ages that are seeking both entertainment and tranquility.
In "Laundry Restock DIY," you step into the shoes of a professional laundry organizer. Your objective is to maintain a well-stocked laundry rush service while ensuring all tasks are completed efficiently and with meticulous attention to detail. As the game progresses, you'll face an increasing number of challenges that test your organizational skills, time management, and ability to multitask.
The game begins with an empty laundry room, waiting to be transformed into a spotless haven. Your first task is to restock the cleaning products, ensuring that you have an ample supply of detergent, fabric softener, and other essential items. Navigate through the in-game store to purchase supplies using the virtual currency earned from successfully completing laundry rush tasks.
Once your cleaning products are ready, it's time to dive into the heart of the game – organizing and washing clothes. Utilize your strategic planning skills to sort and fill the washing machines efficiently, ensuring that each load contains the right combination of garments. Be mindful of the different fabric types, colors, and wash settings to achieve the best results. The game offers a wide range of clothing items, from delicate lace lingerie to heavy denim jeans, providing a realistic laundry experience.
As you progress, the game presents new challenges to keep you engaged. You'll face time limits, demanding customers, and unexpected obstacles that put your organizing skills to the test. Additionally, the inclusion of special deep-cleaning tasks adds an extra layer of complexity and rewards meticulous attention to detail. Earn extra points and virtual currency by delivering flawless laundry, meeting customer demands, and exceeding their laundry rush expectations.
My tidy life has mesmerizing ASMR elements that make the game even more immersive. Immerse yourself in the calming sounds of water gently swishing and clothes rustling, creating a sensory experience that enhances the overall gameplay. The soothing ambiance combined with the satisfying feeling of organizing and completing tasks will keep you hooked for hours.
With its visually appealing graphics and intuitive controls, this newest game in the market delivers the most polished gaming experience. The game's user-friendly interface allows players to easily navigate through different sections, select laundry items, and interact with various in-game elements. Additionally, the inclusion of customizable laundry rooms and characters adds a personal touch, letting you create a unique space that reflects your style.
Step into the world organizing and unleash your organizational prowess. Experience the satisfaction of creating a deep clean and orderly environment, all while indulging in a soothing ASMR experience. Whether you're a fan of OCD games, My tidy life, or simply looking for a relaxing pastime, this game is the perfect companion for those seeking a harmonious blend of entertainment and tranquility. Install Laundry Restock today and embark on an organizational adventure that will captivate and relax your mind!

Peoples Bank of Kentucky – PBKY Mobile Banking 
Experience Banking at Your Fingertips
Our mobile banking app is designed to provide you with a seamless and convenient way to manage your finances on the go. Whether you’re checking your balance, paying bills, or transferring funds, our app offers a user-friendly interface that puts the power of banking in your hands. 
Key Features:
• Secure Login – Access your accounts with confidence using third-party security measures. 
• Account Overview – View your account balances, transaction history, and recent activity in real-time.
• Bill Pay – Easily pay bills directly from your app, scheduled recurring payments, and manage due dates. 
• Money Transfers – Send money to friends, family, or other accounts with Zelle.
• Mobile Check Deposit – Deposit checks safely and securely using your smartphone’s camera.
• Card Management – View your debit card information, set spending limits, and report it lost/stolen.
• Account Alerts – Receive notifications for important account activities, such as low balances, overdrafts, and successful transactions. 
• ATM Locator – Find the nearest Peoples Bank of Kentucky ATM location.
• Customer Service – Contact our friendly customer service team for assistance or inquiries.
Why Choose Our Mobile Banking App?
• Convenience – Manage your finances anytime, anywhere with your smartphone or tablet.
• Security – Rest assured that your personal information is protected by robust security measures.
• Ease of Use – Our intuitive interface makes it simple to navigate and find the features you need. 
• Time-Saving – Eliminate the need for trips to the bank by conducting most banking transactions through the app.
• Personalized Experience: Tailor the app to your preferences and receive relevant notifications. 
Get Started Today
Download our mobile banking app and experience the future of banking. With our app, you’ll have the flexibility and convenience to manage your finances on your terms. bluejetty:00142068:ios.description:
The BeMore app lets you control your hearing aids directly from your mobile device. You can change programs, and make simple or more advanced sound adjustments and save them as favorites. The app helps you learn what you can do and how to do it. It can even help you find your hearing aids if you lose them. Last, but not least, you can have your hearing care professional update your hearing aid programs and send you new hearing aid software without taking a trip to the clinic.
BeMore mobile device compatibility:
Please consult the BeMore app website for up-to-date compatibility information: www.gnhearing.com/guides/app-support
Use the BeMore app to: 
• Enjoy optimization anywhere with online services: Request help with your hearing aid settings from your hearing care professional and receive new settings and software updates. 
• Adjust volume settings on your hearing aids
• Mute your hearing aids
• Adjust volume of your streaming accessories
• Adjust speech focus as well as noise and wind-noise levels with Sound Enhancer (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
• Change manual and streamer programs
• Edit and personalize program names 
• Adjust treble, middle and bass tones to your preferences
• Save your preferred settings as a Favorite – you can even tag to a location
• Monitor the battery status of your rechargeable hearing aids
• Help locate lost or misplaced hearing aids
• Tinnitus manager: Adjust sound variation and frequency of the Tinnitus Sound Generator. Select Nature Sounds (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
For more information please visit the support website via the link in the app store.

bluejetty:00115367:ios.name: Nut Sort Blast: Color Puzzle
bluejetty:00115367:ios.summary: Nut Sort Blast – Stack, Spin, and Satisfy! The bolts are loose and the nuts (hardware nuts, not food!) are rolling! In Nut Sort Blast, your job is to organize colorful metal nuts, bolts, and screws by color and size across growing vertical
bluejetty:00115367:ios.description:
Nut Sort Blast – Stack, Spin, and Satisfy! The bolts are loose and the nuts (hardware nuts, not food!) are rolling! In Nut Sort Blast, your job is to organize colorful metal nuts, bolts, and screws by color and size across growing vertical rods. It's a relaxing yet brain-tickling puzzle game where every move brings you closer to the perfect stack—and maybe even unlocks a curious little critter watching from the shadows.
How to Play:
Tap to Sort: Move hardware nuts between rods until each one is sorted by color or shape. Only One Rule: A nut can only go on a nut of the same type—or an empty rod. Stack Smart: Use logic, not speed. No timers, no pressure. Finish a Stack: Complete stacks unlock surprises like new themes or adorable helpers.
Stack-tacular Features:
Dozens of Levels – Each level adds new twists, like locked rods, mixed shapes, or multi-tier stacks. Visual Customization – Change nut textures, bolt styles, rod designs, and backgrounds. Satisfying Feedback – Smooth animations, relaxing sounds, and tactile feedback that makes every drop feel good. Progress that Grows with You – Start simple and unlock complex challenges at your own pace. Daily Bonuses – Return each day to earn new critters, rod skins, or power-ups. Endless Zen Mode – Unlimited sorting for when you just want to unwind.
Build Your Dream Stack Lab:
Collect themed backgrounds like forest workshop, tech garage, or cozy attic. Customize your rods—wooden poles, neon pipes, or even rainbow coils. Track your critter collection and learn their quirky backstories.
Why You'll Love Nut Sort:
A uniquely tactile twist on the color sorting genre. Perfect balance of chill and challenge. Focus on real hardware nuts, bolts, and screws (not food!) Family-friendly and playable offline—great for on-the-go or bedtime relaxation. Regular content updates with seasonal themes and limited-edition critters.
Ready to Sort Like Never Before?
Download Nut Sort Blast – Stack & Shine now and turn chaos into calm, one hardware nut at a time. Your stack kingdom awaits—let's get screwing!

bluejetty:00080874:ios.name: Magic City Detective - Ocean
bluejetty:00080874:ios.summary: Dive into the thrilling world of "Magic City Detective: Wrath of the Ocean," where the supernatural and detective skills collide in an epic race against time. As an expert detective, you're faced with the most critical case of your career:
bluejetty:00080874:ios.description:
Dive into the thrilling world of "Magic City Detective: Wrath of the Ocean," where the supernatural and detective skills collide in an epic race against time. As an expert detective, you're faced with the most critical case of your career: finding Ribeira Lima, the ocean siren, before a tsunami devastates Rio. Ribeira is not just any siren; she's the key to calming the ocean with her magical singing. Unravel the mystery, navigate the intricate relationships among supernatural beings, and save the city from certain doom. Your sharp mind and keen senses are all that stand between Rio and the wrath of the ocean!
Shocking news: supernatural beings are living among us! Sometimes, however, they don't hide well enough. Ribeira Lima, the ocean siren, has become the public's favorite in Rio, but the audience never imagined that her role in their lives is much bigger. After all, she is the only one who knows how to soothe the ocean with her magical singing! But now the daughter of the ocean is gone, and there is no one to sing the Song of the Ocean. Meanwhile, an overwhelming tsunami is coming to Rio, ready to sweep away everything in its path. So, you're the only one who can find Ribeira and save the city! 
Engage in High-Stakes Deduction!
Use your detective skills to solve the kidnapping of Ribeira before the tsunami hits! Gather clues, piece together evidence, and make critical decisions under pressure. Explore diverse locations throughout Rio, each filled with hidden objects and puzzles.
Master the Art of Discernment!
Analyze faces and body language to uncover who among Ribeira’s friends is truly trustworthy! Use your intuition to navigate complex social dynamics and reveal hidden motives, engage in challenging dialogues where every choice impacts the outcome of your investigation.
Your Own Investigation!
Examine every clue at the crime scene to ensure all hidden objects are found! Collect unique items scattered throughout Rio, each telling a part of the larger story. Utilize forensic tools and techniques to uncover hidden evidence and solve intricate puzzles.
Supernatural Adventure!
Immerse yourself in a world where mythical beings walk among us, hiding secrets that only a skilled detective can uncover. Encounter a variety of supernatural entities, from sirens to other mystical creatures, each adding depth to the storyline!
Prepare for a heart-pounding journey that blends mystery, supernatural elements, and the urgency of a natural disaster. Can you uncover the truth and save Rio from the Wrath of the Ocean?
-----

Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00126687:ios.name: CASIO WATCHES
bluejetty:00126687:ios.summary:
CASIO WATCHES is the official comprehensive app that unlocks new ways to enjoy CASIO watches.
Using Bluetooth® technology to link to your CASIO watch, the app allows you to access a range of convenient functions via your smartphone, includ
bluejetty:00126687:ios.description:
CASIO WATCHES is the official comprehensive app that unlocks new ways to enjoy CASIO watches.
Using Bluetooth® technology to link to your CASIO watch, the app allows you to access a range of convenient functions via your smartphone, including time adjustment and world time settings. Keep up with the latest G-SHOCK and other CASIO brand information, and view exclusive CASIO content.
■ Major functions
‐ Home: Check the status of registered watches and your recent activity at a single glance
‐ My Watch: Register your watch to easily check its manual, or use Bluetooth connection to adjust its time settings, set alarms, and implement world time settings
‐ My Page: Monitor your daily activities by keeping track of data including calories burned, step counts, heart rate, and activity log
‐ Discover G-SHOCK: Exclusive content for G-SHOCK fans, including brand history and details of over 4,000 G-SHOCK models
‐ BADGE COLLECTIONS: Link the app with step tracker-equipped models, and receive CASIO original badges as rewards for hitting certain step count marks
‐ MY G-SHOCK: Customize and order your very own unique G-SHOCK!
‐ Latest Watch Information: Information pertaining to various CASIO brands, including G-SHOCK, BABY-G, EDIFICE,PRO TREK ,CASIO, and OCEANUS
■ Major Compatible Models
G-SHOCK: DW-H5600, GBD-H2000, GPR-H1000, GA-B2100, GBD-200, GMW-B5000
BABY-G: BSA-B100
EDIFICE: ECB-S10, ECB-2000, ECB-2200
PRO TREK: PRJ-B001
CASIO: ABL-100WE
OCEANUS: OCW-S7000, OCW-T6000, OCW-S400
etc. New products are always being added.
You can manage registered watches from “My Watch”. You can also view manuals.
*Bluetooth® compatibility and functionality differ by model. Please see each product’s page for more details.
Please see the following website for more details: https://www.casio.com/intl/watches/casio/app/
■ Compatible OS
iOS 16.0 or later
■ Notes
‐ A CASIO ID is required to use the app.
‐ This app is not guaranteed to work on every device.
‐ Even devices with a compatible OS may fail to operate or display the app depending on the device’s software version and display specifications.
‐ Bluetooth® functionality can be used with devices compatible with Bluetooth 4.0.

bluejetty:00034911:ios.description:
Find Your Vibe with Vibes – The Fun Way to Date!
Looking for a dating app that's less awkward and more awesome? Welcome to Vibes, where dating is a breeze and making new friends is a walk in the park! Join the party and discover what sets Vibes apart:
POLISH YOUR PROFILE
•⁠ ⁠Show off your best pics and craft a witty bio. Let your interests shine and be your amazing self.
•⁠ ⁠Vibes introduces you to a never-ending lineup of incredible people. Find your perfect match and get the conversation started!
SWIPE, MATCH, CONNECT
•⁠ ⁠It’s as easy as pie: Swipe right if you’re interested, and wait for that exciting match!
•⁠ ⁠Even if things don’t go as planned, you might just make a new friend or gain some valuable experience. Why not give it a try?
VERIFIED PROFILES
•⁠ ⁠We’re on a mission to keep our community free of harassment, bots, and fake profiles.
•⁠ ⁠At Vibes, we have zero tolerance for inappropriate behavior. If you ever run into a problem, reach out and we’ll help right away!
TOTALLY FREE TO USE
•⁠ ⁠Yes, you read that right! Vibes is 100% free, and we mean it.
•⁠ ⁠Enjoy unlimited swipes, endless messaging, and the ability to boost your profile for more matches—all without spending a dime.
•⁠ ⁠Earn free credits by inviting friends, completing quick tasks, or simply logging in daily.
REASONABLE SUBSCRIPTIONS
•⁠ ⁠Want to stand out from the crowd? Check out our optional subscriptions.
•⁠ ⁠While Vibes will always be free at its core, a subscription helps you shine even brighter. And don’t worry—we’re listening to your feedback to keep pricing fair!
JOIN THE VIBES
•⁠ ⁠Don’t be shy! Create your profile, start swiping, and have some fun conversations with your matches.
•⁠ ⁠You never know what exciting adventures await—whether it’s a great date or finding someone to share your journey.
SPECIAL THANKS
•⁠ ⁠Vibes is a work in progress, and your feedback is like gold to us. It helps us create a safe, fun, and engaging dating experience.
•⁠ ⁠Share your thoughts in the review section or reach out to us at support@vibes.chat. We appreciate you!
PRICE VARIES BY COUNTRY
•⁠ ⁠The cost of our service may change depending on where you are, but you'll always see the exact price in the app.
Terms of Use (https://vibes.chat/terms/)
Privacy Policy (https://vibes.chat/privacy-policy/)

bluejetty:00145541:ios.name: Oxytone
bluejetty:00145541:ios.summary: Are you ready for a unique adventure like no other? Oxytone invites you to explore the depths of your mind while offering a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life for those seeking relaxation. For more determined player
bluejetty:00145541:ios.description:
Are you ready for a unique adventure like no other? Oxytone invites you to explore the depths of your mind while offering a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life for those seeking relaxation. For more determined players, there are 99 challenges, colorful themes to unlock, and 12 meticulously designed maps. Oxytone is the ultimate puzzle game, equally easy to learn and challenging to master.
Strive for the highest scores by creating the longest paths and achieving impressive combinations. Every move matters, and success depends on strategy and planning. You can discard tiles that don't fit your plan, but this reduces your pool of available tiles. To refresh it, you must fill tiles by guiding paths through them six times, deepening the mechanics further.
Sound is an integral part of Oxytone, so I recommend playing with headphones. This will immerse you even deeper into the game. The sound design has been crafted with great care to create a unique and relaxing atmosphere, yet it can also deliver powerful moments when needed.

Yuzu is a learning platform that lets you read and interact with digital content from the convenience of your iPad or iPhone.
BENEFITS OF eTEXTBOOKS ON YUZU
Interactive Learning - eTextbooks can include videos and other multimedia content and links to related websites, to make the learning experience richer and more engaging.
Travel Lighter - Replace multiple textbooks with one app where you can access your course materials from a single, beautifully organized interface.
Read On-the-Go - With course materials always at your fingertips, you can read and study wherever you are. Highlights, notes, and bookmarks automatically sync across all of your devices.
Study Smarter - You can highlight and add notes to your eTextbooks. Plus, you can easily adjust the layout, font size, and zoom to make reading easier.
Simple Navigation - Search keywords, phrases, and figures throughout all of your digital content. Quickly jump to a location by typing a page number.
Features
* Create highlights, notes, and bookmarks. Your changes are automatically saved and made available to all of your apps.
* Search for keywords, phrases, or figures.
* Navigate using the Table of Contents.
* Jump to a location by page number.
• Listen to your books and learn on the go with Read Aloud. 
* Zoom fixed format content or adjust the layout and fonts with reflowable content.
* Download your digital content for later reading and adding notes while offline.

bluejetty:00187773:ios.name: FieldVibe: Field Service App
bluejetty:00187773:ios.summary: Run your field service business without paying for software you’ll never use. FieldVibe gives solo pros a free-forever plan to schedule unlimited jobs, cut no-shows with text reminders, capture leads with a free website, and build trust wit
bluejetty:00187773:ios.description:
Run your field service business without paying for software you’ll never use. FieldVibe gives solo pros a free-forever plan to schedule unlimited jobs, cut no-shows with text reminders, capture leads with a free website, and build trust with client reviews. 
Need quotes, invoices or crew tools? Affordable plans are ready when you are.
KEY FEATURES:
• JOB SCHEDULING
Schedule visits, assign technicians, prevent double bookings, and manage recurring work from a clean and simple calendar built for service pros.
• JOB DETAILS & VISIT TRACKING
Create jobs from quotes, track tasks, attach before-and-after photos, and collect client signatures. Track time and revenue, and easily export jobs to PDF.
• AUTOMATED TEXT MESSAGES
Reduce client no-shows. Send your clients confirmations, reminders and follow-up messages automatically. Customize the templates to fit the needs of your business.
• CLIENT MANAGEMENT & HISTORY
See all client photos, notes, quotes, invoices, and jobs in one clear, aggregated view.
• PRICE BOOK
Save time by defining standard services and products once, then add these pre-set items straight into your quotes, jobs and invoices in seconds.
• BUSINESS WEBSITE
Showcase your business info, services, photos and 5-star reviews on a mobile-friendly site built to get you found on Google.
• WORK REQUESTS
Let clients submit job requests through your website so you never miss a local lead.
• QUOTING & ESTIMATING
Win more jobs with professional quoting. Add services, taxes, discounts, and deposits, and get notified when a client views or approves a quote.
• INVOICING & PAYMENTS
Create professional invoices instantly. Send invoices by email or text, accept online payments, and get paid faster.
• TAP TO PAY ON iPHONE
Accept contactless credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and digital wallets right on your iPhone without carrying extra card readers.
• CLIENT REVIEWS & MARKETING
Collect feedback after completed jobs and use Apple Intelligence text generation to effortlessly post your best ratings on social media.
• STAFF SCHEDULING
Dispatch jobs to team members, and use permissions so they only see what they need, protecting sensitive business information.
BUILT FOR HOME SERVICE PROS:
• Lawn care & landscaping
• House cleaning & maid services
• Plumbing, HVAC & electrical
• Handyman & appliance repair
• Pest control & pool service
PRICING:
SOLO (FREE)
• Unlimited jobs & clients
• Business website
• Work requests
• Recurring visits
• Manual tap-to-send text reminders
• Client review collection
SOLO PRO ($20/mo)
Everything in Solo +
• Quotes
• Invoicing
• Online Payments
• Automated text reminders & customizable templates
• Time tracking, job extras and simple business reports
CREWS ($50/mo)
Everything in Solo Pro + 
• Unlimited staff members
• Roles & permissions
No contracts. No hidden fees.
Payment Policy: Subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID account and auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in your Apple ID Account Settings.
Terms and conditions: https://www.fieldvibe.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://www.fieldvibe.com/privacy-policy

- Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00041805:ios.description:
The Official Facial Recognition App!
AI Face Scan is your ultimate tool for exploring the web through photos. Developed by Persist Ventures, this AI-powered app helps you uncover the online presence of people with just a single image. Ever wondered where a photo might appear online? AI Face Scan does the work for you, scanning the web for websites and links that may feature similar images. bluejetty:00015373:ios.description:
2,000+ Learning Activities with No Ads
Our interactive educational app provides a well-rounded curriculum that helps build key developmental skills. Designed by educators and built by the leading brand in learning for kids, LeapFrog Academy™ provides learning games for kids ages 3, 4, 5 and 6 years old that explore a variety of skills that are important to development.
Log in to your existing account or sign up for this learning app and get a 1 Month FREE trial. The program includes more than 2,000 of our best eBooks, games, puzzles and videos.
Each Learning Adventure provides a well-rounded curriculum that includes traditional school subjects blended with life skills like creativity, problem solving and social-emotional skills.
• Reading & Writing – Early reading, language and spelling skills build a critical foundation for learning. Become confident readers with lessons in the ABCs, syllables, uppercase and lowercase letters and rhymes.
• Math – Skills like counting, comparing and sorting help young learners think critically and solve problems to challenge them at the right level.
• Science – Explore scientific concepts including STEM skills, life cycles, human body, simple machines, observations and more.
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving – Develops memory and planning skills by exercising logic and reasoning.
• Creativity – A strong foundation of music and art help children in their ability to create and imagine.
• Health & Feelings – Strong social and emotional skills allow children to develop and engage with learning that they can bring to their daily lives.
LeapFrog Academy™ Key Features:
• More than 2,000 learning activities including eBooks, games, puzzles, videos, music and art across a variety of Learning Adventures that become more advanced as your child progresses.
• My Learning Lab, which provides extra activities that offer additional practice in subjects your child needs help mastering or more difficult activities designed to keep them challenged.
• Earn rewards by collecting marbles or completing lessons. Rewards include clothes, accessories, pets or pieces for their Collection.
• Up to 5 child profiles included with your subscription.
• The Parent Dashboard lets you choose and change your kid’s Learning Adventure and see what activities are offered in My Learning Lab. It also lets you see how your child is progressing, view your account, manage each profile and more.
• No Wi-Fi, no problem! Play most of your favorite activities by adding up to 24 of them to your Favorites. Then, continue to play your favorite games without an internet connection.
• Also includes access to the LeapFrog Streaming Video Library. Learn about the alphabet, letter sounds, word-building, numbers, shapes and much more.
LeapFrog Academy™ learning app is a safe environment for children. There’s no advertising or ability for an external party to contact your child.
Terms and Conditions: www.leapfrog.com/terms-academy
Privacy Policy: www.leapfrog.com/privacypolicy
Subscription Details:
Upon downloading the app, choose your subscription plan and activate a 1-Month free trial. Cancel any time from your iTunes account and enjoy the app until your subscription plan ends.
• While the app is free to download, one of three subscription plans is required to access the program. Choose from the following plans to get started:
 • Monthly Plan: $7.99/month
 • 6-Month Plan: $39.99 every 6 months
 • 12-Month Plan: $69.99 every 12 months
• FREE 1 Month trial starts after you sign up for the subscription
• Subscription fee will be charged on the first day following the 1-Month free trial and will be charged to your iTunes account
• Subscription is automatically renewed at the end of each billing period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period
• Subscription can be managed at any time via your iTunes account
• If you have any questions, visit www.leapfrog.com/support

bluejetty:00097183:ios.description:
MaxBeauty is a personal beauty and wellness app designed to make self-care simple, clear, and consistent.
Build a routine that supports how you look and feel — with guided morning and evening rituals including facial massage, breathing exercises, meditations, skin progress tracking and AI Assistant in one place.
MaxBeauty is designed for people who want a more complete approach to self-care: not just skincare, not just exercises, but daily care that connects your face, habits, stress levels, and consistency.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH MAXBEAUTY
Follow daily content
Open new content every day and build a steady self-care rhythm with short, guided lessons and practices.
Start morning and evening routines
Follow video routines with facial massage, fascia release exercises, and relaxing self-care practices designed for different moments of the day.
Relax with breathing exercises and meditation
Use breathing exercises and meditations to slow down, reset, and return to yourself during the day.
Ask the AI Assistant
Get help building a beauty routine that fits your goals, habits, and preferences. Get personalized help about routines, facial care, product use, ingredients, and daily care choices.
Track your skin state
Use the FaceIQ scanner to analyze visible skin condition, review tension patterns over time, and get an AI summary that helps you understand what to focus on next.
Explore topics you care about
Look through by concern, target area, or topic. Find lessons, routines, meditations, breathing exercises, and beauty guidance based on what you want to work on.
Recommended skincare products
Discover product suggestions for morning and evening routines, with simple guidance on how they may fit into your care plan.
Save favorites to your Shelf
Keep liked video guides and recommended products in one place, so your favorite routines and beauty items are easy to find.
WHY MAXBEAUTY
• Daily self-care structure
• Face-focused beauty routines
• FaceIQ scanner and progress tracking
• Breathing and meditation practices
• AI Assistant
• Beauty lessons and targeted topics
• Skincare recommendations*
• A holistic approach to self-care and wellness
HOW IT WORKS
Download MaxBeauty and complete a short onboarding. Based on your goals and preferences, MaxBeauty helps you build a daily beauty and wellness experience with personalized routines, AI Assistant, FaceIQ scanner, skin progress tracking and self-care practices.
MaxBeauty is not a medical app. Content and tools are provided for informational and educational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you have questions about a medical condition, product interaction, or skin concern, please consult a qualified healthcare provider or dermatologist.
Terms of Use: https://themaxbeauty.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://themaxbeauty.com/privacy-policy
Support: support@themaxbeauty.com
*Please note, MaxBeauty does not sell physical products

listings.name: Engage-Global
listings.description:
With the Engage Global app, you can easily share your way to success with digital tools that create word of mouth buzz and complement belly to belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials, videos, social assets, and more all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.

Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you've shared and contact actions.

Media: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You'll receive a notification when contacts view a tool so you know exactly when to follow up! No data connection? No problem! Simply download content in the app beforehand for offline playback.

Samples: There’s no better way than samples to allow prospects to experience your products and the benefits they deliver. Leverage the power of digital and physical with the ability to send product samples directly to prospects. Users receive notifications to help them follow up, and recipients receive emails to help educate them. Site visitors also have the ability to request a sample. Simple and powerful!

Feed: Keep track of everything you’ve shared and see what your contacts have viewed with notifications. You can even swipe notifications to mark them as a Reminder. News also brings all of the latest announcements and social posts from corporate straight to you in one convenient place!

Business: Access helpful links to build your business. 

Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your 'why' in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business. You can also configure notifications, watch Quick Tips to learn about the app, and more.

bluejetty:00068630:ios.summary: With AppLocker you can password protect individual apps on your iPhone and iPad - all at once or one at a time. It works with any app, Facebook, Photos, Tinder, Mail or banking and financial apps. You can also unlist apps from your device.
bluejetty:00068630:ios.description:
With AppLocker you can password protect individual apps on your iPhone and iPad - all at once or one at a time. It works with any app, Facebook, Photos, Tinder, Mail or banking and financial apps. You can also unlist apps from your device.
Stop worrying about your privacy when you lend your phone or tablet to a friend, colleague or family member. No one will mess with your important apps anymore. Just start AppLocker, configure a password and select the apps you want to keep private.
FEATURES
• Block access to applications that you want private and avoid sneak peeks from friends, family members or co-workers (all at once or individually)
• Emergency Password: create a fake password that hides the entire configuration making the app look empty
• Lock Screen & Control Center actions, Shortcuts and Automation full support
• No one can use or see the content without entering the password first
• It works with any app installed on your phone: social, chat and dating apps, business apps, banking or financial apps
• AppLocker will protect you by using a secret password and optionally Face or Touch ID. Keep your important apps safe, including removal protection
• Private gallery: keep secret files, photos or videos
• Private notes: keep secret notes
• Easy to use, no configuration required. Also works great as a self control or parental system
We read your support emails every day, day by day.
Write with confidence any question, feedback or complaint and you will receive an answer in a very short period of time.
We offer two auto-renewing subscription and a one time payment option:
• Basic, a 1 Month subscription
• Premium, a 12 Months subscription
• Lifetime access: one time payment only
Prices may vary by location.
Subscriptions will auto-renew unless canceled.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Setting after purchase.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal for the amount of your current subscription within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. All cost for subscriptions are mentioned above.
Privacy Policy
https://alexdenk.eu/subscriptions-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use

bluejetty:00182652:ios.description:
Rush Rally 3 is the most realistic rally simulation on your mobile.
CONSOLE QUALITY RALLYING 
60fps racing at night or day in the rain or snow! Over 72 new and unique stages each with different surface types including snow, gravel, tarmac and dirt! Race with one of the best car dynamics models to date, including real time vehicle deformation and damage, built from over 15 years experience.
WORLD RALLY RACING!
Take on the new Career mode, race A-B stages over a Single Rally or grind metal to metal with other cars in Rally Cross.
LIVE EVENTS
Compete in weekly events against other players all over the world on a unique selection of tracks!
BUILD YOUR GARAGE
Upgrade, tune and customise a garage full of cars. Use the new livery editor to completely change the look of your vehicles. Buy new wheels and upgrades to make each car truly unique.
COMPETE WITH FRIENDS, MULTIPLAYER AND OFFLINE!
Real-Time multiplayer, Social Leaderboards and Ghost Racing allow you to race any player at anytime. See how you compare with the worlds best.
OPTIMISED CONTROLS!
A fully customisable control system designed specifically for touch and tilt devices means racing becomes more fun and consistent. Place the controls where you want them! Also includes full support for all MFi controllers

bluejetty:00120691:ios.description:
Typography Insight is a toolkit for learning & teaching typography, designed for those who love type. You can learn about historically important typefaces, observe and compare them. 
● Fast Company - "It's more like an exquisite museum exhibit than a musty textbook." “Anyone who loves books, words, history, or fine art — even in the slightest bit — will find Typography Insight as intoxicating as Wikipedia and as fun as a video game.” 
● The Atlantic - "Learning the subtleties of Helvetica and Garamond used to be a pain—but a sleek new app has made the process easier" "Typography Insight: iPad App Teaches Fonts Like Never Before"
● Gizmodo - "Typography Insight is sort of like an iPad typeface encyclopedia. Only encyclopedias are boring, and Typography Insight is beautiful and fun." "Typography Insight Makes Learning Fonts Gorgeous and Easy"
“Turned on by serifs and stems? Then you’ll love Typography Insight. Very slick, very informative.”
“This is like taking a beautiful coffee-table book and making it interactive.”
Features
● Juxtaposing Comparison: Understand the detail differences between the typefaces with side by side comparison
● Overlaying Comparison: Compare two typefaces by overlaying on top of each other
● Type inspector: Observe the detail shapes of typefaces such as serif, counter, and ear in very large scale, with pinch and pan gesture
● Basics: Learn about the basics of typography and simple tips for making a readable page
● Typeface Anatomy: Learn about the elements and terminologies of typefaces
● Historical typefaces: Understand different characteristics of historically important typefaces
● Custom Font Support: Access system and downloaded fonts using the native iOS System Font Picker. 
● System font library support: Observe and compare all iOS system fonts

1. TÌM SẢN PHẨM & TƯ VẤN DỄ DÀNG
 • Chat với Dược sĩ: Chụp hình đơn hàng hoặc sản phẩm gửi ngay cho Dược sĩ để được tư vấn chính xác và tìm đúng sản phẩm bạn cần.
 • Mua sắm đa dạng: Hàng ngàn sản phẩm Thực phẩm chức năng, Dược mỹ phẩm & Thiết bị y tế chính hãng.
2. TIÊM CHỦNG LONG CHÂU
 • Đặt hẹn chủ động: Chủ động đăng ký vắc xin và chọn ngày tiêm mong muốn tại trung tâm gần nhất, giảm thiểu thời gian làm thủ tục.
 • Sổ tiêm chủng điện tử: Theo dõi lịch sử và nhắc lịch tiêm tự động.
3. TRỢ LÝ MẸ & BÉ
 • AI Kể chuyện: Công nghệ AI tái tạo giọng nói, kể chuyện giúp bé ngủ ngon và gắn kết cảm xúc.
 • Theo dõi phát triển: Công cụ ghi lại chiều cao, cân nặng và các cột mốc vận động của con yêu theo chuẩn WHO.
4. ĐẶC QUYỀN THÀNH VIÊN
 • Giao hàng miễn phí siêu tốc: Đặc quyền giao nhanh và miễn phí vận chuyển cho đơn hàng từ 0đ.
 • Tích điểm đổi quà: Tích lũy điểm thưởng trên mọi đơn hàng để nhận ưu đãi hấp dẫn.
HỖ TRỢ & LIÊN HỆ 
Đội ngũ Long Châu luôn sẵn sàng lắng nghe bạn:
 • Hotline: 1800 6928 (08h00 - 22h00)
 • Website: nhathuoclongchau.com.vn & tiemchunglongchau.com.vn
Lưu ý: Thông tin trong ứng dụng chỉ mang tính tham khảo, không thay thế lời khuyên, chẩn đoán hay điều trị y tế chuyên nghiệp. Vui lòng tham khảo ý kiến Bác sĩ/Chuyên gia y tế đủ trình độ trước khi đưa ra bất kỳ quyết định liên quan đến sức khỏe của bạn.

bluejetty:00130194:ios.description:
Looking for a birthday planner or maybe you need a wedding or anniversary organizer? Our event planner is what you need! TopEvent is a simple app for planning any holidays.
Keep track of important tasks, manage guest list, control event budget, etc. Such sections of the app as Checklist, Guests, Budget, Schedule will help you with this.
KEEP TRACK OF TASKS
Add tasks and track their progress. Group tasks into categories or divide them into subtasks. Event planner will remind you of upcoming purchases or meetings.
MANAGE GUEST LIST
Make a list of guests and companions. Divide guests into groups and tables, plan menus. Our party planner will help you analyze everything: gender, age, RSVPs, invitations, attending…
CONTROL EXPENSES
Specify an event budget, generate expenses and mark upcoming payments. TopEvent will optimize the budget of the party and will tell you how to save money!
MANAGE VENDOR LIST
Make a list of vendors with contacts and other information. Planner will help you make the right choice and control the costs.
FOLLOW THE PLAN
Create a schedule for the event day and keep track of each milestone. The app will verify that everything goes according to plan.
PLAN EVENT TOGETHER
Join helpers and organize your event with friends. Manage your event with different devices and accounts. Your data will be synced instantly!
EVENT COUNTDOWN
Install beautiful widgets and track the days until the event.
And that's not all… There are many more features in the app that will simplify the preparation for any holidays: wedding, bachelorette and bachelor party, anniversary, birthday, Christmas party or any business events.
Event planning's never been so easy! Install the app and see for yourself!

Terms of Use: https://topevent.app/legal/terms_of_use/

bluejetty:00161228:ios.description:

bluejetty:00041223:ios.description:
Top rated fitness app for women by Niki Zoumpouli and Rauvé Haley. Home and gym workouts designed for women of all fitness levels.
Join over 200,000 women seeing real results with The Good Fitness App, free to download and packed with everything you need to stay consistent and see progress, including:
• Better Booty Program 1–4
• Mom Body Program 1 & 2
• Busy Woman Program
• Standardized Meal Plans
• Cardio and Warm-Up Guides
• Progress Tracker
Better Booty Program 1–4
A progressive glute and full-body training series designed for women of all shapes and fitness levels. Each phase includes home and gym options, fat loss and muscle gain meal plans, and weekly guidance to help you stay on track and continue progressing.
Mom Body Program 1 & 2
Our bestselling postpartum recovery programs, built to support moms through healing, strength rebuilding, and healthy fat loss after pregnancy. Includes structured workouts, a core rehabilitation guide, and tailored meal plans for both breastfeeding and non-breastfeeding mothers.
Message from our Coaches:
“We built this app to help women become the happiest, healthiest, and most confident version of themselves.”
Niki and Rauvé
Download The Good Fitness App today, it’s free to get started.
