bluejetty:00176707:ios.description:
DietSensor will help you discover the principles for permanent weight loss validated by nutrition science and explained by our AI based dietitian
Are you looking for a nutrition solution to permanently manage your weight, gain muscle or manage a health problem? You will discover and apply principles unknown to the public and even contrary to the beliefs conveyed by the weight loss industry
***
VISIT OUR WEBSITE TO SEE ALL OUR APPS
Weight Loss, Intermittent Fasting, Keto, Sports Nutrition, Diabetes, Nash, Oncology, Cardiology, Epilepsy
***
● 1. Drastically restricting calories and exercising more has been shown to always fail in the long run. For permanent weight loss, 80% of your progress will come from your food choices. Sport will be optional, but not mandatory!
● 2. Make meals compatible with your long-term lifestyle with the help of IA, without unsustainable deprivation or starving yourself. Occasional excesses are not only allowed but mandatory with DietSensor which is also a scientifically proven truth to prevent metabolism slow down!
● 3. Reprogram your metabolism by intelligently using your hormones to trigger the unloading of body fat. Learn about your blood sugar levels and how to adjust the spike in blood sugar after meals which drives insulin, the fat storage hormone. DietSensor will allow you to see this peak before eating and to correct it! You will be able to create ideal meals aimed at fueling your body and not storing body fat! 
● 4. Our AI based coach will let you know the foods to eat according to your weight goal. Unlike light, bland and boring diets, you will be able to eat your preferred natural, tasty and nutritious foods, such as meat, eggs, cheese or even chocolate.
● 5. To help you create the meal perfectly suited to your weight goal, the app can provide suggestions for your next meal, pre-established meal plans as well as your shopping list for coming meals.
● 6. You will have indications on the food quantities to maximize chances that your metabolism acts effectively towards the weight you are aiming for.
DIETSENSOR ADAPTS TO YOUR OBJECTIVE
● Do you want to lose weight? Instead of following a restrictive diet, DietSensor creates an ultra-personalized program based on your profile and food preferences.
● Do you practice intermittent fasting? You probably want to know what to eat after fasting, the app will guide you.
● Need to develop your muscle mass? Calculate your personal protein needs and eat the right amount with our suggestions.
● Need to control blood sugar spikes after meals, whether you have diabetes or not? Analyze your own meals with the app to anticipate your blood sugar spike. The app tells you how to reduce spikes before you eat (>iOS 16).
● Need to make the right food choices to reduce your bad cholesterol, your hypertension or the side effects of chemotherapy? DietSensor was designed with doctors and dieticians for this purpose.
HEALTH APP
● Connect the Apple Health app and import your weight and exercise automatically. Export your meals
AWARDS
● Voted the most innovative App in the world at CES 2016
● Second place in the Publicis90 global innovation competition
PRICES & TERMS OF USE
To use the application, you will need to subscribe to one of the PREMIUM packages. We offer several subscription options with automatic renewal.
Payment will be billed to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase or at the end of the trial period if there is one. The subscription will renew automatically unless automatic renewal is stopped at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period. Renewal will not result in a cost increase. Manage your subscriptions after purchase in your Account Settings
See Terms of use (EULA): https://www.dietsensor.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00165161:ios.description:
Welcome everyone to participate in the screw tightening competition. The goal of the game is to rearrange the screws in the spare holes to make all the iron plates fall off
Each level has different layouts and screw positions, requiring players to find the best solution within a limited number of steps
Players need to carefully observe the relationship between the iron plate and screws, adjust and rotate the screws, find the points that affect the entire structure, and reconnect them
Every time a screw is turned, it may affect the position of other screws, and players must consider the consequences of each step
By challenging different levels, players can improve their problem-solving skills, spatial imagination, and creativity

bluejetty:00170699:ios.description:
Choose your truck and deliver cargo across the country, East to West Coast! The timely delivery is all in your hands, can you do it? 
This idle truck simulator game allows you to choose your path - where do you want to go? Build routes, collect trucks, earn coins, and become the tycoon! 
EPIC TRUCKING QUEST
Jump into the life of a truck driver in this sim, and carry goods across the USA in awesome American trucks. Boost your trucks to get better speed, comfort, and gas mileage. Finish jobs to grab rewards and push ahead in the game, expanding your empire with every task.
TACKLE SURPRISING CHALLENGES
Get ready for unexpected twists and turns on the path to your empire across the country. With a map in hand, you'll move through different scenes and deal with challenges like icy roads, heavy traffic, and blocked paths. This idle sim makes you think on your feet!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR RIDE
Select your driver from a lineup of characters perfect for the job in this tycoon adventure. Dress them up in various outfits and gear, and choose your cargo, each needing a special way to be moved and delivered. Your choices craft the story of your trucking empire.
Jump into this truck sim with its cute retro pixel art! Drive, explore, and enjoy the thrill of building your empire. In this idle tycoon game, strategize and grow, leaving your mark across towns and the country. Every decision counts towards becoming the top truck idle empire tycoon.

bluejetty:00073006:ios.description:
Photo Vault – Your Phone’s Real Private Mode
Take control of your privacy like never before.
Photo Vault is an all-in-one secure vault designed to protect the most personal parts of your digital life. Hide and lock your photos, videos, passwords, notes, contacts, documents, emails, reminders, and voice memos in one private space, protected by Face ID or passcode.
Your phone holds more than files.
It holds your memories, relationships, thoughts, and identity.
Photo Vault keeps them truly private.
All-in-One Private Vault
With Photo Vault, you can securely store and lock:
- Photos & Videos – Keep private moments out of your gallery
- Passwords – Store login details safely in one place
- Notes – Lock personal thoughts and sensitive notes
- Contacts – Hide selected contacts
- Emails – Secure important and sensitive emails
- Documents – Protect IDs, contracts, bills, and files
- Screenshots – Hide sensitive screenshots instantly
- Reminders – Keep personal reminders private
- Voice Memos – Lock private recordings
Everything stays hidden, organized, and accessible only to you.
Built-In Password Manager
Stop saving passwords in unsafe places.
Photo Vault includes a secure password vault that lets you store usernames and passwords in one protected location. Access them quickly when you need them, always locked behind Face ID or passcode.
No syncing. No cloud exposure.
Just secure, on-device protection.
Private Incognito Browser
Browse the internet without leaving a trace.
- No browsing history
- No tracking
- No records saved
Your searches stay private, exactly as they should.
Advanced Security Protection
Your vault cannot be opened without authentication.
- Face ID and secure passcode protection
- App stays locked when closed
- Your private content remains hidden even if someone uses your phone
Simple and Powerful Organization
Privacy should be easy.
- Clean and modern interface
- Separate sections for every content type
- Create folders to organize your private files
- Fast, smooth, and intuitive experience
100% On-Device Privacy
Your data never leaves your phone.
- No cloud uploads
- No external servers
- No data sharing
- No remote access
Everything you store in Photo Vault stays locally on your device.
Why Choose Photo Vault
- More than a photo locker
- True all-in-one private vault
- Designed for real life, not just photos
- Built with privacy at the core
- Clean, premium, Apple-style experience
Whether you want to protect memories, personal information, or your digital privacy, Photo Vault is your safe space.
Photo Vault Premium
Upgrade to Photo Vault Premium to unlock full access to all features and enjoy an ad-free experience.
Premium gives you unlimited secure storage, full access to all vault categories, and maximum privacy protection.
Stop worrying about who might see your private content.
Enjoy complete peace of mind.
Your Privacy. Your Control.
Download Photo Vault today and turn your phone into a truly private place.
Legal
All content stored in Photo Vault is 100% private and stored only on your device. We do not upload, collect, or access your files.
Subscription payments will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://thepbstudios.co/privacy/
EULA: https://www.thepbstudios.co/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00069235:ios.description:
This app allows user to take photos and videos at lower resolution and even custom resolution down to 20x20 pixels!
You can also batch compress upto 50 photos in one click.
Save massive space on videos and photos!
Sometimes we want to capture very small sized video to quickly send to other people for various reasons including but not limited to:
- Debugging
- Quick preview
- Save storage space
- LoFi for fun
- Quick sharing on social media.
- Different picture / video dimensions.
- Option to save both high res and low res copies of the same image.
- Option to preserve timestamp after converting image or video.
Preset resolutions:
120p - 120 x 160 ~ 0.02 MP (megapixels)
240p - 240 x 320 ~ 0.08 MP
360p - 360 x 480 ~ 0.17 MP
480p - 480 x 640 ~ 0.3 MP
720p - 720 x 1280 ~ 0.9 MP
Other Features
- Choose lower audio quality or no audio at all.
- Save to custom folder.
- Batch conversion of up to 50 images / videos at once.
- One click conversion.
E.g. I sometime just want to report a problem to my developers about some issue with an app, and i really don't need 4K or Full HD for that...
I want LOWER resolutions.

bluejetty:00070141:ios.description:
Sevelina is here - sparkle her now! With brand new dressup game you never seen before, modern and fashion interface for endless variations of dress up and makeover. You can continuously try variations of skin colors and hair style. The way you can select it is better then ever, simply scroll and swipe it. Same with the hair style, endless scrolling of hair type will give the best result. Once you over with hairstyle you can make an awesome makeover. Just click the makeover icon to zoom the face. Isn’t it much better? Select eyelashes, shadows, cosmetics, blush and lipstick. Don’t limit yourself, try everything in this make over. Еye glitter is the “must have” now. Tons of various glitter you can apply in this makeover which look gorgeous. Apply it carefully around the eyes, check it while the eyes are open and the they closed. Make it compatible with the texture of the blush, make it exactly as it needed, do not put more than it is necessary if you not wish them to drop you your dress, in other word, don’t be greedy with glitter, be wise. Once you finish with the makeover you can continue with the dressup.
By the way, can you hear this awesome music, this is the mood you should follow while playing this game. Dress, all types of dress, easy to put on, easy to take off, some of them are the latest trend of fashion collections. 
Since the dressup is ready you can now think about accessories. What else if not bag can be better. Leather bags, fabric bags, bags with diamonds. After the bags you can try on some jewelries: earrings pendants necklaces, made from diamond, silver and gold or other precious stones. 
There are some secret moments in this game, unlock them and you will see more variation from Sevelina. Download it once and play anywhere even without internet. Save you screenshots with your success. Share it with friends.

Hareeg 14: The Ultimate Multiplayer Elimination Card Game!

bluejetty:00039481:ios.description:
Hareeg 14: The Ultimate Multiplayer Elimination Card Game!
Join OVER A MILLION players in the most thrilling, fast-paced, and competitive Hareeg experience available! Dive into the classic elimination card game you love, fully loaded with premium features, vibrant social connectivity, and the ultimate online community.
Outsmart, Meld, and Eliminate!
Can you be the last player standing? In Hareeg 14, four or more players battle it out in a tense game of strategy and survival. Your goal is simple: reduce the cards in your hand by melding them to the table based on specific rules, trap your opponents with high points, and eliminate them from the game. It’s easy to learn, but incredibly deeply strategic to master!
Why Hareeg 14 is the #1 Card Game Choice:
A Universe of Hareeg: Three Thrilling Game Modes!
Whether you want a quick match or a high-stakes battle, we have a mode for you:
Classic Hareeg: The traditional experience! Your penalty score is determined by the number of cards left in your hand. Empty your hand fast!
Fourteen (14): High risk, high reward. Your penalty score is calculated by the total value of the cards left in your hand. One bad round can change everything!
Hareeg 50s: A unique and challenging twist where melding is restricted to drawing FIFTIES only. Perfect for true veterans seeking a fresh tactical challenge.
Connect & Compete: FREE In-Game Voice & Text Chat!
The game is as much about the people as it is about the cards. Talk strategy, bluff your rivals, or just catch up with friends using our crystal-clear, FREE in-game voice chat. Prefer to keep it quiet? Utilize our global text chat and fun emojis to react to every game-winning move!
Unrivaled ONLINE Multiplayer:
Play anytime, anywhere. Match up against our massive community of over a million players. Use your dedicated message inbox to seamlessly send match invitations, manage friend requests, and build your ultimate Hareeg squad. Account linking via Email ensures you never lose your progress!
Master the Game Offline:
Want to practice your strategies before facing real players? Challenge our sophisticated AI! With 5 distinct computer difficulty levels, you can hone your skills, test new strategies, and perfect your melding mechanics at your own pace.
Ascend the Leaderboards & Claim Achievements:
Prove you are the ultimate Hareeg champion!
Global Leaderboards: Dominate the competition, rise through the ranks, and etch your name among the elite.
Rich Achievements: Complete unique daily and lifetime challenges to unlock prestigious achievements that showcase your mastery.
Customize Your Game, Your Way:
Flexible Game Rules: Tweak and customize a wide variety of game rules to play exactly the way you and your friends prefer.
The Ultimate In-Game Shop: Personalize your aesthetic! Unlock stunning new card decks, beautiful tables, vibrant themes, custom music, and expressive emojis. Play with style!
Join Over 1,000,000 Players Today!
Authentic Hareeg and Fourteen gameplay mechanics.
Deeply competitive online multiplayer and social features.
Continuous updates, smooth animations, and a polished user interface.
Download Hareeg 14 NOW and experience the timeless thrill of melding, outsmarting, and eliminating your competition!

bluejetty:00145923:ios.description:
Each curated Knitrino kit includes high-quality yarn from makers we love, a workshop-style project designed for mobile, and step-by-step instructions with video tutorials for every stitch and technique, plus needles and supplies — everything from cast on to bind off. You're not buying a PDF pattern. You're buying a complete making experience.
Create a project to track your progress row by row, see colorwork charts in your actual yarn colors, see only the size you're making, and tap any stitch to watch how it's done — including left-handed versions.
If you're looking to import your own patterns or buy PDFs, this isn't that. Knitrino is a curated experience built around kits we stand behind.
Here’s what people are saying:
“My squishy yarn package arrived today! Everything is gorgeous!!!!!” - Charli
“I'm so happy I found [Knitrino]. It's exactly what I've been looking for… It is obvious you put a tremendous amount of thought and research into all of this.” - Robyn
Founded by knitting sisters Alison & Andrea, Knitrino is crafted on the sense of family and community central to the fiber arts. Knitrino is a place for people to share their knowledge, connect and feel part of a wider group of makers with at least one thing in common: a passion for knitting. It’s our goal to make it easy for people to return to making, reconnect with their roots and feel present, all while striving for a more compassionate and sustainable world.
"I love knitting with Knitrino's knitting patterns, I can't imagine ever going back to a PDF again." - Claudia
“Omgeeeeeeeeee. Just got my knitting kit and I looooooooove it. You are the best!” - Andrea

bluejetty:00035415:ios.description:
Experience the simple yet addictive water sorting puzzle game! It’s the ultimate free game for training your brain, killing time, and relaxing!
If you want to sharpen your combinational logic skills, this water sort puzzle game is perfect for you! It offers a unique blend of relaxation and challenge, and there’s no timer to pressure you. With soothing water sounds and eye-catching visuals, Water Sort is more than just a game; it’s a delightful experience! 
How to Play:
 - Sort the Colors: Your goal is simple - pour colored water into matching bottles.
 - Pour Smartly: Tap one bottle to pour its contents into another. Remember, you can only pour water of the same color, and each bottle can only hold one color at a time!
 - Level Up: Solve thousands of brain-teasing levels, earn rewards, and unlock unique bottle designs!
Features:
 - Beautiful Bottles: Unlock and collect stunning bottles with intricate designs!
 - Stunning Backgrounds: Enjoy immersive backgrounds like ocean waves, starry skies, and serene sunsets as you play.
 - Power-Ups: Use helpful power-ups like Undo, Restart, and Hints to enhance your gameplay.
 - Relaxing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in calming music and the gentle sound of water flowing.
 - Free to Play: Download now and play without hidden fees or subscriptions!
Benefits:
 - Brain Exercise: Challenge your mind and improve cognitive skills while sorting colors.
 - Stress Relief: Experience relaxation as you engage in this calming puzzle environment.
 - Focus & Concentration: Sharpen your focus and problem-solving skills with each level you complete.
 - Sense of Achievement: Enjoy the satisfaction of sorting and organizing colors perfectly!
Join the fun and download Water Sort - Offline Color Puzzle now! Test your skills, relieve stress, and unleash the beauty of colors in this addictive and visually stunning puzzle game! 
Discover Water Sort, the ultimate color-sorting puzzle game that combines simplicity with addictive gameplay! Get ready to embark on a vibrant journey filled with colorful liquids that will challenge your mind and provide endless hours of fun.

bluejetty:00037372:ios.summary:
HotelsCombined searches hundreds of travel sites to show you your options and let you pick what works best for your trip. Track prices, set a budget, build your itinerary and more.
WHAT’S IN OUR APP.
Get the flight you want: Compare flight
bluejetty:00037372:ios.description:
HotelsCombined searches hundreds of travel sites to show you your options and let you pick what works best for your trip. Track prices, set a budget, build your itinerary and more.
WHAT’S IN OUR APP.
Get the flight you want: Compare flight options from hundreds of sites then zero in on the best one for you by using our filters.
Hotel rates only on the app: Find mobile-only prices from select hotels.
Car sharing: Search car sharing alongside traditional agencies for more options (and maybe better prices).
Know when prices change: Track search results for your trip and get a notification when prices change.
Search on your budget: Only have $300 to spend? HotelsCombined Explore will show you your flight options, on any budget.
ONLY ON THE HOTELSCOMBINED APP.
Flight tracker: Get alerts when something about your flight changes or track flights so you can see if you’ll make your connection.
Trips offline: All your ticket confirmations and reservations loaded into Trips are accessible regardless of whether or not you have Wifi.
Measure your bag: Direct your camera at your bag or carry on and we’ll let you know if it’s the right size for your flight without incurring a fee.
WE LOVE FEEDBACK.
Got a question and in need of support? Send us a message at https://www.hotelscombined.com/help and we’ll help you out
MORE ON WHAT HOTELSCOMBINED OFFERS.
Find flights, hotels, vacation rentals, rental cars and more - then filter by what matters to you most. Like a pet-friendly boutique hotel with a pool. Or a 4-door sedan with airport pick-up to get you on your way. We bring together great deals from your favorite travel sites in one place.
SEARCH HUNDREDS OF FLIGHT SITES AT ONCE.
With filtering and flexibility options, you can quickly search and book what works best for your trip.
MORE OPTIONS, MORE SAVING.
Find mobile-only rates and exclusive deals on the app. Set Price Alerts to know when prices drop on the flights, cars and hotels you’re interested in.
CREATE ITINERARIES AS YOU PLAN.
Our Trips tool puts all your plans in one place. Get alerted to flight and gate changes, access boarding passes both on- and offline, and share your itinerary with friends – all in one spot. You can sync your inbox or manually add any part of your trip - from tour and restaurant confirmations to notes on things to see.
CAR RENTAL DEALS.
Search from over 70,000 locations to find the perfect rental car. Book risk-free by filtering for free cancellation policies.
GET A HOTEL… OR A HOME.
See your accommodation options from major hotel chains and resorts to local boutiques to apartments, cabins, beach homes and more. Filter for free cancellation if you’re worried plans will change.
Plan your next trip with HotelsCombined. Download now to start planning a great trip.

Most Likely To is the party game where you spend the night pointing at your friends accusing them of horrible stuff.
STUPIDLY FUNNY
A stupid-ly funny game that's fast-paced and sure to leave you in splits. The game starts by drawing a card each round and everybody points to the friend that is described by the card.
The person with most fingers pointed at them does the punishment (drink, push up, or whatever you want)
BEST AND FUNNIEST CARDS
We created the best and funniest most likely to cards that will test your friendship in every way possible. We make party games for a living and trust us, Most Likely To will start your night in the most chaotic way possible.
OVER 900 CARDS AVAILABLE
There are many different categories, meaning no 2 playthroughs will be the same and it’s the perfect party game for many weeks to follow.
And the best part?! You just need your phone!
LET’S GET DIRTY
We know the real reason why you play this app (game also has dirty and suggestive cards for adults)
Most Likely To: Party Game allows players to:
- Select what kind of night they want to have
- Play Most Likely To with several decks that range from Fun to Dirty
- Spend unforgettable moments with your friends
- Create your own cards
If you enjoy roasting your friends when you are in a bar, you will love this game.
So, who’s most likely to install this game? Is it you?

bluejetty:00152154:ios.summary: Welcome to Jigsaw.com: Classic Puzzle, your new go-to destination for a premium digital puzzling experience. We provide a rich and engaging way to relax and enjoy a rewarding mental workout. Dive into a vast and beautiful collection of high
bluejetty:00152154:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsaw.com: Classic Puzzle, your new go-to destination for a premium digital puzzling experience. We provide a rich and engaging way to relax and enjoy a rewarding mental workout. Dive into a vast and beautiful collection of high-definition jigsaw puzzles, thoughtfully crafted for enthusiasts of all ages and skill levels.
Escape the everyday and sharpen your mind with the timeless joy of assembling beautiful images, piece by piece.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE JIGSAW.COM:
A New Puzzle Every Single Day Start each day with a fresh challenge. We deliver a brand-new, completely free puzzle to your device daily. It's the perfect morning ritual or evening wind-down, ensuring you always have something new to look forward to.
Exciting Daily Challenges Feeling competitive? Our Daily Challenges push you to race against the clock and compare your solving time with players from around the globe. Prove your skills, complete the challenge, and celebrate your achievement.
A Massive Library of HD Themes Get lost in our extensive gallery of stunning, professionally curated images. Explore numerous categories: travel to breathtaking landscapes, discover intricate architecture, admire colorful works of art, marvel at adorable animals, or piece together vibrant patterns. Our HD library has a theme for every possible mood and interest.
Full Customization of Your Experience This is your game, played your way. You are in complete control of the difficulty. Start with a quick, relaxing 36-piece puzzle, or test your mettle with large 400+ piece challenges. For an extra test, enable "Rotation Mode" to require rotating each piece into its correct orientation.
A Calming, Meditative Escape Jigsaw.com is more than just a game—it's a tool for mindfulness. Escape the stress of the daily grind and find your focus. Enjoy the calming, therapeutic process of sorting pieces and watching a beautiful image emerge at your own, unhurried pace.
Constantly Fresh Content Our puzzle collection is always growing. We regularly release new themed puzzle packs and special collections to keep your experience engaging. You'll always find new and amazing worlds to piece together.
Whether you have five minutes to spare or a whole evening to dedicate to relaxation, Jigsaw.com: Classic Puzzle is the perfect way to sharpen your focus, clear your mind, and unwind.
Download now and discover your next favorite puzzle!

bluejetty:00129435:ios.description:
It’s time to chop some trees! 
Lumber Harvest is one of the most fun tree cutting games that lets you experience all the joys of being a lumberjack. Clear the heavily forested islands, harvest the wood, and sell it to make a profit. Live the life of a lumberjack in one of the best lumber games! 
CHOP TREES
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to be a lumberjack? Well, now you have a chance to learn all about timber harvest and production. Navigate through endless islands and guide your truck through thick forests. There are plenty of trees to cut in this logging simulator!
GROW YOUR BUSINESS
A forest is not only a gift of nature, but it’s also a great source of income! Along with cutting trees and hauling timber to the sawmill, this logging simulator gives you an opportunity to build a profitable timber business. Cut down all the trees you see, harvest the wood, make a fortune, and earn coins for future upgrades. Explore the full depth of this logging truck simulator by completing various fun missions and lumber games.
Do you have what it takes to become a lumber tycoon? Today, you might be just an ordinary wood cutter, but tomorrow, you can become the best lumberjack in the world. Join the exciting adventure in one of the best tree cutting games!
COOL FEATURES:
● Ever-growing timber business. Earn coins for the trees you harvest and become the crackerjack of wood cutting!
● Immersive gameplay. This logging simulator is so real you can almost feel the smell of freshly cut wood!
● Adventure through numerous islands—visit various forested lands and wipe them clean!
● Satisfying tree cutting games. Once you try cutting trees, you won’t be able to stop!
● Impressive logging truck simulator—experience what it’s like to operate a real wood cutting truck.
So, what are you waiting for? One of the best tree cutting games is a download away. Unlike the other lumber games, Lumber Harvest makes cutting trees relaxing and fun! Start your tree-cutting empire now and become the renowned lumber tycoon in this super satisfying logging truck simulator!

bluejetty:00159713:ios.description:
Say hello to Gipi, your trusted AI Friend and Tutor! Whether you’re battling loneliness, practicing a new language, or looking for homework help, this AI companion is here to brighten your day and keep you company.
Gipi’s Key Features
- Real-time conversations: Share your thoughts, practice languages, or just have a friendly chat with Gipi whenever you feel like it. Whether it’s to learn or ease loneliness, your supportive friend is always there for you.
- Live Call feature: Talk to Gipi hands-free, just like a phone call. Perfect for moments when you’re driving, cooking, or even taking a walk – and never feel alone.
- Daily updates & horoscopes: Get inspired with personalized updates, local news, and insights about your favorite topics. Your AI friend helps you stay connected and combats loneliness with meaningful content.
- Homework help: Struggling with studies? Solve problems, learn new subjects, or send images for personalized homework assistance with your personal tutor by your side.
- A friend who remembers you: Gipi learns your preferences, remembers past conversations, and creates a truly customized experience for you.
- Safe and judgment-free space: Feeling lonely? Your caring friend provides a supportive, non-judgmental environment where you can open up and just be yourself.
- Customizable experience: Personalize your chats with Gipi – upload a recording, and enjoy your AI friend speaking in a voice that feels familiar and comforting.
Why Gipi?
This AI companion is more than just an app – it’s your trusted friend and tutor who listens, understands, and supports you through it all. Whether you’re practicing a language, tackling homework, or simply looking for a way to ease loneliness, Gipi adapts to your unique needs and grows with you.
Start your journey with Gipi today and discover the joy of having a caring AI friend who’s always there to help, listen, and care.

bluejetty:00125965:ios.description:
OneStep Reader gives you instant access to print anytime and anywhere. 
OneStep Reader 3.0 is a rapid and efficient text recognition app. Its text-to-speech, text-to-Braille, and text highlighting tools make it valuable for blind, low-vision, dyslexic, and others with reading differences. 
Use it to import or take a photo of anything containing text. Take a photo and the app reads text out loud or displays it on a connected refreshable Braille display. Read with more ease thanks to the simultaneous highlighting of the sentence and word that is being read on the picture or in the plain text document. The app helps you get a good photo with special alignment tools, including spoken and vibration guidance. Snap multiple pages, such as a book, for later reading. 
Winner of the 2014, 2015, and 2016 AppleVis Golden Apple Award for Best Assistive 
Technology App. 
• Reads image-based PDF and JPEG files, and now tagged PDF and ePub files too!
• Exports OneStep reader files as HTML or TXT files.
• Navigates by line, sentence, word, or character.
• Crop, rotate and edit the pictures you take before performing text recognition. 
• View documents in PDF presentation mode with double highlighting while reading. 
• View reading order and language-tagged PDF documents. 
• Add and remove bookmarks in PDF documents. 
• Switch between PDF view and reflowable text view. 
• Read documents in the increasingly popular ePub format.
The app also has synchronized text highlighting to help you read along with the spoken text, a benefit for people with dyslexia and other reading difficulties.
Need nutritional information from your breakfast cereal? OneStep reader can read labels. Out shopping and need a price? OneStep Reader can read price tags. Want to know what came in the mail? OneStep Reader captures it all.
OneStep Reader captures print from your computer or tablet screen. Photograph the screen and know exactly what that error message says.
Little details abound. We got rid of the fifty-page limit for batch recognition. Everything gets turned on its side with landscape support. Add subfolders to the local folder structure. Use Microsoft OneDrive, Dropbox, or Google Drive to store and retrieve your documents. You can now make calls, send emails, and open hyperlinks directly from documents; call or email your new contact directly from the text of her business card!
Fully localized versions (user interface, recognition and speech) are available in: English, German, Italian, French, Spanish, Norwegian (Bokmål), Swedish, Portuguese, Dutch, Turkish, Danish, Polish, Russian, Japanese, and Czech.

bluejetty:00119195:ios.name: HCSS Equipment360
bluejetty:00119195:ios.summary: It’s exactly what it sounds like: a 360-degree approach to your equipment maintenance. And now, it’s as mobile as you are. Designed for your heavy and over-the-road equipment, Equipment360 is a truly comprehensive maintenance solution that
bluejetty:00119195:ios.description:
It’s exactly what it sounds like: a 360-degree approach to your equipment maintenance. And now, it’s as mobile as you are. Designed for your heavy and over-the-road equipment, Equipment360 is a truly comprehensive maintenance solution that provides vital information to your mechanics, maintains a history of their time and work, helps shop managers run the show, and then feeds all of this data back to the office for costing and analysis.
~~~~~EMPOWERING FOR MECHANICS~~~~~
Hey mechanics, replace those filing cabinets with an easy app that you can take anywhere, even remote sites without Internet. It’s instant access to all the info you need so you can work faster and smarter, wherever the job takes you.
“Equipment360 has really made it easy to come out and diagnose the problems and enter the information with ease. It’s just a really great tool to use. It’s really easy to walk yourself through.”
- Carl R., Shop Foreman at Lecon, Inc.
• HAVE A PLAN: We make it easy to receive and complete the work orders you’ve been assigned to. Or, you can even create your own.
• KNOW MORE: Know everything about the equipment you’re servicing, including repair history, parts, schematics, serial numbers, and active warranties.
• SAVE TIME & MONEY: Be alerted to potential time and money savings if your pending work involves components still under warranty.
• COLLABORATE: Make it a team effort. Collaborate with other mechanics in the same work order, simultaneously or in phases.
• LOG IT ALL: It’s easy to enter all the details in one place, including time, parts, receipts, photos, notes, and more.
• FINISHED EARLY? Check the backlog, or quickly find other open work orders in the vicinity.
• OUT OF TIME? Add notes to the backlog for the next mechanic or service on this item.
~~~~~CONVENIENT FOR MANAGERS~~~~~
Managers, we know you’re on the move, too. Now you can easily manage your people and work no matter where you are — in the shop, on the road, or at a job site. 
“The value we are realizing through implementing the software is incredible. We have...equipment data at our fingertips and see significant efficiency improvements.”
- Brian C., Engineering Dept. Manager & Project Manager for The Earle Companies
• GET ORGANIZED: Always know what’s around the corner. See all your upcoming maintenance, incoming requests, inspection issues, and even equipment moves on one screen.
• SIMPLIFY YOUR PROCESS: Instantly turn alerts into work orders with a simple tap.
• SET IT & FORGET IT: Preventive maintenance is one less thing you’ll have to remember because we’ll alert you when it’s due. Our robust system tracks PMs by odometer miles, meter hours, and/or days to meet all your heavy equipment needs.
• GO LIVE WITH GPS: Don’t waste time gathering meter readings. GPS integration ensures your PMs are driven by accurate, automated readings. You can also see the live location of each equipment piece and their open work orders. (Requires HCSS Telematics.)
• FIND BALANCE: Assign and balance mechanic workloads with easy drag-and-drop functionality.
• REVIEW WORK with little work. Review and close out completed work orders with ease.
• APPROVE TIME in no time. Approve mechanic time cards with just a tap, or send them back with rejection notes for corrective action.
~~~~~Try it out now!~~~~~
On the login screen, just tap "Take a tour." (Full app usage requires a subscription plan.) 
Learn more: www.hcss.com/equipment360
“Thank God for Equipment360! It’s making my life a whole lot easier.”
- Kole W., Maintenance Service Writer at Lecon, Inc.
---------------------------
COMPATIBILITY
- Mechanic features compatible with Equipment360 server v2023.2.0 or higher (limited features available on older versions). 
- Manager features compatible with Equipment360 server v2023.2.0 or higher (limited features available on older versions).

bluejetty:00071010:ios.name: AGED Freecell Solitaire
bluejetty:00071010:ios.summary: FreeCell solitaire is a classic, causal card game, based on classic solitaire. FreeCell solitaire uses standard 52-card deck, and there are 4 open cell and 4 open foundations. The goal of freecell is to build up 4 piles from Ace to King in
bluejetty:00071010:ios.description:
FreeCell solitaire is a classic, causal card game, based on classic solitaire. FreeCell solitaire uses standard 52-card deck, and there are 4 open cell and 4 open foundations. The goal of freecell is to build up 4 piles from Ace to King in the 4 foundations. You win when all 52 cards are moved to the foundations.
Unlike other solitaire card games, it requires skill rather than luck. There are very few deals which are unsolvable, different from most other solitaire games. All the cards are opened at the beginning. You need to think very carefully, utilize empty cells and empty cascades wisely, and then move the cards strategically to win the game.
Now, come and download this relaxing FreeCell solitaire for free. Enjoy the fun of classic card game and get your brain exercised!
Features:
- Classic FreeCell solitaire rules
- Classic and simple user interface
- Winning deal: a game is winnable and has a solution
- Random deal: possible to be non-winnable, but most of them are solvable. It is up to you to find a solution to these games
- Daily Challenge: you can challenge every day to practice your skills of playing solitaire
- Numbered game: if you enter a number from 1 to 64000, it will give you the card layout of that number
- Auto-complete: cards will automatically move to the foundations when they can
- Can choose to play by right or left hand
- Can choose Auto orientation and portrait or landscape
- Unlimited Hint: guide you to take the next move
- Click or Draw: when you click on one card, it can automatically move to the right place; or you draw it to the place you want
- Unlimited chances of Undo/Redo
- Auto-save incomplete game
- Look up your historical statistics
- Multiple background and appearance styles you can choose
- Multiple language choices
Enjoy the game and train your brain now!

bluejetty:00024725:ios.description:
Dentist game for kids – is a cool educational app in which your kids will be able to be a dentist and learn to take care of teeth properly.
Open your own dentistry and help little animals in treating their teeth! Become familiar with the state of the oral cavity of the patient, use all the necessary tools, clean the teeth of food debris and rinse them with a special solution.
In the dentist game your kids will learn how to:
• apply special products and gels to the teeth and gums;
• clean up the teeth from the leftover food;
• remove tartar and treat caries;
• brush teeth and freshen breath.
Also, we will tell and show what tools the doctor usually uses during the appointment to find bad teeth, treat them, put braces and replace old teeth with new ones.
~~~ Large character selection ~~~
There are many patients in reception waiting for your help! We provide you with 6 cute animals who are eager to treat their teeth. Click on any of them and start the game.
~~~ Instruments preparing ~~~
Before you start to play, watch a small tutorial to become familiar with the problem of the patient and learn more about the exact instrumentary you will need while treating. Tap on the button and start to play!
~~~ Dental cleaning ~~~
Time to show your dentist skills! Use a hook to take the leftover food out of the fang spinas. Brush the teeth with a brush and a toothpaste. Take a syringe and give an injection so that the animal does not hurt while you treat the gums. Show how good a doctor you are!
~~~ Oral cavity treatment ~~~
Cleaning up your character's mouth requires more than just brushing their teeth. Replace old fangs and incisors with new ones and treat caries. Rinse the mouth with a special refreshing liquid and apply gel glue to the teeth to get braces. Moreover, to add some color to the brackets, decorate them with bright heart and star stickers.
~~~ Simple interface and fun gameplay ~~~
Our app is easy to use and has a fairly simple interface, due to which the kid will be able to play the game on their own, without the help of parents. Now your kids can not only have a good time, but also stop being afraid of dentists.
Try yourself as a dentist and see how dental treatment can be not scary, but, on the contrary, very entertaining!

bluejetty:00098651:ios.description:
It’s time to money your way! Send money, save alone or with friends, pay bills, and set payment reminders—all in one place. 
This is your PocketMoni—your new favourite digital bank! 
But seriously, why should you use PocketMoni? 
Because you’re the master of your money. We’ll only help you manage it.  
Easy sign-up: Create your account for free in 10 minutes. You only need your NIN and BVN. 
Send money in 5 seconds: No, we’re not joking! Transfers are as fast as lighting on PocketMoni. Send money to any Nigerian bank fast. Whether you’re shopping, eating, splitting a bill, or making a quick payment, it takes only 2 seconds on PocketMoni. 
Spend and save with friends: Imagine this: You and your friends are saving for a trip, but plans change. No more awkward “have you sent it” or I'm yet to receive it” texts. PocketMoni lets you track group balances, receive payment notifications, and get automatic reversals whenever you want out.  
A card that works: Love movies or music? Pay your Netflix, Amazon Prime, YouTube Premium, Spotify, DStv and GOtv subscriptions with your PocketMoni physical, virtual or single-use card. 
Set payment reminders: Life happens. Set reminders for upcoming bills, grandma’s cash gifts subscriptions, loans or personal payments. You’ll never forget important payments with PocketMoni. 
Receive instant notifications: Stay updated with real-time alerts whenever money enters or leaves your account, giving you complete control over your money. 
Understand your spending behaviour: See where your money goes. Understand where your money goes. With detailed weekly and monthly reports, you can uncover your spending behaviour and make informed decisions about your finances. 
Scan to pay: Tap, scan, pay! That’s all you need for safer, faster payments. You can’t beat that feeling. 
Your app, your style: Your app should reflect your style. Customise your app wallpapers with exciting wallpapers or quirky GIFs. It’s up to you because “moneying” is an art. 
Easy bill payments: When you buy airtime, data, and meter tokens and pay other bills on PocketMoni, you’ll see records of your frequently paid bills, so it's easier to make payments next time with fewer taps. No stress—just convenience! 
Debit cards? Make it interesting: Choose your debit card design and swipe in style. Add your picture or any image you like for an extra vibe. Bye, boring cards! (Fees may apply). 
Under 18 accounts: Set your children up for financial success. Get them an under 18 account with their card so that they can learn about saving and spending early.  
Security and privacy: Your security is our top priority. PocketMoni uses state-of-the-art encryption and security measures to protect your personal and financial information. With features like private mode, two-factor authentication and real-time transaction alerts, you can confidently use PocketMoni, knowing that your data is safe. 
User-friendly interface: Accessing your money should be easy and intuitive. The PocketMoni app features a clean, user-friendly interface that makes it simple to spend, save and invest with just a few taps. 
Join PocketMoni people: A community of people like you who have taken control of their money. 
24/7 support: Please talk to us in the app or through email at cic@etranzact.com; a real human being will attend to you.  
Download the PocketMoni app today. 
The NDIC insures your deposits on PocketMoni. 
Our registered address is 1st, 4th and 5th floors, Fortune Towers, Adeyemo Alakija Street, Victoria Island, Lagos. 
www.pocketmonibank.com 
Phone Number (Calls): 09087989094 
WhatsApp Support: 08188639818 
Email: cic@etranzact.com

bluejetty:00025931:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00025931:ios.description:
CarPlay Support!
NOTE: R4 Companion™ requires a Uniden R4 or R4w radar detector with US Version 142 (R4) or 127 (R4w) firmware to function correctly. R4 Companion will NOT function correctly without at least this version of firmware.
R4 Companion™ is a feature rich app, designed to give you the most out of your R4, while enhancing your driving experience along the way. Featuring intelligent alerts and advanced muting! R4 Companion™ is the COMPLETE solution to enjoying your R4. 
SpotLock 2.0 and Advanced False Assist 3.0. Both data driven systems have been updated using 5 years of historical data. This takes your detector to a whole new level of quietness and safety against real threats. 
The R4 Companion™ app leverages years of optimizations and features from the Radar Companion™ series of apps. (Available separately for owners of the V1, R8, R9, & DS1 radar detectors).
Enhanced GPS location based 'false muting' via SpotLocks™ - All future updates to this app are free to purchasers of R4 Companion™
R4 Companion™ feature list:
• SpotLocks™ - Location based false silencing has never been this good or easy. Turn on the intelligent location-based learning and let R4 Companion™ do the rest. Or you can manually 'lock' or 'unlock' locations with ease from the main alert screen.
• Full navigation functionality in preparation for future CarPlay integration.
• New alert screen (portrait & landscape views). 
• Posted speed limit displayed on main alert screen (US, CA, AU, NZ).
• Customizable low speed muting based on PSL.
• Quickly switch back from navigation screen to classic alert details screen.
• Works seamlessly with the R4's auto mute memory, manual mute memory, k-block, and quiet-ride built in muting. 
• Option to play detector tones in app.
• Ability to set R4’s internal detector settings from the app. *Requires US Version 142 (R4) 127 (R4w) firmware.
• SpotLocks™ works seamlessly with your R4’s built in 'auto mute memory' locations. If you create or delete a location from the app it will apply the changes to your R4 at the same time.
• 'Proximity' meter - leverages the high resolution signal strength to show you a better representation of the signal's source.
• 'K & X falses in area' meter shows you how many possible false alerts exist in the area you are traveling based on the accumulated SpotLock data™.
• 'Custom Phrases' for a given threat's audio announcements.
• High resolution meters for the priority alert (Not limited to the # of bars on the R4 display).
• Customizable heads-up display (HUD).
• HUD displays the priority alert's band, signal strength, frequency. The HUD is color coded between real threats & muted false signals.
• HUD of the secondary alerts' bands, signal strengths, frequencies, & bogey counts.
• Advanced BSM/CAS/Ka False Muting (Optimized for the R4 platform).
• 'Ghost' muting quiets false alerts when you are stuck traveling near a false emitting vehicle.
• "Passive Mute™"- Quiets the R4 below user set speeds & during weak K & X signals.
• Bogey count display showing total number of threats.
• Vehicle speed display. Speed is color coded for each alert type.
• Mute status with the ability to manually mute/unmute alerts as you need.
• Detailed & intelligent voice announcements of band, frequency, strength, number of alerts, occurrences of mixed signals and more.
• Automatic muting of Ka, K, and X bands ('Time before mute' set for each band).
• 'Reduce Speed' notification for user set speed.
• ‘Urgency Alerts™’ - Unmutes growing threats & announces these alerts via voice & notifications.
• ‘Alert History’ - View your past alerts with detailed information.
• Compass heading.
• Detailed trip summary including duration, distance, alerts, muting stats, battery, and more.
• Automatic and seamless connection via Bluetooth even while the app is in the background.
• iPhone & Apple Watch notifications of Band, & Frequency of each alert.
• Help system.

bluejetty:00091705:ios.description:
= Get our full-featured, fast and well-designed mobile App. =
Integrated with Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Google Vacation Rental, Expedia, Agoda, Trip.com, Houfy and your own Direct Booking Sites. Synchronize calendars, messages, prices, reservations and reviews across all platforms. Our automated tools and team accounts make managing a large number of properties a breeze.
【AUTO MESSAGING】
- AI bots respond to guests 7x24
- Automatically contact guests at key points
- Automatically review your guests
- HostGPT automatic response generation
【CHECK-IN GUIDE】
- Automatically send check-in guide link to guests
- Collect identification photos and secure deposit
- Provide check-in instructions and map navigation
- Automatically generate and share door lock codes
【TASK AUTOMATION】
- Automatic creation and assignment of cleaning tasks
- Email notifications and reminders for cleaning tasks
- Ability for cleaners to send image and text feedback
- Task statistics and cost calculation
【TEAM ACCOUNT】
- Create individual team accounts for different roles within the team and assign them functional permissions and access to specific properties. Let everyone fulfill their respective roles, working in parallel without conflict.
【DIRECT BOOKING SITE】
- Fully synchronize with Hostex, live chat with your guests
- Integration with Google Vacation Rentals, Stripe and PayPal
- Customizable pages and the ability to create extra pages
- Custom domain name
- Embeddable booking widget
- No additional charges
【ROOM TYPE & MULTI-UNIT】
- You can create a room type and assign multiple properties to it, then link the room type with the corresponding room type on Booking.com. This way, when a new reservation comes in, it will be allocated to one of the properties within the room type, while the room type automatically calculates the latest remaining inventory and synchronizes it with Booking.com.
【INTEGRATIONS】
- Integrated with TTlock platform, as well as numerous leading smart lock brands such as August, Yale, SmartThings, Nuki and 30+ smart lock brands.
- Integrated with PriceLabs and Rategenie smart pricing tools.
- Hostex Open API & Web Hook.

bluejetty:00183837:ios.name: Moya Mobile App
bluejetty:00183837:ios.summary:
Moya Mobile App allows you to do your banking securely at anytime and anywhere – in the palm of your hand! Access and view your account balances, pay your bills, and transfer money conveniently.
Use the Moya Mobile App for fast, easy, on-
bluejetty:00183837:ios.description:
Moya Mobile App allows you to do your banking securely at anytime and anywhere – in the palm of your hand! Access and view your account balances, pay your bills, and transfer money conveniently.
Use the Moya Mobile App for fast, easy, on-the-go banking. There are no new passwords to remember – all account login information is the same as your online banking. The app is compatible with iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad.
With Moya Mobile App you can:
• Log in with your Username and Password
• For secure and quick access, set-up Fingerprint ID or Facial Recognition
• View your account activity, balances and recent transactions
• Pay bills now or set them up for a future date
• View and edit upcoming scheduled bills and transfers
• Send money instantly with Interac e-Transfer®
• Transfer money between your accounts
• Quickly and securely deposit your cheques by using your smartphone or tablet
• Display your balances at-a-glance without having to log in with QuickView
It’s simple to use and free*
Security
Your security is our top priority, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full online banking.
*You may incur service charges for various online services depending on the type of account you have. In addition, your mobile carrier may charge you for using your mobile device to access the services provided by our mobile app.
Permissions
In order to use the Moya Mobile App, you'll need to grant our app permission to access certain functions on your mobile phone, including:
• Full network access – Allows our app to connect to the Internet.
• Take pictures and videos – Deposit cheques using Deposit Anywhere™ right from your mobile phone by allowing our app access to your phone camera.
• Access to your phone contacts – Get the utmost in convenience by allowing our app to access your list of contacts, that way you can send an Interac e-Transfer® to someone on your contact list without manually setting them up as a recipient in mobile banking.
Access
Access is available to all members who currently use our online banking service. If you’re not a Moya Financial member, no problem – simply contact Moya Financial and set up a new membership. You’ll be set up with access right away.
Use of the mobile app is subject to the terms and conditions found in our Moya Financial Credit Union Account Access Agreement for personal accounts.

bluejetty:00023669:ios.description:
Calvetica is the fastest calendar for iPhone and iPad.
+ Beautiful interface for viewing and managing your calendar.
+ Universal. Made for any iOS device
+ Continuous scrolling month view on iPad
+ A rich month view that lets you see how events span days and overlap
+ A continuous scrolling week view on both iPhone and iPad
+ Works out of the box with all your existing events
+ Relies on the default calendar app for syncing with Google, Exchange etc
+ Quickly add an event by long pressing on a day, typing the time with our fast number pad
+ Custom Calvetica alerts can fire after the default apps alerts and give you a "Snooze" option
+ Custom Calvetica alerts allow you to set a sound thats louder and longer than default apps alert
+ E-mail an iCal file to share with others or SMS an event description to someone
+ Highly customizable complex repeats (e.g. The first thursday of every month)
+ Manage attendees
+ View a location on a map or use the map to set a location for an event
+ Tappable email addresses, phone numbers, etc in notes
+ Lots of awesome gestures for power users to get things done quicker
OTHER GREAT FEATURES
+ Customize calendar colors
+ Show/hide calendars
+ Search for events within a time range. Search by title, notes, location. Results will highlight the matching text and indicate where it was found.
+ Multiple default alarms
+ Alarms specifically for all day events (i.e. remind me 6pm the day before)
+ Icons by event titles to quickly see if it has notes, a location, attendees or if it repeats.
+ Time zone support
+ Start your week on any day
+ 24-hour format
+ Customize how event and task details appear on the edit screen. Reorder, show or hide details so you can simplify and see only what you want to see.
+ We’re friendly, responsive and personal developers who seek constant improvement in everything we build.
+ And more...

bluejetty:00018716:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00018716:ios.description:
Eat better, feel great, and lose weight the Mediterranean way. Get a personalized weekly Mediterranean diet meal plan, dietitian-checked recipes, smart grocery lists, and your own AI nutrition coach—all in one easy meal planner app.
Rated 4.4 stars by 1,400+ users and rebuilt from the ground up, the all-new Mediterranean Diet & Meal Plan app makes healthy eating simple, sustainable, and delicious.
YOUR PERSONALIZED MEAL PLAN
• A fresh weekly meal plan tailored to your goals, allergies, and food preferences
• Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks—planned for you
• Swap meals, adjust serving sizes, and mark meals as eaten, including previous days
• Calorie goals matched to your body and weight-loss targets
HUNDREDS OF HEALTHY RECIPES
• Dietitian-checked Mediterranean recipes with clear, step-by-step instructions
• Search by name or ingredient and filter by meal type or dietary tags
• Save favorites and add your own recipes to your personal recipe book
SMART GROCERY LISTS
• Your shopping list builds itself from your weekly meal plan
• Ingredients are organized by category to help you shop faster
• Add, edit, and check off items in seconds
AI NUTRITION COACH
• Personalized nutrition tips and answers whenever you need them
• Daily and weekly insights that show how you’re eating
• Gentle guidance that helps you stay consistent—no guilt or gimmicks
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Simple calorie and nutrition tracking built into your plan
• A clear analytics dashboard showing daily and weekly wins
• See small, healthy habits add up to lasting results
WHY THE MEDITERRANEAN DIET?
The Mediterranean diet is a sustainable way of eating centered on vegetables, fruits, whole grains, olive oil, fish, and lean proteins. It can support heart health, healthy cholesterol, anti-inflammatory eating, and lasting weight loss—without giving up the foods you love. It can also complement a GLP-1 journey focused on building long-term healthy habits.
WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
• Anyone seeking an easy Mediterranean diet meal plan and healthy meal planner
• Busy people and families who want weekly menus and grocery lists prepared for them
• Home cooks looking for quick, healthy Mediterranean recipes
• Anyone focused on heart health, anti-inflammatory eating, or sustainable weight loss
Start your Mediterranean journey today. Download the app and get your personalized meal plan in minutes.
A subscription is required for full access. Payment is charged to your app-store account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms of Use: https://www.mediterraneanmealguide.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.mediterraneanmealguide.com/privacy
This app provides general nutrition and wellness information for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your doctor before beginning a diet or changing your health routine.

iPassSafe uses AES-256 encryption combined with PBKDF2 key strengthening to secure your data. This industry-standard encryption ensures your information is protected from unauthorized access, even if a backup is compromised, offering robust defense against any threats.
○ EXCLUSIVE USE OF APPLE’S OFFICIAL FRAMEWORKS: 
Unlike many competitors that integrate third-party libraries for analytics, push notifications, and other services, iPassSafe relies solely on Apple’s official frameworks. By avoiding external code, iPassSafe minimizes potential security risks and ensures that your data is handled within a highly secure and trusted environment.
○ PRIVACY POLICY: 
Our privacy policy is straightforward—iPassSafe does NOT collect or track ANY user data. iPassSafe stands out by NOT collecting or tracking ANY user data. Unlike most other apps, your information stays completely private and secure, with NO third-party involvement.
○ LOCAL DATA STORAGE WITH SECURE CLOUD SYNC OPTION:
Unlike some popular password managers that have been compromised due to reliance on centralized private clouds, which have faced security breaches, iPassSafe avoids these risks. Your data is stored directly on your device and in your iCloud (optional), benefiting from Apple’s secure infrastructure. This approach makes such breaches impossible and ensures robust privacy and control while offering seamless sync and password autofill across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Safari.
◆ Available on both iOS and macOS! I
PassSafe offers the same high level of security and convenience across all your Apple devices, with a macOS version available on the Mac App Store.
> ALL YOUR DATA

• 19 x Built-in categories including:
○ Logins (Web, Email, FTP...)
○ Credit Cards

○ Text notes

○ Contacts with Build-it call/send email option
○ ID cards

○ Driving License
○ Software License

○ AutoFill extension support
○ Built-in search tool
○ Face/Touch ID support 
○ Private Reminders
○ Air Print
> NOTES:

without it , you will not be able to see your data. 
2. Backup is not done automatically, the user is responsible for such a backup (IDB file) using features (iCloud, Dropbox, email, FTP ...) exists in iPassSafe to avoid loss of data when device is lost, damaged or any other reason, furthermore iPassSafe is NOT providing any direct cloud service, password retrieval, or backup service for security reason (all data stored on your device only!), user need to decide where to do the backup (iCloud, user's private Dropbox account, user's diskonkey using FTP, or user's email ...), the user is also responsible for this backup safety. 
3. Sync is not merging data, you have to keep all updated data on one device and use sync option upload file, then load and activate with a password on all your other devices 
4. Incase you used in-app purchase to upgrade app (unlimited records + backup support), and you want to use it on your other iOS devices please goto "settings" on your new device iPassSafe free app and select "restore purchase" on new device to restore it without any additional cost.

bluejetty:00079771:ios.name: Credible: Speech Coach
bluejetty:00079771:ios.summary: Stop saying "like," "um," "you know," and other distracting filler words that make you sound unprofessional. Credible is the only app that provides immediate feedback during everyday conversations to help you speak with confidence and clari
bluejetty:00079771:ios.description:
Stop saying "like," "um," "you know," and other distracting filler words that make you sound unprofessional. Credible is the only app that provides immediate feedback during everyday conversations to help you speak with confidence and clarity.
WHY CREDIBLE WORKS (When Other Apps Fail)
• Real-Time Feedback: Credible works in the moment, when you need it most – not just during isolated practice sessions.
• Effortless Improvement: No time-consuming practice drills. Credible works immediately, making you aware of your speech habits instantly and discreetly.
• Fast Results: Awareness based training is the only way to improve, enhancing job prospects and personal communication.
• Track Your Progress: Stay motivated and track your progress with our new streak tracking feature.
KEY FEATURES:
Unlike other speech improvement software that requires regular training or provides feedback after you speak, Credible is designed to increase your awareness of filler word use immediately, the only way to solve the problem. With Credible, you don't need to spend hours practicing; it works effortlessly to help you improve your speech.
• Real-Time Alerts: Discreetly alerts you of filler words as you use them while speaking on your iPhone and Apple Watch.
• Customization: Choose common filler words or add any phrases you want to reduce, and the notification frequency.
• Streak & Progress Tracking: Monitor your improvement over time with detailed progress reports.
• Privacy First: Audio is processed on your device, never stored or shared.
PERFECT FOR:
Break the habit of saying "like" with Credible, the easy-to-use solution that works instantly without any effort, time, or practice. As you become more aware of your speech, you'll naturally stop using "like."
• Job Interviews
• Conversations
• Meetings
• Presentations
• Anyone who wants to communicate more effectively!
Get Noticed for What You Say – Not How You Say It
HOW TO USE:
Credible requires microphone, speech recognizer, and notification access. Also, you will need to read a short paragraph to train Credible to only listen to you.
• Provide access to your microphone, speech recognizer, and notifications.
• Select the filler word you want to stop saying.
• Select your notification frequency.
• Set up the speaker verification tool by reading a short paragraph.
• Hit “Tap to Start.”
Leave Credible on during any conversation to increase your awareness of filler words as you say them. Real time feedback is the only way you can become aware and improve your speech.
DATA PRIVACY:
We take your data privacy seriously! Audio data is processed on-device in real time, it is never sent to the cloud or saved. Credible listens only when you activate it.
PURCHASE OPTIONS:
Credible offers a free demonstration of all included features with unlimited use, without interruptions or advertisements. Subscription options are for 1-week, 1-month, 3-months, 1-year, 1-year non-renewing access, or purchase of lifetime access. The cost varies by country of residence and will be shown before confirming the purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing cycle. Users can manage subscriptions by going to the App Store, going to AppleID Account Settings, and scrolling down to Subscriptions. Cancellations are allowed during the active subscription period but no partial refund will be given. For refund inquiries, users must contact the Apple App Store directly.
CONNECT:
For more information, questions, or concerns, please visit our website https://soundcredible.com/contact-us/ or email info@soundcredible.com
Privacy Policy: https://soundcredible.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://soundcredible.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00156472:ios.summary: Estacionamento Rotativo é um instrumento da engenharia de tráfego, cujo objetivo principal é proporcionar a acessibilidade do cidadão motorizado às áreas de maior oferta de comércio, serviços e lazer, onde o espaço é escasso, disponibilizan
bluejetty:00156472:ios.description:
Estacionamento Rotativo é um instrumento da engenharia de tráfego, cujo objetivo principal é proporcionar a acessibilidade do cidadão motorizado às áreas de maior oferta de comércio, serviços e lazer, onde o espaço é escasso, disponibilizando vagas de estacionamento pagas, o que proporciona a ocupação de uma mesma vaga ao longo do dia por vários veículos, democratizando o uso do espaço público.
Com o Estacionamento Rotativo Digital a BHTRANS irá acompanhar, em tempo real, todas as etapas do processo de estacionamento, constituídas pelo cadastramento e suporte ao usuário, aquisição de créditos eletrônicos de estacionamento, controle de arrecadação, validação da permanência na vaga e coleta de dados em campo, o que permitirá um maior controle sobre a receita, a otimização dos recursos humanos para a fiscalização, maior agilidade nas informações sobre o funcionamento do Estacionamento Rotativo e, consequentemente, na tomada de decisões visando às correções necessárias.
Há 50 anos Belo Horizonte mantém em funcionamento o Sistema de Estacionamento Rotativo pago, operacionalizado atualmente por meio do uso de folhas de raspar. O Estacionamento Rotativo Digital vem modernizar a forma de estacionar em Belo Horizonte facilitando a vida do cidadão, além de permitir melhor gestão, fiscalização e coleta de dados visando constante melhoria do serviço.

bluejetty:00035888:ios.description:
سوا (Sawa) – تطبيق دردشة و بث صوتي هدفه جمعك مع اصدقاء مميزين حيث يمكنك الدردشة الصوتية مجانا وامضاء وقت ممتع.
مميزات تطبيق الدردشة
غرف الدردشة الصوتية العامة و الخاصة
دردشة صوتية عالية الجودة مع اصدقائك و هي تعتبر آداة تواصل سهلة جدا! كما يمكنك انشاء غرفة دردشة خاصة مع كلمة سر لتتمكن من الاستمتاع بلحظات خاصة و هادئة.
ميزات غرف الدردشة
هناك العديد من الغرف الخاصة في سوا، مثل غرفة للعب الألعاب الرقمية ، وغرفة متخصصة في الغناء، وغرفة لعزف الآلات الموسيقية، وغرفة لقراءة الشعر، وغرفة لمشاركة خبرات السفر والحياة وما إلى ذلك. يمكنك أن تكون مالكا لأي غرفة ذات طابع خاص ومميز . لدردشة ممتعة ورائعة.
عائلة المجد
داخل برنامج سوا يمكنك ايضا الانضمام الى العائلة التي تفضل و يمكنك تطوير نفسك مع العائلة من خلال ان تكون فعال داخل العائلة و المشاركة بالتحديات و الدردشة وارسل الهدايا. يمكنك ايضا كسب ماسات اضافية واستخدامها لابراز ثرائك و تميزك.
هدايا افتراضية و انتقائية مميزة جدا
في تطبيق سوا يمكنك اختيار مجموعة كبيرة من الهدايا الافتراضية للتعبير عن نفسك ، هذه الهدايا مناسبة لذوق المستخدمين ، مع تأثيرات رائعة. كما تتوفر مجموعة كبيرة من إطارات الصور وتأثيرات الدخول المباشر التي ستجعلك تشعر بأنك مميز ومختلف
الصديق المناسب لشخصيتك
يمكنك العثور على أصدقاء مناسبين لشخصيتك مباشرةً ثم الانضمام إلى غرفتهم والمشاركة في المحادثات الصوتية. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، إذا أكملت اختبار الشخصية، سنقوم وفقًا لنتائج الاختبار بمطابقتك مع اصدقاء مناسبين، مما يجعل توافقك أكثر دقة وملائمة.

bluejetty:00061736:ios.name: Tap Forms Organizer 5 Database
bluejetty:00061736:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061736:ios.description:
Tap Forms 5 is the digital filing cabinet for life’s scattered details. Now with Scripting and Siri Shortcuts support!
Accounts, recipes, expenses, inventory — life is full of things that we don’t want to forget or misplace. Tap Forms 5 helps you organize all kinds of things in one place — secure, searchable, and accessible on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch (Mac app sold separately).
How can one app organize everything? Because not only can you use and customize the more than 30 built-in templates but you can create your own “forms” for inputting any kind of information, even if that information includes pictures, doodles, audio recordings, calculations, file attachments, ratings, or even links to other forms. This makes it almost like building your very own customized organization app.
• Capture your way: Snap a picture, type or scribble some text, record an audio note, scan a barcode — there are 23 different types of information that can be captured with Tap Forms
• Organize your way: Create and design custom forms exactly how you want to for optimal organization. Get started with one of our ready-to-go form templates, or easily make a custom one from scratch with our integrated form building tools.
• Store confidential data with confidence: Tap Forms' security settings let you optionally require a password or a Touch ID scan, and even auto-lock when idle for a custom period of time. Using AES encryption, you can rest easy knowing your data is safe and secure.
• Import, Export, Share: It’s easy to import your data from existing files, so getting started is a breeze. Import your data from text, CSV, Bento and more. One-tap exporting allows you to share with Mac, Windows, and Linux users.
Advanced Features:
• Scripting support for writing JavaScript code for performing all kinds of operations on your forms and records.
• Siri Shortcuts let you record a voice command to execute any Form script.
• Multi-column (table) view of your records.
• AirDrop records to your nearby contacts.
• Sync with Tap Forms for iOS and Mac using iCloud, IBM Cloudant, Nearby (WiFi), or with your own Apache CouchDB sync server.
• Saved search rules with multi-field record filtering
• Built-in Backup & Restore
• 1Password Extension integration for logging into your Cloudant sync account.
• Document Picker support for accessing iCloud and other document service providers.
• Pick lists for quick data entry
• AES-256 bit encryption
• Import & Export standard CSV files from Excel, Numbers, or other systems
• Print record details
• Lightning fast search
• Share form templates with friends, family, and co-workers
• Notify you of things that need your attention using alerts
• Barcode scanning of UPC/EAN and QR codes (iOS only)
Store 25 different types of information, such as:
• Script
• Table
• Link to form (relational links between forms)
• Inverse relationships
• File Attachment with multi-file support
• Email address
• GPS location
• Contact
• Text
• Date
• Time
• Date & time
• Number
• Rating
• Web site address
• Check mark
• Note
• Audio notes (record on iOS, playback on Mac)
• Photos
• Drawings (draw on iOS, view on Mac)
• Phone number
• Section headings
• Calculations
• Signatures
Includes more than 30 built-in forms, including:
• Audio dictation
• Bank accounts
• Clients
• Client call log
• Credit & debit cards
• Daily journal
• Expenses
• Frequent flyer numbers
• Health insurance
• Homework assignments
• Loyalty cards
• Personal health cards
• Security alarm codes
• Serial numbers
• Vehicle insurance
• Website accounts
• Wine collection

bluejetty:00119485:ios.name: PropertyMe Agent
bluejetty:00119485:ios.summary: Made for Property Managers by Property Managers, PropertyMe Agent is your portfolio in the palm of your hand! With every message, task, job, inspection, property, owner, tenant and supplier at your fingertips wherever you go, you're always
bluejetty:00119485:ios.description:
Made for Property Managers by Property Managers, PropertyMe Agent is your portfolio in the palm of your hand! With every message, task, job, inspection, property, owner, tenant and supplier at your fingertips wherever you go, you're always on top of what's going on in your portfolio!
Stay across all activity
The dashboard gives you a real-time summary as tasks are created, jobs are reported and inspections fall due.
Communicate with a single click
All of your rental and sale properties are available in the app alongside complete owner and tenant contact details so you can make a call, send an sms or compose an email with just a tap. All communication is stored within the platform and inbound sms receives replies straight to the app so you never need to search your phone or screenshot and save messages again.
Go completely digital with Paperless Inspections
Preparing paperless inspection reports couldn’t be easier. The app preselects the areas for each property, which you can customise and then records your comments (using dictation if you wish) along with any number of photos for each area. Nominate a rent review amount, specify any follow-up actions and recommendations for the owner and then tap to sign and publish the report right from the device. bluejetty:00159422:ios.description:
Nosotras V-App es un calendario menstrual que te notifica el pronóstico de tu período y te brinda recomendaciones para cada etapa del ciclo, definiendo reportes de peso, sueño, actividad sexual, entre otros. Nuestra app no te deja olvidar ni de tus anticonceptivos, ni de tus exámenes regulares como la citología, mamografía, etc. Lo mejor es que podrás contar con un consultorio ginecológico y psicológico con expertas que te ayudarán a responder todas tus dudas.
CONFIGURA V-APP SEGÚN TUS NECESIDADES
Puedes configurar Nosotras V-App de acuerdo a tus necesidades y etapas. Adapta tu perfil para seguir tu ciclo, buscar un embarazo o entender la premenopausia sin misterio.
Podrás modificar estas configuraciones cuando quieras.
RECIBE RECORDATORIOS:
Entra a tu perfil y activa tus recordatorios, que te permitirán estar al tanto del registro de tu ciclo, síntomas, señales, cambio de toallas higiénicas y más.
REGISTRA CAMBIOS EN TU CICLO MENSTRUAL DE MANERA FÁCIL
Agrega información relacionada con tu ciclo como: flujo, síntomas, estados de ánimo, actividad sexual, peso, entre otros.
LLEVA EL CONTROL DE TUS REPORTES:
Lleva el control de tu cuerpo con reportes de sueño, peso, actividad sexual, señales, entre otros, para comprender mejor los cambios que han ocurrido durante ciertos intervalos de tiempo y detectar cuando algo no está bien.
RECIBE CONSEJOS PERSONALIZADOS
Según los datos que registres en Nosotras V-App sobre tu edad, preferencias y ciclo menstrual, te enviaremos artículos y tips personalizados para acompañarte de forma integral en tu día a día, con temas como:
1. Consejos sobre el ser mujer de forma integral y holística
2. Artículos sobre sexualidad
3. Cuidado íntimo
4. Etapas de la vida
5. Salud femenina
6. Actividad física.
PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES SOBRE V-APP: CALENDARIO MENSTRUAL
¿Cómo ingreso mi nuevo período?
¡Es super fácil!, en la pantalla principal del menú inferior, en la opción “Hoy”, hay un botón que dice “Agregar período”, le das clic y te enviará a una pantalla donde podrás ver los meses, luego seleccionas el día en que empezó tu período, ¡y listo!
¿Cómo activar los recordatorios de la aplicación?
Para activar los recordatorios tienes que registrarte e ingresar tus datos. Una vez registrada, debes ir al menú inferior y en el botón “Perfil”, le das clic a “Recordatorios” para activarlos. ¡Será rápido!
¿Cómo ingresar señales y síntomas de días anteriores en Nosotras V-App: Calendario menstrual?
Ingresa por el menú inferior en el botón “Calendario”, señala la fecha previa en la que desees ingresar datos y dale clic en “Añade síntomas y señales de tu cuerpo”.
¿Dónde puedo ver los pronósticos de mi ciclo?
Si ingresas a tu Perfil por el menú inferior y luego en la parte de arriba le das clic en “Actualizar”, entrarás a una pantalla llamada “Actualizando mi perfil”, donde encontrarás todo acerca de ti y de tu ciclo. Ahí podrás ver los pronósticos de tu período y de tu ciclo que has ingresado en los últimos 6 meses.
