bluejetty:00122342:ios.description:
Would you rather is a casual trivia game where you can get to know your friends better while making very hard choices the whole night.
It's similar to “Never Have I Ever”, “Truth or Dare” and other party games.
Make your way through the questions, make impossible choices, this or that? The choice is yours.
There are 6 different decks filled with questions in the game that will help you use this game as an ideal:
- This or that
- Conundrum game
- For slumber party
- Party game for 2
Questions range from innocent and lovely to very difficult.
FEATURES
- 6 decks
- 850+ questions
- Dirty question
- Questions for kids
- Ability to make your own custom cards
If you are playing the game with kids make sure you don’t play with adult decks.
Would you Rather? Adult subscription:
- Gives user instant access to all existing and future cards and removes all ads.
- Subscriptions are from $2.99 weekly*
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access everything for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (weekly, monthly or yearly package)
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.

bluejetty:00153956:ios.description:
Drive fast cars through cities completing challenges and progressing to unlock more cars and environments. 
Which side will you choose?! Be the street racer or play as a cop to take down the racers!
Complete missions, stunts and unlock new cars to boost yourself to the top of the worldwide online leaderboards. Experience smooth realistic driving while you speed through city streets drifting around corners and smashing through competition with our softbody damage physics!
Progress through the street racer ranks completing drift missions, time trials, parkour challenges and speed traps. Unlock more vehicles or when you're ready switch teams and become a police officer equipped with police radio, siren and lights to chase down criminal street racers!
- [Next Level Handling] Dynamic driving feel with smooth realistic controls!
- [Enhanced Visuals] High quality vehicle visuals and street racing UI.
- [Turbocharged Stunts] Smart scoring & stunts, perform combos to rack up credits!
- [Mission Mayhem] Tons of mission rewards and leaderboards to show off your skills worldwide!
- [Police Patrols] Switch teams to play as a cop to take down the street racers!
- [Smooth Performance] High performance smooth racing experience across all devices.
Put the pedal to the metal reaching insane speeds, zoom past city city traffic and race around police, taxis and other traffic. Explore and complete missions to unlock faster & better sports and racing cars then show of your top times to the world with mission leaderboards!
Want to feel the experience of driving in realistic racing car game? Turn the key in the ignition and start burning tire rubber as you go from 0-60 in no time, perform drifts, stunt jump, and wreck your car with realistic vehicular body damage. Witness in real time every bump and scratch with each new car crash!

- Multiple open world cities to unlock
- Level builder, create and share custom levels online
- Awesome high speed sports cars to unlock

- Play as a street racer or switch to police mode to play as the cops

Piano Rythmia Tap Beats – Play the Ultimate Music Tiles Game! 
Step into the world of music and rhythm with Piano Rythmia Tap Beats, the addictive piano tiles game that lets you test your reflexes and sense of rhythm while enjoying your favorite songs. Whether you love classical piano melodies, trending EDM beats, or the latest K-pop hits, this game is made to keep your fingers dancing on the screen!

Tap the falling tiles in perfect rhythm to the music. Don’t miss a single beat or the game is over! The faster the song, the harder the challenge. Can you master the speed and claim the top score?
Features
 Wide Song Collection – Play trending tracks, relaxing piano melodies, and popular K-pop songs.
 Simple Yet Addictive Gameplay – Just tap the tiles to the rhythm, anyone can play!
 Fast & Challenging Levels – From easy beginner songs to extreme piano speed runs.
 Global Leaderboards – Compete with friends and players around the world.
 Headphones Recommended – Feel the real rhythm and immerse yourself in every beat.
 Offline Play Mode – Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, no internet needed.
 Why You’ll Love It
Piano Rythmia Tap Beats combines fun gameplay, trending music, and endless challenges into one. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a true music lover, you’ll never get bored. From calm piano melodies to high-energy K-pop tracks, there’s always a new rhythm waiting for you.
If you enjoy games like Piano Tiles, Magic Tiles, Beat Hop, or other rhythm tap games, this is your next favorite challenge!
 Start Your Rhythm Journey Today!
Download Piano Rythmia Tap Beats now and show your tapping skills to the beat of the world’s most popular music. Challenge your friends, unlock new songs, and become the ultimate piano master!
Are you ready to tap, play, and feel the music?

bluejetty:00075571:ios.description:
Meet our new browser which is great for multitasking.
Using our app you can watch videos and do your usual tasks on your phone at the same. This is made possible by our "Picture in Picture" mode. Just open any video in our browser, press the "pip" button and now you can check your mail, reply to your friends in messengers, use any of your apps, while the video from our browser will play in a small window that you can drag and drop wherever you want as well as change its size.
That's not all. Tired of not being able to listen to content from your favorite video portals on your lock screen? We have solved this problem. If you don't need to look at the screen, just lock it and the video will continue to play and you can listen to it.
Features:
Fast and easy to use browser.
Picture in Picture mode. With the ability to drag the screen to any place, change its size, pause, rewind.
Listening sound or music from the video on the locked screen.
PiP Timer. Use the timer that is always visible when you need to keep track of time while using other apps. You don't have to switch between apps like before.
PiP Watch. Time will always be visible, also when using other applications.
PiP Photo. Do you surf the Internet, chat on social networks, write notes and want your favorite photo to be be always in sight?
Then this feature is for you.
Favourites. Add an unlimited number of websites for fast access. Now you do not need to enter your favorite site manually every time. Aceess by one tap. With the possibility of removal.

You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00026631:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00026631:ios.description:
FIND. CHARGE. PAY. GO.
The ChargePoint app seamlessly connects drivers to the world’s largest EV charging network with hundreds of thousands of available stations and roaming partners to choose from. Finding, using and paying for charging your EV has never been easier. The ChargePoint app is the only all-in-one driver solution with smooth tech integrations and premium driver features so you can finally leave your wallet at home. Charge, drive and live better now with the ChargePoint app.
Download the ChargePoint app to:
FIND A PLACE TO CHARGE
Discover real-time charging station availability with the ChargePoint map.
CHARGE AT ROAMING PARTNER STATIONS
Use your ChargePoint app and account to charge at FLO, EVgo, Greenlot and EV Connect stations.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR STATION FILTERS
Use filters to see only stations that work with your car and filter for AC or DC fast chargers for maximum convenience.
SEE EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW
Find the most important information about a charging station, including station availability, pricing, popular times to charge, charging history, driver tips and more.
START CHARGING INSTANTLY
Begin charging via Tap to charge, directly in the ChargePoint app or with your RFID card.
TRACK YOUR COMPLETE CHARGING ACTIVITY
See your charging history and trends, including miles added and cost. Easily control both your public and home charging in a single app.
GET LIVE UPDATES
Receive real-time notifications and reminders about your charging status, including when a station becomes available, your car finishes charging and a charging session’s cost.
ENJOY CONVENIENT WIDGETS
Activate widgets to seamlessly find nearby stations, view your charging status, manage home charging and more without opening the app. Choose the right ChargePoint widgets for you from Lock screen, Home screen, StandBy mode and macOS.
LEARN FROM DRIVER TIPS
Get station advice complete with photos from other drivers to better navigate and enjoy ChargePoint’s global app and roaming network.
CHARGE AT HOME
Use the ChargePoint app to charge your EV at home with ChargePoint Home Flex. Schedule charging, set reminders, get notifications, track usage and more.
JOIN A VIRTUAL WAITLIST
Reserve a charging spot from anywhere via our virtual Waitlist feature.
MAXIMIZE CHARGING WITH YOUR APPLE WATCH
Tap to charge with your Apple Watch to start charging instantly and easily see miles added to your range.
LOCATE STATIONS AND MORE WITH CARPLAY
Easily access charging info while on the road with your CarPlay in-vehicle display.

熟語は中華文化の貴重な遺産です。古代の四字熟語は、深い哲学と文化的な背景を含んでおり、古代人の修身の必修科目でした。今では、「熟語クリア」を通じて、軽快な雰囲気の中で熟語の美しさを再び味わい、中華文化の広大な魅力を感じることができます。

【知恵極限に挑戦して、ポテンシャルを引き出す】

「熟語クリア」は、競争性、趣味性、知識性を兼ね備えたワードゲームです。散らばった文字を埋め込み、正しい四字熟語を構成して、ステージをクリアしていきます。初心者でも熟語の達人でも、言語力を磨くことができ、自分自身に挑戦し、知恵のポテンシャルを引き出すことができます。

【美しい画面、優雅な音楽、文化的な魅力を感じる】

「熟語クリア」は、古風で洗練されたゲーム画面と、美しく静かなゲーム音楽が備わっています。ゲームをプレイする中で、リラックスした気分で文化的な魅力を感じることができます。ゲーム操作は簡単で、ヒントやヘルプ機能があり、熟語の意味や背景をより深く理解することができます。過去を学び直して新しいことを学ぶことができます。「熟語クリア」で言語能力を向上させましょう。

「熟語クリア」に参加して、熟語の達人になり、知恵と楽しみを組み合わせた魅力的な経験を体験し、最高の栄誉に挑戦しましょう！

bluejetty:00068053:ios.description:
لعبة جوابك جوابهم هي لعبة اسئلة واجوبة وتحديات جماعية هدفك فيها الإجابة على الأسئلة، وكلما كانت إجابتك شائعة / مشهورة أكثر كلما زادت نقاطك! إذا كنت تبحث عن لعبة اسئلة أو العاب جماعية مع الأصدقاء، فهذه اللعبة تقدم لك تجربة حماسية وتنافسية ممتعة.
واثق من إجاباتك وسرعة بديهتك؟ استعد لأجواء مليئة بالتحدي في جلسة مع الأصدقاء أو العائلة. صمم شخصيتك الخاصة واجمع ستيكرات مميزة، وادخل منافسات في العاب اون لاين ضد لاعبين آخرين! من متابعي برامج مثل "تحدي العائلات" أو "فاميلي فيود"؟ العب وراح تعيش نفس أجواء الاسئلة الجماعية ولكن بأسلوب ممتع وسريع!
● أجواء حماسية
استمتع بأفضل لعبة جماعية تناسب كل جلسة، سواء كنت تلعب مع الأصدقاء أو العائلة.
● طور أونلاين تنافسي
العب مع لاعبين من حول العالم في العاب اون لاين ونافس للوصول إلى الصدارة.
● صمم شخصيتك الخاصة
خصص شخصيتك واجمع ستيكرات مميزة أثناء اللعب.
● لائحة الصدارة
اجمع النقاط واعتلِ الصدارة ليظهر اسمك وتحصل على التاج المميز.
● الغرفة الخاصة
أنشئ غرفتك الخاصة واعزم أصحابك للعب معك واكتشفوا من الأفضل بينكم.
أمثلة من الاسئلة:
شيء تأكله مع الرز؟
حيوان تشوفه في حديقة الحيوانات؟
شيء ما تقدر تطلع من البيت من دونه؟
معلومات عن اللعبة:
وقت اللعب: حوالي 3 دقائق
عدد اللاعبين (اونلاين): 2 - 20
جرب الآن "جوابك جوابهم" واستمتع بأفضل تجربة لعبة اسئلة جماعية مع الأصدقاء ضد الآخرين في العاب اون لاين!

Search for open positions in trusted facilities all over the country, chat with a team of experts as you navigate the hiring process, and track your shift hours easily.
GET WHERE YOU WANT TO GO FASTER

If you accept an offer through Nomad, you’ll have access to a robust benefits package, including full healthcare coverage, 401(k) matching, malpractice insurance, and travel reimbursement, among other exciting features.
Download today and get started.

bluejetty:00022377:ios.summary:
Do you remember this board game from your childhood?

bluejetty:00022377:ios.description:
Do you remember this board game from your childhood?
Checkers (Draughts) is a traditional and inspiring board game that gives you a lot of fun playing online multiplayer mode with people from all around the world. Relax and enjoy Checkers Online wherever you are. Share Checkers with kids and show them the best entertainment from your school days.
Are you a board game enthusiast? Would you like to create or think of a strategy to win? Checkers or Draughts will help you to learn and practice logical thinking. Multiplayer checkers mode will make the game even more fun!
With our app, you can:
- Play checkers for free
- Enjoy Checkers Online with multiplayer mode and play against random players according to the rules you like the most!
- Play Checkers Online with Blitz mode (really fast match)
- Use Hints online 
- Personalise your user profile in Checkers Online
*Checkers Online & No Registration*
Play Checkers Online with other users in just three steps:
1. Create a profile by choosing an avatar, the flag of your country, and entering your nickname.
2. Select the rules you want to play.
3. Start playing and enjoy the Checkers game.
Beat your opponents in multiplayer mode, improve your skills, and collect gold!
*Blitz mode - perfect for a break*
How to play the blitz mode? Tap “Online game”, find the Blitz mode, and play! Why Blitz mode? With a time control of 3 minutes and an additional 2 seconds per move, you will experience a faster, more dynamic, and truly exciting online checkers game mode! Stay focused ‘cause blitz checkers match can be really quick - think faster, win easier! 
*Checkers or Draughts variants and rules: online multiplayer*
There are many ways to play checkers (draughts). Everyone has various habits and usually prefers to play exactly the same way as they used to play checkers in the past; that is why you can decide on your favorite rules of this game.
*American Checkers or English Draughts* Capturing is mandatory, but the pieces cannot capture backward. The king can only move one square and can move and capture backward.
*International Draughts* Capturing is mandatory, and all the pieces can capture backward. The king has long moves, meaning the promoted piece can move any distance diagonally if the square is not blocked.
*Turkish Checkers: Dama*, also named Turkish Draughts. Both dark and light chessboard squares are used. Pieces start on the second and third rows of a game board; they do not move diagonally but forward and sideways. The way kings move is similar to the movement of queens in chess.
Play checkers online, decide whether you prefer a really fast blitz game or classic mode, and choose the rules you like the most (or you know from childhood).
Have a good game!
Best regards,
CC Games Team

bluejetty:00150598:ios.description:
Built for surfers chasing the Search. Track every wave from your Apple Watch, see yourself surf, and beat your mates to the best sessions.
The Rip Curl Search GPS app turns the watch on your wrist into a dedicated surf watch. Paddle out, hit start, and we'll log every wave you catch, every metre you paddle, every second in the water. No phone in the lineup. No extra hardware required. Just pure surf data, automatically.
Then come in and go deep. Replay your session wave by wave on a map of your break. See your top speed, your wave count, your distance. Watch yourself surf back on Surfline Cam
Rewind at supported spots. Climb the leaderboard at your Home Break in Boss of the Break®. Share your best moments to socials and let your crew know exactly how the session went.
Built by surfers, for surfers. Trusted at every level from your first barrel to our crew on tour.
What's in the app
• Real-time surf conditions powered by Surfline
• Automatic wave tracking on Apple Watch and Rip Curl Search GPS Watch
• Wave count, paddle count, top speed, distance, and duration for every session
• Wave-by-wave session replays with break maps and full analytics
• Surfline Cam Rewind at supported breaks. Watch yourself surf, frame by frame
• Boss of the Break® leaderboards at your Home Break
• Achievements, stats, and bragging rights for your crew
The Fine Print
• Available in participating regions only.
• Surf Tracking requires a subscription, with a free trial. Cancel anytime before it ends via Settings > Subscriptions on your iPhone.
• Boss of the Break®: To compete, you'll need a public account and a selected Home Break (you can update this anytime in Account Settings).
• Surfline Cam Rewind: Available via the Surfline app and requires a Surfline account.
For FAQs and support: https://www.ripcurl.com/pages/watch-instructions-support
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.ripcurl.com/pages/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00019409:ios.description:
"DEFINITELY amongst the 10 BEST adventure games of ALL TIME" - ACG (Adventure Classic Gaming)
“An instant classic. You won’t regret playing it.” – Adventure Gamers
There are some things that kids just shouldn't have to put up with. Being transported to some weird dimension full of goblins, dwarves, swamplings, stupid wizards and sleeping giants is definitely one of them.
After escaping a "welcoming party", Simon discovers that he has been brought on a quest to rescue the wizard Calypso from the evil sorcerer Sordid.
In the last 25 years, the 'Simon the Sorcerer' game series has made millions of players fall in love with Simon.
Now you can relive the renowned original adventure in a whole new way!
'Simon The Sorcerer: 25th Anniversary Edition' features:
- Totally new, much praised, game play controls that were built from the ground up for touch-screens.
* Hotspot based - no more pixel hunting! 
* All-new slick icons and animations.
* For more details, please see our tutorial video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JFp03nw_yyA&hd=1
- Completely new game menus and save/load system
- Three Music options: New stereo recording and the Original music in MT-32 or Adlib 
- High-end graphics upscaling (xBR filter) for high-resolution displays
- Optional retro settings: play with original graphics, original music and even the original controls (mouse pointer)
- Multiple languages (ALL included without additional payment):
English voice acting, with the option for adding subtitles in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian and Hebrew
German voice acting or subtitles-only
- GREAT PURCHASE! The best and most affordable way to experience this timeless classic
The 25th Anniversary Edition produced and developed by MojoTouch © 2008-2025 all rights reserved.

Uses ScummVM which is protected under GNU-GPL v2. For more information please visit http://mojo-touch.com/gpl

 • Get starte
bluejetty:00122150:ios.description:
Overview
 • The SYFY app is the best place to catch up on the most recent season of your favorite shows, watch live TV, and stream movies and past season content, including Revival, Face Off, Paranormal Witness, AND MANY MORE!
 • Get started by signing in with your TV subscription (cable, satellite, or digital). The SYFY app supports most TV providers, including DirecTV, Spectrum, Xfinity, Dish, and AT&T.
App Features
 Watch Your Way
 • Watch the latest episodes of new SYFY shows the day after they air on TV.
 • Live stream and schedule available 24/7 when signed in with your TV provider.
 Explore Versant Content
 • Access to on-demand content from across the Versant family of networks (including USA, SYFY, E!, Oxygen, MSNOW, CNBC, and Golf Channel).
 • Don't miss a second of the Premier League, the WNBA, A10 hoops, the PGA and LPGA Tours, and NASCAR!
 • Live stream your favorite Versant networks within the app.
 • Dedicated page for each network showcasing the hottest series.
 • Stream recent and throwback favorites, like Law & Order: SVU, Chicago Fire, Chicago P.D., and Chicago Med.
 • Filter shows by network and genre while browsing. 
 TV Provider Access
 • Sign in with your TV subscription to gain access to the entire catalog of VOD and Live content.
Availability Notice
 • Versant's family of networks are only available to stream in the US and US territories.
 • Those outside the US will be unable to watch full episodes or live TV.
 • If you're traveling, you'll regain full access as soon as you return to the US.
Comments or Questions
 • Please fill out our contact support form at https://help.versantmedia.com/s/contactsupport for assistance.
 • Please note: Use of the app is limited to the United States and its territories. Video is accessible via 3G, 4G, LTE, and Wi-Fi networks. Data charges may apply.
 • Privacy Policy: https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy 
 • Your Privacy Choices: https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy/cookies 
 • CA Notice: https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy/california-consumer-privacy-act

bluejetty:00149678:ios.description:
Are you applying for the New York CDL permit driver’s license test certification? Use this app to prepare, practice and pass CDL permit test for New York state and get driver's license on the first go. 
This app includes questions based on official New York CDL state manual. The app allows you to prepare and practice for the Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) test for New York state and all practice tests are based on the latest manuals. So if you are searching for CDL driver’s license test preparation – this is the perfect CDL driver’s license test practice app for you. This app is a handbook manual to practice and prepare for CDL Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is designed keeping in mind the learning needs of a user applying for a driving license and driver’s license test and best learning practices established by researchers. It makes preparing for the driving permit test more enjoyable and fun. Users using this application finds it very easy to answer the questions asked in real CDL permit driver’s license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the facilities provided by the app.
- Practice tests design specially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- Keep your progress for each practice test and view history. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Practice tests for Commercial Vehicle (CDL) driver’s license test.
- Exceptionally large set of practice questions which covers every aspects of the driver’s license test.
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

“Aplicativo excelente! Sem dúvida a melhor aquisição para o processo de Introdução Alimentar! Todo conteúdo é maravilhoso e muito fácil de entender, além das dicas de receitas e como lidar com cada fase da IA! Ajuda muito os pais a lidarem com o medo de oferecer os alimentos! Por aqui, amamos! Parabéns a toda equipe por esse app maravilhoso!”
MayMoPeu 
Melhor app de Introdução alimentar
“Esse app é incrível e completo. Me sinto totalmente segura, informada e preparada através do conteúdo disponibilizado no aplicativo. Tem receitas, cardápios, artigos sobre os mais diversos assuntos em torno da IA. Queria um app tão completo pra alimentação de adultos. :D Melhor investimento que fiz! Nota 1000!”
—
Não esqueça de seguir a gente no Instagram @BlwBrasilApp 
—
Essa é a sua chance de virar especialista na alimentação do seu bebê. Este aplicativo foi feito para ajudar pais, pediatras e nutricionistas a se apoiarem sobre como fazer a introdução alimentar dos bebês acima dos 6 meses por meio da abordagem BLW (Baby-led Weaning) ou também oferecendo alimentos amassados, sempre respeitando a autonomia e desenvolvimento do bebê. 
Somos um time de mais de 20 mulheres empenhadas a trazer tudo que há de mais atual no universo da nutrição infantil. Pediatras, nutricionistas materno-infantis, fonoaudióloga, e outros profissionais de saúde.
Nosso aplicativo é totalmente livre de anúncios e venda de produtos aleatórios. Baixe gratuitamente!
Nele você vai encontrar um guia super completo, além de mais de 650 receitas, cardápios feitos por nutricionistas e muito mais. 
- Temos receitas para café da manhã, almoço, lanche e jantar. Você pode filtrar as receitas de acordo com alergias, preferências, tempo de preparo, complexidade e ingredientes. Poderá também salvar as suas receitas favoritas e organizá-las em pastas!
- A seção de alimentos, totalmente gratuita, vai te ensinar como oferecer cada alimento para seu bebê. Modo de preparo e apresentação para cada fase da introdução alimentar, com fotos e vídeos.
- Com nossos cardápios você saberá exatamente o que oferecer ao bebê, gradativamente, mês a mês. Temos opções para crianças veganas e vegetarianas e também cardápio de lancheirinhas. Tudo feito pelo nosso time de nutricionistas. 
- Guias nutricionais e específicos abordam temas importantes como gag e engasgo, amamentação durante a Introdução Alimentar, como começar, seletividade alimentar, entre outros. Além de guias sobre como higienizar alimentos, praticidade na cozinha e como congelar.
Como funciona o BLW Brasil:
Versão gratuita: acesso a toda seção de alimentos, cardápio de lancheirinha, diversos guias nutricionais e quizzes.
Versão premium: acesse +650 receitas, cardápios para cada fase do bebê, checklist de alimentos e acesso completo a todos os guias. Disponível nos planos mensal e anual, com possibilidade de teste grátis.
Sua assinatura renova automaticamente, mas você pode cancelar a qualquer momento, em dois cliques. A loja de aplicativos envia um email de confirmação da compra. É possível desativar a renovação automática nas definições de assinatura após a compra. Todas as informações sobre cobrança estão detalhadas no próprio app e na loja.
Baixe agora e experimente grátis!
Este aplicativo foi criado para pessoas que falam português. Se você mora em um país onde o idioma é o inglês e deseja receitas e cardápios dessa cultura, baixe nosso app BLW Meals. Ou se o idioma for espanhol, baixe o nosso app BLW Ideas.
Se tiver alguma dúvida contate-nos através do e-mail oi@blwbrasilapp.com.br, teremos o maior prazer em ajudar. :)
Termos de Uso:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IbCPD9wFab3HBIujvM3q73YP-ErIib0zbtABdDpZ09U/edit

bluejetty:00093846:ios.name: Screw Block Escape
bluejetty:00093846:ios.summary:
Screw Block Escape: Slide, match, and clear the color blocks.
Screw Block Escape welcomes you to a bright color block jam where every move matters. Guide colorful blocks toward their matching gates, open the right path, and turn a crowded
bluejetty:00093846:ios.description:
Screw Block Escape: Slide, match, and clear the color blocks.
Screw Block Escape welcomes you to a bright color block jam where every move matters. Guide colorful blocks toward their matching gates, open the right path, and turn a crowded block puzzle into a satisfying block blast. The controls are simple, but finding the perfect order creates a rewarding block buster challenge for fans of puzzle games and brain games.
Easy to start, satisfying to master
Tap a block to move it in the direction of its arrow. Watch the board carefully, keep important spaces open, and build the right block escape route one step at a time.
The color sort mechanic makes each goal clear: every color block must reach a gate of the same color. As the levels progress, new obstacles, keys, locks, and narrow paths appear. The no timer adds excitement, while every successful solution ends with a smooth block crush moment.
A fresh board every time
No two layouts feel exactly the same, even with features such as timer or no-timer. Each color block jam introduces a new arrangement to read and a new sequence to discover. One piece may look ready to leave, but moving it too early can trap another behind it.
That is what makes every block puzzle feel rewarding. Bright brick-style pieces and clear arrows keep the board easy to understand, while polished movement and effects make every block blast feel crisp and satisfying.
Become a block buster
Early levels help you learn the rhythm naturally. Later challenges ask you to plan several moves ahead, protect each exit, and rethink your approach when the obvious route fails.
Use your block buster instincts to stay calm under the timer, avoid blocking key spaces, and create a clean block crush sequence. A difficult board may take several attempts, but the final solution always feels earned.
Why you’ll enjoy it
- Strategic color block jam gameplay with colorful levels
- Handcrafted block puzzle layouts that grow in difficulty
- Smooth block blast effects after a successful clear
- Challenging block buster objectives for strategy fans
- Relaxing color sort rules with meaningful decisions
- Bright and colorful brick pieces and polished 3D visuals
- Engaging brain games for quick or extended sessions
- Intuitive controls that are easy to learn
Players who enjoy puzzle games and the spatial thinking of tetris-style classics will find a different kind of challenge here—one built around directions, colors, timing, and route planning.
Your next route is waiting
Every color block jam has a solution. Read the arrows, test a path, and adjust your plan when the board changes. Whether you play for a quick break or stay for a tougher challenge, there is always another clever layout to solve.
Download Screw Block Escape today. Master every block puzzle, complete the perfect route, enjoy a colorful block blast, and discover how satisfying a smart solution can be!

listings.description:
האפליקציה של בנק מרכנתיל,
יותר ממה שהיית מצפה מאפליקציה בנקאית...
הזדהות קלה ונוחה, העברת מזומן (גם לאנשי קשר, גם באופן קבוע וגם במועד עתידי), המרות והעברות מט"ח, הפקדת שיקים, קבלת הלוואה מידית, הפקדה לפיקדון, פעולות בכרטיס אשראי, מה קורה עם המשכנתא, מעקב אחר תיק ניירות ערך ועוד...
ובנוסף, עוד מגוון שירותים שלא היית מצפה מאפליקציה בנקאית:
•	דידי – נציגה דיגיטלית שזמינה 24/7 כדי לעזור לנווט באפליקציה, לקבל מידע ולבצע פעולות
•	תובנות מעניינות על מה קורה בחשבון, כמו חיוב כפול לבית עסק, ניתוח הוצאות והכנסות חודשי, סיכום ההוצאות בחו"ל והתראות על שינוי בהרגלי ההוצאה
וזו רק ההתחלה
יש עוד דברים טובים בדרך כמו הזמנת פגישה עם בנקאי ועוד...
האפליקציה חינמית ומיועדת ללקוחות מרכנתיל בלבד!

تطبيق بنك مركنتيل
اكثر من المتوقع من تطبيق بنكي ...
تعريف الدخول سهل ومريح ,تحويل النقود (وايضاً تحويل لقائمة الاتصال بأمر ثابت او تحديد وقت لتحويل بالمستقبل ), صرف عملات و حوالات بعملات أجنبية, ادخال شيكات, حصول على قرض مباشر , اداع للتوفير, عمليات ببطاقة الاعتماد, متابعة القرض الاسكاني . 
لمتابعة ملف الاوراق المالية  خاصتك وعمليات أخرى 
وأيضاً, العديد من الخدمات لم تتوقعها من تطبيق بنكي :
-	دي دي – مندوب رقمي متاح 24/7 للمساعدة باستعمال التطبيق, للحصول على معلومات ولتنفيذ العمليات 
-	تحليلات مهمة عن حسابك, مثلا دفع مزدوج لمصلحه, تحليل المدفوعات والدخل الشهري, تلخيص النفقات خارج البلاد وتحذر عن أي  تغيرات في عادات المصروفات 
-	العديد من العمليات من الممكن تنفيذها مباشرة بواسطة  Siri
هذه فقط البداية
هناك المزيد من الامور الجيدة بالتطوير, مثلا تحديد لقاء مع موظف 
يُعطى هذا التطبيق كخدمة مجانية لزبائن بنك مركنتيل فقط

bluejetty:00147198:ios.name: Habit List
bluejetty:00147198:ios.summary:
Create good habits. Break bad ones. Build a better you. Habit List includes everything you need to reach your goals, wrapped in a beautiful and intuitive interface. It motivates you, helps you stay focused, and keeps you on track.
Get moti
bluejetty:00147198:ios.description:
Create good habits. Break bad ones. Build a better you. Habit List includes everything you need to reach your goals, wrapped in a beautiful and intuitive interface. It motivates you, helps you stay focused, and keeps you on track.
Get motivated with streaks — Keeping streaks alive is a powerful motivator. See how high you can go, then try to beat your personal best. Red badges mean you've slacked and need to get back on track. Yellow badges show up after a streak ends, indicating it's time to recommit to building a new one. Gray badges are optional, missing them won’t break your streak. Green means go, complete it today!
Focus on what’s due — No need to wade through all your habits to figure out what to do, Habit List only shows what’s due today. And you can set the default order for your habits, so items that you’ll complete first are at the top of your list. Habit List's beautiful, distraction-free design keeps you focused and on task.
Stay on track with reminders and badges — Habits are powerful because they’re automatic, but while you’re building routines, reminders are indispensable. App badges show the number of remaining habits for the day, great for reminding you to complete your list. You can even set a daily review reminder to get in the habit of using the app.
View trends over time — Step back and see the big picture with weekly and monthly completion percentages. Bar colors range from green to red and give a visual indicator of how you’re doing.
Flexible scheduling — Choose from 3 kinds of schedules: Specific Days, Non-specific Days, or Intervals. So you can schedule your workouts M-W-F, bring lunch to work any 4 days per week, or write a blog post every 2-3 days. No matter what kind of habit you're building, Habit List has you covered.
Track your progress — See your history at a glance and gain insight into what's working—or isn't. Always miss your Friday workout? Maybe a different day or early morning routine would work better. Habit List also tracks your personal best (longest streak) and total completions.
No detail too small — Need to track multiple times per day habits, like drinking 8 glasses of water? No problem. Going on vacation? Skip habits without breaking your streak. Miss a habit early in the day? Mark it as missed to keep your list uncluttered. You can also change the week start date, use light or dark mode, and keep things private with a passcode or touch ID. Speaking of privacy, we don’t require you to set up an account, don’t track your habits, and your personal data is 100% private.
Try Habit List for free — Your first three habits are on us. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited habits, passcode/touch ID lock, dark mode, and support future development.

bluejetty:00154942:ios.summary: LingUp is your personal AI tutor for English, Spanish, German, French and Turkish. Talk with it, follow a clear path of lessons, practice real-life situations and get help with the book you study in class, with explanations in your own lang
bluejetty:00154942:ios.description:
LingUp is your personal AI tutor for English, Spanish, German, French and Turkish. Talk with it, follow a clear path of lessons, practice real-life situations and get help with the book you study in class, with explanations in your own language.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Talk: speak with an AI tutor about anything, any time, and pick the tutor you like.
Video call: turn the conversation into a video call. Your tutor fills the screen, answers out loud and listens while you speak, with captions of every word.
Lessons: a clear path that starts at your level, with new words and grammar in every lesson.
Roleplay: job interviews, airports, restaurants and small talk, at your level.
My book: add the book you study in class, snap a page and practice its exercises right away, with hints and help in your language.
Words: keep any word you tap and review it later.
Grammar: every topic in one place, with short notes and practice.
FIX MISTAKES AS YOU SPEAK
Your tutor points out grammar and pronunciation mistakes without stopping the conversation. You get a score for each word and a reason for each mistake, and your mistakes come back in later practice until you get them right.
LEARN IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Stuck on a word? Say it in your own language and keep going. LingUp explains words and grammar in more than 50 native languages.
FOR EVERY LEVEL
Beginner, intermediate or advanced: tell us your level and your goal, and your path starts there. See your progress after every lesson.
WHY PRACTICE WITH AN AI TUTOR
Available day and night, with no appointments.

Interval Run is a running interval timer for iPhone and Apple Watch. Create run/walk intervals, sprint sessions, and HIIT workouts in seconds. Train with voice announcements and haptic cues, control workouts from Apple Watch, save sessions to Apple Health, and track your workout history.
Choose from 25+ ready-made running workouts or build your own. Follow intervals from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, and focus on your run.
25+ READY-MADE RUNNING WORKOUTS
• Explore run/walk workouts, running intervals, sprints, hill repeats, tempo runs, fartlek sessions, ladders, pyramids, and more
• Find workouts for speed, endurance, recovery, and different training goals
• Start any workout immediately or customize it to match your training
• Save your favorites to My Workouts for quick access
BUILD YOUR OWN INTERVAL WORKOUT
• Create simple run/walk intervals or advanced multi-step workouts
• Add warm-up, running, walking, recovery, rest, and cool-down sections
• Set a custom duration for every step
• Repeat intervals and complete workout blocks
• Add custom cues to guide you through each workout step
• Build sprint, HIIT, cardio, and structured running sessions
• Save multiple workouts and reuse them anytime
• Preview the complete workout before you start
VOICE & HAPTIC INTERVAL CUES
• Hear clear voice announcements at every interval transition
• Feel haptic cues when it’s time to run, walk, recover, or rest
• Keep your workout active while your iPhone is locked or the app is in the background
• Follow your current interval from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities
• Listen to music, podcasts, or audiobooks while you train
RUN WITH APPLE WATCH
• Sync workouts to Apple Watch
• Start, pause, and control workouts directly from your wrist
• Run phone-free with your workouts ready on Apple Watch
• Follow interval progress without repeatedly checking your phone
• Track heart rate, distance, and active energy during your workout
• Get haptic interval cues directly on your Watch
• Save completed workouts to Apple Health
TRACK YOUR TRAINING
• Browse completed workouts in calendar and history views
• Review workout duration, intervals, distance, and active energy
• Look back at your running and interval training over time
• Share your workout results
• Export and restore backups of your workout data
MADE FOR RUNNERS WHO TRAIN WITH INTERVALS
Whether you’re starting with beginner run/walk intervals, adding speed work to your weekly training, preparing for a 5K or another race, or creating a challenging HIIT session, Interval Run keeps every interval clear from start to finish.
Use it as a simple run/walk timer, a running interval timer for speed training, an Apple Watch interval timer for phone-free workouts, or a flexible workout builder for more advanced structured sessions.
From beginner run/walk workouts to sprints, tempo runs, hill repeats, fartlek training, and custom multi-step sessions, Interval Run adapts to the way you train.
Start with one of 25+ ready-made workouts or create your own. Interval Run handles the timing so you can focus on your training.
Some features shown, including the full workout library, advanced workout creation, multiple saved workouts, and full workout history, require Interval Run Pro.

bluejetty:00100791:ios.summary: Kur'an-ı Azimüşşan'ın basımı için kurulmuş matbaa tesislerinde gerekli hürmet ve ihtimamla, özel olarak yetiştirilmiş çalışanlarla neşredilen Tevafuklu Kur'an-ı Kerim, yine titiz bir çalışmanın neticesi olarak iPhone' lara yüklenmek
bluejetty:00100791:ios.description:
Kur'an-ı Azimüşşan'ın basımı için kurulmuş matbaa tesislerinde gerekli hürmet ve ihtimamla, özel olarak yetiştirilmiş çalışanlarla neşredilen Tevafuklu Kur'an-ı Kerim, yine titiz bir çalışmanın neticesi olarak iPhone' lara yüklenmek için Apple Store'da yerini aldı.
Merhûm Ahmed Husrev Efendi’nin dünyâda ilk defa tevâfuklu olarak yazdığı 
orijinal nüshanın tıpkı basımı. Âyetberkenâr yazıları net ve okunuşu kolay Kur’ân-ı Kerîm. Bu Mushaf ile hem Kur’ân’ı yeni öğrenen, hem de her yaştan insanımız artık rahatlıkla Kur’ân okuya-bilmektedir.
Temel Özellikler:
1- Tam sayfa Kur'an okuma hem yatay hem de dikey mod,
2- Yüksek çözünürlük, sayfalar hem yatay hem de dikey modda en guzel ve rahat orjinal yazımı bozmadan okunacak şekilde yerleştirildi, 
3- Kur'an sayfalarını seçmeli olarak 6 farklı hafızın sesinden dinleyebileceksiniz.
4- Hatim takip için 5 ayrı sık kullanılanlar imgesi,
5- Ana menüden istenilen sayfa, cüz ya da sureye gitme.
6- Secde ayetleri zemin renkli ve secde ayeti uyarılı
7- Hayrat Neşriyat Meali
Proğramın ipad güncellemesi yakında yayınlanacaktır. "Kur'an-ı Kerim - Ipad için" ismi ile App Store de yayınlanmaktadır.
ios@hayteknoloji.com

bluejetty:00143469:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00143469:ios.description:
Meditatio est une application de méditation chrétienne qui vous aide à développer une relation intime avec Dieu jour après jour. 
À une époque où la méditation est souvent associée aux philosophies orientales, Meditatio vous invite à replonger dans la Bible et dans 2000 ans de tradition chrétienne en matière de méditation. 
Avec Meditatio, vous pouvez :
- Nouer une relation d’intimité avec Dieu au quotidien
- Développer une vie intérieure plus riche
- Retrouver votre paix intérieure
- Enforcer l’unité corps-âme-esprit
- Découvrir la force du silence
Concrètement, Meditatio vous propose des centaines de méditations guidées sur des thématiques variées : 
- Méditations autour des grands temps liturgiques chrétiens : Carême et Avent
- Verset du jour : Chaque jour, une méditation sur le verset du jour de la Sainte Bible
- La Lectio Divina : apprenez à pratiquer la Lectio Divina, une méthode très ancienne de méditation de la Bible
- L’oraison : une forme de prière silencieuse très ancienne développée au sein de l’ordre du Carmel
- Autres traditions chrétiennes de méditation : Pères du désert, méditation ignatienne, prière de Jésus…
- Surmonter l’anxiété : méditer pour se décharger de ses sources d’anxiété et recevoir une grâce de confiance en soi et sérénité
- Bible audio : les quatre Évangiles de la Bible en audio, psaumes, Évangile du jour, verset du jour
- Développer la confiance en soi : des exercices de la méthode chrétienne Vittoz pour améliorer l’estime de soi et la confiance en soi
- Louer Dieu avec des psaumes de louange : beaux psaumes à méditer pour louer Dieu, ou psaumes pour traverser une épreuve
- Améliorer son sommeil : terminer sa journée dans la prière pour se détendre en confiant son sommeil à Dieu et enfin mieux dormir.
- Contenu pour les enfants à partir de 4 ans : méditations face à des émotions fortes, histoires des grands personnages de la Bible
- Histoires bibliques : la naissance de Jean-Baptiste qui prépare la naissance de Jésus, sur les pas de Moïse, la Création et beaucoup d’autres…
- La prière du Chapelet : prier le chapelet et ses mystères 
Nous travaillons avec des laïcs, prêtres catholiques, pasteurs évangélique et des religieux des différentes confessions chrétiennes.
« Notre but est de faire connaître à tous la richesse de la tradition chrétienne sur ce sujet, d’une façon abordable pour nos contemporains, en visant en particulier les “chrétiens non institutionnels”, qui ne mettent plus forcément les pieds à l’Église »
Jeanne et Thomas Delenda, fondateurs de Meditatio.
Quelques avis de nos utilisateurs :
« Votre application réunit authenticité, beauté, calme et progression . Elle invite sans imposer, sans vendre… elle propose du sur-mesure et encourage. J’adore ! Dieu revient doucement dans ma vie et mes peurs lâchent tout naturellement, déjà !!!!!!!!! Merci. »
« Enfin, une vraie alternative chrétienne aux applications de méditation classiques »
« Le contenu est simplement magnifique et ressourçant. J'écoute l'évangile et je médite chaque matin au réveil ou en me rendant au travail. »
« Une application très bien faite, un pur bonheur. C'est un véritable plaisir de découvrir chaque jour l'évangile, les méditations sont très bien faites »
« Grâce à Meditatio, j'arrive à prendre un vrai temps de cœur à cœur avec Dieu chaque jour et ça change ma vie ! »
« les méditations sur les textes et les prières sont vraiment puissantes »
« Meditatio est vraiment la parfaite liaison entre la méditation et la prière »
« Ce que vous avez fait en créant cette appli est juste incroyable ! Elle est d’une grande richesse dans bien des domaines et nous apporte beaucoup quand nous traversons des périodes difficiles ! »
Téléchargez Meditatio dès aujourd’hui et commencez votre chemin vers une relation avec Dieu plus intime, sereine et intérieure.

bluejetty:00066277:ios.description:
The game requires minimum 2 GB RAM. Supported devices: iPhone 6S or newer, iPad 2017 or newer. All older devices (iPhone 5, iPhone 6, iPad Mini, iPad Air) are not supported and will not work correctly.
The game is set in virtual 3D Tokyo and focused on anime and otaku culture. After being transferred to a new school, you have a goal of getting new friends, exploring the city together during various activities. This is a school and friendship simulator game, combining gameplay of visual novels and sandbox-style city exploration adventure.
Features
* Studying - you'll have to study at school, getting grades every day and improving your stats.
* Working - to earn money, you'll have to take part-time jobs in cafe or in the local Shinto shrine.
* Various locations for exploring and activities - school, Shinto shrine, amusement park, Akihabara.
* Apartment room customisation - you can buy furniture and items to decorate your anime room.
* Shopping for clothes, accessories, food, snacks, toys.
* Cooking - you'll have to cook food for your friends, by using recipes and combining various food ingredients.
* Cosplay and customization - you can dress your character and your friends using different clothes and accessories.
* Unique girls - all characters have different likes and dislikes.
* UFO catchers where you can obtain anime figurines and put them on display in your apartment room.

bluejetty:00076495:ios.summary: CaringBridge is a no-cost, 501(c)(3) nonprofit health platform that surrounds family caregivers with support while they care for a loved one on a health journey. A donor-supported nonprofit founded in 1997, the organization offers tools to
bluejetty:00076495:ios.description:
CaringBridge is a no-cost, 501(c)(3) nonprofit health platform that surrounds family caregivers with support while they care for a loved one on a health journey. A donor-supported nonprofit founded in 1997, the organization offers tools to share and document a health journey, simplify care coordination, and connect caregivers with a supportive community. CaringBridge addresses feelings of overwhelm, isolation, and loneliness by improving emotional health and social connectedness, helping people come together in support of healing. With over 300,000 people on the platform every day sending or receiving support, there are over 1,600 messages of love, hope, and compassion posted every hour. And every 12 minutes a new CaringBridge page is started. The CaringBridge community includes all 50 states and more than 242 countries around the world. To learn more visit www.caringbridge.org.
Private, protected, and ad-free
· A trusted, private, and ad-free space that only a nonprofit like CaringBridge can provide to support family caregivers and their loved ones on a health journey. 
Communicate to everyone all at once
· Communicate to everyone all at once in a safe and private space, relieving the burden of individually updating people. 
Capture and process every step of the health journey
· The very act of capturing a loved one’s health journey improves emotional health and social support.
Coordinate care with family and friends
· Making it easy to ask for help, because we know it’s often the most difficult thing to ask for.

bluejetty:00137990:ios.description:
Solitaire Riches: Set sail for fortune and adventure!
Game Overview
Welcome to Solitaire Riches, a thrilling fusion of classic solitaire and daring exploration. Step into the boots of a fearless pirate captain and follow ancient treasure maps to uncover hidden riches. Every flip of a card could spark your next big win, and every victory brings you closer to real cash rewards. The adventure begins—are you ready to claim your treasure?
Core Gameplay
At its heart, Solitaire Riches features timeless Solitaire gameplay. Flip, stack, and arrange cards strategically to master each challenge and uncover your path to fortune. Every move tests your focus and skill as you sail through waves of excitement. The smooth rhythm and clever mechanics make every playthrough both relaxing and rewarding—where classic card play meets thrilling treasure hunting.
Art Style
Solitaire Riches brings a vivid pirate adventure theme to life. Golden chests, ancient maps, mysterious islands, and deep blue seas create a world full of wonder. The sails flap in the wind, jewels gleam under the sun, and every match feels like a voyage toward a legendary island of gold. bluejetty:00184719:ios.description:
Looking for the ultimate mental escape?
Welcome to Sudoku by Volcano—the world’s most vibrant puzzle community! From thrilling global tournaments to infinite player-created grids, your daily brain workout just got a major upgrade. Perfect for a 5-minute coffee break or hours of deep logic training, our classic and innovative puzzles offer endless fun for everyone, from beginners to grandmasters. 
With 365 days of Daily Puzzles, international rankings, and endless creative challenges, your mind will always stay sharp! 
◆ Why Choose Sudoku by Volcano?
We offer a premium, feature-rich experience that no other classic puzzle app can match: 
• NEW! Puzzle Workshop: Step into our thriving creator community! You are no longer just a player—you are a puzzle designer. Create your own custom grids from scratch, scan them directly from a newspaper, share your masterpieces with the world, and play infinite unique puzzles crafted by global players. 
• Champions Challenge & Global Leaderboards: Battle logic enthusiasts worldwide in thrilling daily competitions. Track your rank against millions of active players, win exclusive rewards, and climb to the top spot to earn your bragging rights as a true Sudoku Champion. 
• Non-Stop Daily Challenges: Never miss a day of mental fitness. Log in daily to solve unique, hand-crafted puzzles, build your consecutive win streaks, and collect gorgeous monthly trophies and champion badges. 
• Exclusive Hint System (Sudoku Solver): This is not just a cheat sheet! Our intelligent system teaches you advanced solving techniques step-by-step with intuitive instructions, colorful visuals, and elegant animations. Go from beginner to expert in no time. 
◆ Core Game Features & Variations
Enjoy 8 tailored difficulty levels—from Very Easy to Extreme—alongside multiple ways to play: 
• 10 Brain Teaser Variations: Challenge yourself with Squiggly, X-Sudoku, Color puzzles, and alternative grid layouts. 
• Daily Puzzle Archive: Missed a day? Access past Daily Challenges from the archive to complete your trophy collection anytime. 
• Career Statistics: Access detailed profile stats to track your logic improvement, win streaks, and best solve times. 
• Beautiful Visuals: Personalize your board with stunning designs and alternative numerals, including Chinese numbers. 
• Offline Mode: Enjoy your favorite mindsport anywhere, anytime—no internet connection required for official packs and saved daily grids. 
◆ Smart Tools & Quality of Life
Maximize your solving efficiency while protecting your eyes during night-time play: 
• Intelligent Assist: Auto-highlighting of identical numbers, automatic pencil marks, and real-time error checking. 
• Standard Tools: Unlimited Undo & Redo, Double-Tap Erase, and smart drafting notes. 
• Seamless Convenience: Auto-Save ensures you never lose progress when life interrupts your game. Toggle Dark Mode for a more comfortable night-time experience. 
• Universal Design: Stunning high-resolution graphics optimized perfectly for both iPhone and iPad. 
Download the ultimate Sudoku experience today! Wake up your brain with a fresh Daily Challenge, unleash your creativity in the Puzzle Workshop, and see where you stand on the global stage!

bluejetty:00024879:ios.description:
Life Choices returns with improved graphics, new storylines and more choices. Return to Unicoville and make crucial choices to shape the lives of its residents. A little bit life a little bit choices. This game is more about the decisions. Hell heaven game is one of the best game in the world.
Lots of new characters are introduced that will allow players to get into their home lives. Choices made by the players will shape the fate of the town. Like robust life simulator games, Life Choices 2 offers a glimpse into adult life. Life simulator game is a free offline game. Life is a game! Play adorable angel and devil girls. It is little bit simulator but mostly story of heaven and hell.
With the new progression system, players will complete a life in each level by completing the character’s 3 tasks. Successful completion will give rewards and these rewards can be used to customize the town in various ways. If you like simulator games and story games this good girl bad girl game is very adorable.
Play the lives of Unicoville citizens and uncover their secrets. Choose their fates and simulate all aspects of their home life. Each character has 3 tasks to complete and this is related to the 1000 of choices available to the players. Choose your life and make your decision on your life. angel and devil games in an adorable life simulator.
Bit life fans will love the opportunity to live a life of their own. Like 100 years life simulator games, Life Choices 2 is all about choices and freedom. College life and free life are a vital part of this new game.
Once again, you will cast the wand of fate upon the sims that are simulated by the game. Will you climb the stairway to heaven or push your characters into hell? With the inappropriate karma system, maximum freedom of choice is presented as a live simulator. With the new simulation system, Life Choices 2 allows players to get into another life.
If doing a math test or a moron test is not enough for you, come and play my study life in Life Choices 2. Make impactful choices and see how it is to live another life. Don’t expect any bit lofe or bitlufe as instlife takes over simalator games in Life Choices 2. 
Choice games usually limit players’ sims into teasers and triviacracks. But Life Choices 2 presents 100 years life simulator experience without any choice limits. Make choices which will shape the destiny of Unicoville residents. Do roleplay your way into a mafia life or a college life. As one of the most diverse choice games, Life Choices 2 shows all bits of life.
Experience great romance with Life Choices 2 and fall in love while living your adult life. Homelife gets boring fast, but Life Choices 2 offers a great 100 years life simulator.
Game features:
● Unparalleled freedom of choices.
● Diverse cast of characters.
● Customization options allow town building.
● Five different boosters to help players.
● Intriguing stories and immersive dialogues.
● Lives filled with love, comedy, action, thrill and tragedy.
● Top quality 2d graphics and animations.
● Can be played offline.
● Can be played with one hand.
What are you waiting for? Download and start another life now!

bluejetty:00180193:ios.name: SimplePi for Raspberry Pi
bluejetty:00180193:ios.summary:
SimplePi is the Swiss army knife utility app for monitoring, controlling, and managing your Raspberry Pi using your iPhone and iPad.
MONITOR ACTIVITY
See what is going on with your Raspberry Pi. CPU, Memory, Temperature, Disk Usage, and Cl
bluejetty:00180193:ios.description:
SimplePi is the Swiss army knife utility app for monitoring, controlling, and managing your Raspberry Pi using your iPhone and iPad.
MONITOR ACTIVITY
See what is going on with your Raspberry Pi. CPU, Memory, Temperature, Disk Usage, and Clock activity are shown in beautiful and easily understandable graphs.
CONTROL
Run commands on your Pi with a single tap. Want to have your own commands? No problem. SimplePi lets you add as many commands as you wish.
Additionally, you can manage your commands in groups.
TERMINAL SHELL
Access your Pi from a shell terminal with colored output and hardware keyboard support. The on-screen keyboard comes with fast access to commonly used special keys like ctrl and arrow keys.
WIDGETS
Monitor your Pi and run commands right from the Home Screen with various widgets.
VIEW COMMAND RESULTS
View and export command results and logs automatically. The results history allows you to view the results of previous commands.
DETAILED STATS
Detailed Stats for CPU and Memory give you an insight on which processes are running, how much memory is active, and much more.
FILE BROWSER
Browse Files and Folders in a file browser-like experience. 
View and export files of various formats.
MANAGE MULTIPLE PI
SimplePi can manage multiple Raspberry Pi. Configure each Raspberry Pi and connect to them simultaneously.
KEY AUTHENTICATION
Public Key authentication gives you the flexibility to authenticate in your preferred way.
Key files can be imported via iTunes or from other apps.
ICLOUD SYNC
Sync Commands, Hosts, Keys over iCloud
APP LOCK
Lock the app using FaceID, TouchID, or a custom passcode
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Run commands directly from your Home Screen on iOS 14
Siri Shortcuts
Integrate commands into automated worflows using the Shortcuts app (requires iOS14 or later)
NOTE: SSH needs to be enabled on your Raspberry Pi for SimplePi to work correctly.
SimplePi has been tested with the latest releases of
* Raspberry Pi OS (formerly Raspbian)
* Raspbmc
* OpenElec
* Xbian
* Pidora
* Arch Linux
SimplePi works on all Raspberry Pi models.
NOTE (only for Xbian users): Automatic start of xbian-config needs to be disabled. You can do this when connecting via SSH and selecting Config > Settings > Xbian Config > NO.
There are many different configurations out there. If you encounter problems with one of the distributions above or want to have your distribution support, please contact us.

bluejetty:00073422:ios.description:
MHealth is the mobile version of MEDITECH’s Patient and Consumer Health Portal, which offers secure and convenient access to your health information at your fingertips, on your mobile device or tablet. MHealth offers a wide range of results and features that allow you to better manage your and your family’s care. Use your existing Patient Portal logon ID and password to get started with MHealth.
With MHealth, you can:
• Communicate securely with your care team
• Request new appointments and see details for upcoming visits
• Pre-register for upcoming appointments
• Review laboratory results and radiology reports
• Track immunizations, allergies, and conditions
• Manage home medications and request prescription renewals
• Reference visit history information and forms, including discharge instructions.
If you already have a Patient Portal account through your healthcare provider, and your provider has enabled access through MHealth, you are ready to begin. If you do not already have a Portal account with a MEDITECH affiliate, visit your healthcare provider’s web page to learn how to get started.

MHealth is the mobile version of MEDITECH’s Patient and Consumer Health Portal, which offers secure and convenient access to your health information at your fingertips, on your mobile device or tablet. MHealth offers a wide range of results and features that allow you to better manage your and your family’s care. Use your existing Patient Portal logon ID and password to get started with MHealth.

With MHealth, you can:

• Communicate securely with your care team
• Request new appointments and see details for upcoming visits
• Pre-register for upcoming appointments
• Review laboratory results and radiology reports
• Track immunizations, allergies, and conditions
• Manage home medications and request prescription renewals
• Reference visit history information and forms, including discharge instructions.

If you already have a Patient Portal account through your healthcare provider, and your provider has enabled access through MHealth, you are ready to begin. If you do not already have a Portal account with a MEDITECH affiliate, visit your healthcare provider’s web page to learn how to get started.

bluejetty:00037276:ios.summary: Send files to Android TV - File share app is an innovative file sharing app designed to make it easy to transfer files from your phone or iPad to your Android TV. With this app, you can share files of any size with just a few taps, no cable
bluejetty:00037276:ios.description:
Send files to Android TV - File share app is an innovative file sharing app designed to make it easy to transfer files from your phone or iPad to your Android TV. With this app, you can share files of any size with just a few taps, no cables, or additional hardware required. 
Whether you want to watch your favorite movie or share photos with your friends and family, File share has got you covered.
This app is packed with advanced features that make file sharing a breeze. It supports all file formats, including photos, videos, music, and documents. 
The app uses Wi-Fi to transfer files, which means you can send large files quickly and easily, without any lag or delays.
Steps to send file :
- Install Send files to Android TV - File share app on mobile and Android TV both the devices.
- Open app in mobile and select file which you want to share.
- Now open app on Android TV to receive that file.
- Select your Android TV name from devices list on mobile app.
- You will receive files into your TV.
One of the standout features of Send files to Android TV - File share is its intuitive user interface. It is designed to be easy to use, even for beginners. 
Simply select the file you want to share, choose your Android TV, and tap the send button. The app will take care of the rest, transferring your file to the TV in seconds. 
You can also view the transfer progress in real-time, so you know exactly when your file has been sent.
Overall, File share is an essential app for anyone who wants to share files with their Android TV quickly and easily. 
It's packed with advanced features, easy to use, and supports all popular file formats. Download Send files to TV app today and start sharing your files!

bluejetty:00100721:ios.summary: God is Creator. His laws are the protocols that the cosmos is actually built to operate upon. Like law of gravity, laws of health, and law of love, which is the principle of giving. This design of giving is seen in nature, with every breath
bluejetty:00100721:ios.description: God is Creator. His laws are the protocols that the cosmos is actually built to operate upon. Like law of gravity, laws of health, and law of love, which is the principle of giving. This design of giving is seen in nature, with every breath we give away CO2 and the plants give back oxygen to us. This is God’s design of love built into the fabric of reality. Unlike other Bible translations, which view the text through the lens of a legal problem, with humanity being in legal trouble with God for breaking imposed rules, this paraphrase approaches interpretation through this lens of design law and views humanity as being in a condition deviant from God's design and in need of healing and restoration. Thus this paraphrase consistently represents God as healer battling against all forces that damage and destroy.

bluejetty:00114280:ios.description:
Croc Rush Puzzle – Slide, Match & Escape! 
Welcome to Croc Rush Puzzle, the most relaxing yet thrilling puzzle adventure! 
Your mission: guide adorable crocs through twisty paths, avoid collisions, and help them reach their color-matching holes! 
It’s simple to play, but mastering every move takes true skill and focus. 
 HOW TO PLAY: 
 Tap & Drag – Slide each crocs from its head or tail. 
 Avoid Collisions – Don’t let the crocs bump into walls or each other! 
 Match Colors – Guide every crocs to the hole with the same color. 
 Escape the Grid – Complete the level and move on to tougher challenges. 
 FEATURES: 
Addictive & Satisfying Gameplay – Easy to pick up, hard to put down. 
Charming Visuals & Smooth Animations – Watch your crocs glide gracefully. 
Brain-Teasing Levels – From chill to challenging, hundreds of handcrafted puzzles await. 
Time Trials & Bonus Rewards – For players who love speed and precision. 
Relaxing Soundtrack – Play, unwind, and let the stress melt away. 
Are you ready to test your mind and reflexes? 
Every move matters — think ahead, slide smart, and escape the maze! 
 Download Croc Rush Puzzle now and start your puzzle-sliding adventure today!

bluejetty:00080678:ios.description:
Suno is the AI music generator that turns any idea into a real, full song — instantly. Make music, beats, and lyrics with AI, no experience needed.
Whether you're a shower-singer with a melody stuck in your head or a seasoned songwriter looking for a creative edge, Suno is your AI music tool. Transform your ideas into full songs through a single text prompt, humming a tune, tapping out a beat, or uploading an audio recording. Whatever sparks your imagination, Suno can help you turn it into something you can listen to again and again. Generate music in any genre — hip hop, pop, rock, R&B, jazz, country, electronic, and beyond. Every song is original, and every song is yours.
Suno can do lyrics, too: our AI lyrics generator can write a full song from any material. Create a rap song using the texts in your group chat. Turn a study guide into a love song, or a poem into a country ballad.
Publish and share your songs with other creators: go viral, connect with others, stay inspired. Jam by listening to their tracks and follow your favorites. Discover trending songs and explore the best AI music across genres like rock, rap, hip hop, pop, and more from rising talents all over the world. Combine your favorites into your personal playlists. Music is better when it's shared — and Suno is where your community lives.
Feeling Pro? Take full creative control: adjust vocals, tweak structure, fine-tune melodies, add instrumental accompaniment, and edit every detail to your vision. Record your own voice, remix your tracks, and produce studio-quality music right from your phone. Suno Studio gives you a full generative audio workstation in your pocket — the creative power of a recording studio, without the price tag.
From your first song to your hundredth, Suno grows with you. Start from anywhere. Sound like yourself. Make music that means something.
Suno is how imagination becomes music, and music becomes yours.

Circle Location Sharing is a real-time location sharing app designed for family and friends, helping you stay closer to your loved ones in your daily life. - **Notification reminders:** When family or friends arrive or leave a specified location, you will receive instant notifications.
- **Offline maps:** Even without a network, you can view previous sharing records and location information.

- **Safe and reliable:** We are committed to protecting your privacy, and all data is transmitted through encryption to ensure security.
- **Flexible sharing:** Whether you are in the city or outdoors, Circle allows you to keep track of your family and friends at all times.

= EXPLORE T
bluejetty:00016297:ios.description:
Choose one of 15 unique character classes and set off on an unforgettable adventure in the largest MMORPG on mobile. Solo or with friends, join millions of players in the search for the legendary dragon eggs known as the Dofus.
= EXPLORE THE BIGGEST WORLD ON MOBILE =
- Travel around the World of Twelve, a fantasy universe with over 10,000 maps to explore. From majestic dragons to adorable piwis to impetuous bworks, there are thousands of incredible creatures to encounter in every corner of the world.
- Your adventures will take you to the busy streets of the fortified city of Astrub, the frozen lands of Frigost Island, the mystical region of Pandala, the flamboyant island of Orado, and over 70 dungeons!
- Explore stunning landscapes, fight legendary creatures, and unlock the secrets of every region.
= PLAY ONE OF 15 CHARACTER CLASSES =
- Forget sorcerers, elves and druids.
- Meet Xelors, Masqueraiders and Iops, with completely unique playstyles and abilities to unlock as you level up your character to level 200 and beyond.
- Customize your appearance, choose your element and abilities, and pull off devastating combos with other players!
= FIGHT SOLO OR WITH A TEAM IN CO-OP COMBAT =
- Use elemental spells to deal maximum damage, then control the battlefield with tactical spells that can change the course of the fight.
- Fights are turn-based, solo or with up to 3 allies. Find a team easily with the group search feature!
- Or prove your worth by challenging other players in 1v1 or 3v3 tactical PvP fights.
= DOMINATE THE PLAYER-DRIVEN ECONOMY = 
- Choose from over 20 professions available and become a skilled artisan who transforms resources into powerful equipment.
- Equip yourself with epic items or sell them to other players to afford even more powerful equipment!
- Every bit of loot you harvest or acquire as a fight or quest reward has commercial value.
- Master the art of trading to acquire the best equipment, which will make you even more powerful and help you become a formidable fighter.
= FORGE UNFORGETTABLE FRIENDSHIPS =
- Meet thousands of players on your server and forge unbreakable bonds during your many adventures!
- Whether you're a beginner or veteran, a welcoming community awaits you.
- Join a guild, wear its colors with pride and travel the world together, or take part in fierce conquest battles against other guilds.
Extend the adventure with the fantastic animated series WAKFU, available on Netflix and produced by Ankama, the creator of the MMO RPG DOFUS Touch, as well as WAVEN, the tactical RPG.
= JOIN A PASSIONATE COMMUNITY =
- Official Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/dofustouch
- DOFUS Touch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@dofusofficial
- DOFUS Touch on X: https://twitter.com/dofustouch_en
- DOFUS Touch on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DOFUSTouch
Terms of Use: https://www.dofus-touch.com/en/tou
To learn more about the Ankamaverse and other Ankama games: https://www.ankama.com/en

bluejetty:00178138:ios.description:
CONHEÇA O SEU MAIS NOVO ALIADO NA JORNADA PARA UMA VIDA MAIS SAUDÁVEL.
O TREINO é uma ferramenta que vai te auxiliar nos seus objetivos fitness, através dele você terá total controle sobre seus treinos e acesso a uma infinidade de ferramentas que vão garantir que você alcance uma qualidade de vida melhor e o shape que sempre sonhou.
Confira algumas funções do app:
HIDRATE-SE!
O TREINO possui o recurso que envia lembretes para que você possa se hidratar corretamente e ainda mostra a quantidade ideal de água que você deve ingerir de acordo com os seus objetivos.
TREINOS NA PALMA DA MÃO
Os seus treinos estão agora à alguns toques no seu celular. Com o TREINO os professores criam e enviam toda a rotina de treinos direto pelo app.
AVALIAÇÕES FÍSICAS
Tenha acesso à relatórios que mostram todos os dados sobre sua evolução.
*Para utilizar este aplicativo é preciso ser aluno matriculado em uma academia parceira da Pacto Soluções.
**Imagens e vídeos dependem do cadastro pelo coach.
HEALTHKIT
Nosso aplicativo é totalmente integrado com o HealthKit. Assim, os seus dados de saúde, como controle de peso, contagem de passos e monitoramento de calorias gastas, ficam em um só lugar. 
INFORMAÇÕE SOBRE O USO DO APP
O download e uso do app são gratuitos.

Termos de uso e condições gerais: http://pactosolucoes.com.br/termos-de-uso

bluejetty:00093655:ios.description:
Rellevate is a digital consumer financial services platform that facilitates consumer access and use of their money, anytime…anywhere. Rellevate’s state-of-the-art digital platform strengthens organizations and their workforces with a financial wellness benefit, the Rellevate Digital Account featuring Pay Any-Day*. 
Pay Any-Day* enables employers to offer employees secure and affordable advances to earned wages, between pay periods. 
[:mav: 2.0.8]
Other features of the Rellevate Digital Account with Earnings Credit, which is available to the general public, include a Rellevate Visa® Debit Card, ATM Network, Bill Pay and Send Money. There are no monthly subscription fees, no credit checks, and no minimum balance requirements. 
*Pay Any-Day currently available only to employees whose Employers offer the Rellevate Digital Account to their workforce.
Rellevate facilitates banking services through Sutton Bank. Member FDIC. 
The Rellevate Visa® Debit Card is issued by Sutton Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc
The Rellevate MasterCard® Debit Card is issued by Sutton Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Mastercard
YOUR MONEY WHEN YOU NEED IT 
For employees whose employer is offering Rellevate, you can access up to 50% of your pay before payday via Pay Any-Day. The funds are transferred real-time to your Rellevate Account. 
SPEND, ACCESS, SEND, EARN ON-YOUR MONEY
The Rellevate Digital Account includes:
The Rellevate Debit Card can be used at millions of locations worldwide
Access your money at 55,000 locations worldwide with the Allpoint Network with 2 transactions per month / no fee
Safe and secure Online Bill Pay with over 100,000 billers participating / no fee 
Send Money to Friends and Friends in the U.S. (including Puerto Rico) / no fee 
Earnings Credit paid monthly on account balances 
FDIC Insured Account, 24/7/365 Customer Service in English and Spanish

bluejetty:00069333:ios.name: Water Reminder - P App
bluejetty:00069333:ios.summary: P is a water reminder for iPhone and Apple Watch that doesn’t make you log every glass. You log a bathroom visit in seconds, and P reminds you to drink water when it’s been a while. P tracks output, not intake: peer-reviewed studies support
bluejetty:00069333:ios.description:
P is a water reminder for iPhone and Apple Watch that doesn’t make you log every glass. You log a bathroom visit in seconds, and P reminds you to drink water when it’s been a while. P tracks output, not intake: peer-reviewed studies support 24-hour pee frequency as a practical hydration indicator in healthy adults.
P also works as a bladder diary to track how often you pee: log each bathroom visit from your iPhone or Apple Watch, add notes, and keep a record to discuss with your doctor.
It’s great for Apple Watch or as a Lock Screen Widget, and not as complicated as a water tracker. Who wants to use an annoying, complicated water tracker to drink water? Up your hydration game with this app!
Try it out, and see how this drink water reminder app can keep you aware of your body.
Key features:
- Drink water when your body needs it most, instead of based on just water intake
- Great Apple Watch app: Put it on your watch face for fast access while you head to the restroom!
- Customizable drink water reminder notifications
- Apple Health integration
- Lock Screen widgets
- Home Screen widgets
- Hydration calendar (pee count per day)
- Add notes on pees
- Volume tracking: record void volume in mL or oz for a complete voiding diary
- See Where You Peed: include location on pees for a low-effort journal of your life
- Tell Siri to “Log a P”
- Data export as CSV
- Supported by scientific research
- Add friends so you can remind them to drink water
- Earn your scroll: Water Break blocks apps you choose until you take a sip of water
If you’ve ever had a UTI or kidney stones, you know how important it is to drink water. Hydration is so important! There can be many benefits of drinking water, like weight loss, healthy skin, mental clarity, and much more. Dehydration can hold you back from being your best self.
Now it’s easy to know when it’s water time. This hydration app gets you in tune with your body, especially when you need to drink water most.
P is like a fitness game, taking the water tracker concept and turning it around, so you don’t need to track water intake. It’s a much simpler free water drinking reminder app.
Don’t break that streak! You can even see where you stack up against the streaks of other users on the Leaderboard.
Even though P is designed to help you drink water as a hydration app and water drinking reminder app, you may also want to use it as a simple pee tracker or bathroom tracker. With volume tracking, P supports proper voiding diaries that medical providers request. This can be helpful for tracking data related to prostate conditions, bladder conditions, avoiding UTIs, avoiding kidney stones, and more.
Remember, this is not a water tracker! There is no way to record when you drink water, or how much water you drink. Instead, it’s a hydration app based on how often you pee!
Join the many happy users who have used P to drink water and monitor their hydration based on how often they pee instead of a water tracker!
P does not provide medical advice. It is not intended to diagnose or treat any medical conditions. It’s just a fun way to remember to drink more water or track your pees. Ask a licensed medical professional if you have any questions about:
- kidney stones
- gout or other types of inflammatory arthritis
- prostate conditions, or BPH
- interstitial cystitis and bladder conditions
- urinary tract infections (UTI)
- getting well-hydrated to prevent hangovers
- pelvic floor training and Kegel exercises to control urinary incontinence
- postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS)
P includes optional subscriptions. Subscriptions are charged to your App Store account and renew automatically unless canceled before the current period ends. You can turn off auto-renewal in Settings after purchase. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
P was formerly called Pee & See.
