bluejetty:00033724:ios.name: Promise of Lingyun
bluejetty:00033724:ios.summary: Promise of Lingyun is an archaistic role-playing game featuring hand-drawn Chinese ink painting style. Play as the main character to work for the welfare of the country and people in a mysterious palace of millenniums ago. The larger gamepl
bluejetty:00033724:ios.description:
Promise of Lingyun is an archaistic role-playing game featuring hand-drawn Chinese ink painting style. Play as the main character to work for the welfare of the country and people in a mysterious palace of millenniums ago. The larger gameplay variety and random explorations overwhelms players with the love and hatred intertwined in the palace.
[Features]
Fascinating Scenarios
Separate stories for female/male characters immerse you in the intoxicating ancient world. Become a ministeress to fight for the freedom and equality of men and women, or become a royal physician to cure diseases and save people.
Aesthetic Beauty
Customize your costumes and makeup. With the limitless sculpting system and plentiful costume choices, you can be creative and personalize your appearance as you wish.
Powerful Squad
Meet remarkable heroes and friends. Upgrade your heroes to help you continue your adventure. Bond with them and unlock exclusive stories.
Supportive Families
Make friends with real players, build your clan, and unlock more interesting social gameplay. Find your soulmate and explore this amazing ancient world together.
Poetic Life
Relax with multiple leisure gameplay options. Decorate your mansion with various furniture to unlock different kinds of rooms where you can feed your adorable pets or plant vegetables.
My Revolt, My Freedom, My Passion.
Follow Promise of Lingyun on Facebook.
Support: lyn_service@friendtimes.net

bluejetty:00171756:ios.summary: Resume Builder is here to help you creating a professional and impressive resume in minutes. Whether you're a recent graduate or a seasoned professional, our innovative app is designed to help you craft the perfect resume that showcases you
bluejetty:00171756:ios.description:
Resume Builder is here to help you creating a professional and impressive resume in minutes. Whether you're a recent graduate or a seasoned professional, our innovative app is designed to help you craft the perfect resume that showcases your skills, experience, and unique qualifications, all with a few taps on your mobile devices.
With Resume Builder, say goodbye to the daunting task of formatting and structuring your resume. Our app takes the guesswork out of the equation by providing you with an intuitive interface that seamlessly guides you through each step of the process. From choosing the right tenplate to cutsomize your sections and content, we ensure that you create a visually appealing and professional resume that stands out from the crowd.
We understand that a resume for a first-time job seeker will differ from that of a seasoned professional. Resume Builder offers a wide range of templates and customizable options to meet the unique needs of all individuals. Whether you're fresh out of college, transitioning industries, or aiming for a higher management role, our app has the flexibility to adapt to your specific career goals.
Easily modify font styles, colors, and layouts to personalize your resume and make it truly represent you. Whether you want to add a touch of creativity or maintain a clean and professional look, our app ensures your resume reflects your unique personality and captures the attention of potential employers. Resume Builder provides you with a range of templates that are specifically designed to suit different industries and roles, giving you all the necessary tools to create a perfect resume that highlights your skills and achievements.
Export file in a variety of formats. You can save it to your device or share it directly with employers, recruiters, or networking contacts. No more fumbling with file conversions or worrying about compatibility issues. With Resume Builder, sharing your professional accomplishments has never been easier.
Features:
- Wide range of templates specifically designed to suit different industries and roles.
- Customizable options for fonts, colors and styles.
- Built-in sharing function for easy sending and printing.
- User-friendly interface and intuitive navigation system form for easy editing and updating.
- Download resume in PDF format.
Creating and editing your resume is further simplified with our app's intuitive navigation system and user-friendly interface. You can easily edit and update your resume, seeing your progress in real-time as you add your professional experience and qualifications.

bluejetty:00015430:ios.name: Learn Japanese: Manabi Reader
bluejetty:00015430:ios.summary: Expand your Japanese vocabulary and kanji comprehension by getting in the habit of reading short, native content daily. Manabi Reader makes it easy to jump into interesting material without having to worry about your level: just one tap on
bluejetty:00015430:ios.description:
Expand your Japanese vocabulary and kanji comprehension by getting in the habit of reading short, native content daily. Manabi Reader makes it easy to jump into interesting material without having to worry about your level: just one tap on any word you don't know to see its reading and definition. Tap again to add flashcards into Manabi or Anki.
Don't waste time trying to find engaging reading material—a curated selection of news feeds, online magazines, blogs, folktales and ebooks are collected here for you. You can of course also open any webpage or RSS feed in Manabi Reader to help you through it.
Make a habit out of getting your news in Japanese and you'll find your skills multiply. With even a few minutes each day, reading is essential to picking up Japanese. Memory is one of those things where it sticks best when you're having fun, so dive in!
• Read native texts.
• One-tap word lookups (with audio!).
• Word tracking: you'll see how much of an article's vocabulary is already familiar. New words are highlighted for you.
• Kanji tracking: we'll also track the kanji you're familiar with as you read articles. Check your progress within JLPT levels.
• One-tap flashcard creation: memorize the words you look up.
• Review flashcards from an article once you're done reading it.
• Automatic furigana.
• BYOC (bring your own content) via URL or copy/paste; or, choose from our curated selection of reading materials.
• EPUB ebooks.
• 3rd-party dictionary apps are supported.
• Offline-friendly.
• Respects your privacy like a web browser.
=========================
The core app is fully functional without payment. Word tracking behaviors are limited to a subset as a preview. The companion Manabi flashcard app is limited to 10 flashcard reviews per day. Full word tracking functionality as well as unlimited flashcard reviews in the companion app may be purchased as a subscription. You may purchase a subscription, which will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase and will auto-renew within 24 hours prior to the end of the purchasing period. You can manage this in your Account Settings after purchase. Manabi Reader subscriptions are offered on a monthly or annual basis, with free trials—the annual subscriptions offer a discounted rate. This purchase supports the ongoing development of Manabi.
We offer a substantial discount for students, educators, and parents.
Privacy Policy: https://manabi.io/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://manabi.io/terms-of-service/
Chat with Team Manabi: https://tawk.to/manabi

bluejetty:00148281:ios.description:
I failed plenty of exams simply because I didn’t have a study system that actually worked, until I discovered flashcards and built this app.
If you’ve ever sat in the library wishing your study setup wasn’t a chaotic mix of screenshots, half finished notes and 20 open tabs, Flashtex is the app that finally fixes that.
Download now or keep failing exams.
Think of it as your reliable place to learn flashcards the way real university students study: actual equations, real cases, real diagrams, real vocab. Not just simple Q&A cards.
You can write cards in LaTeX, structure them neatly with Markdown, add images or even draw diagrams by hand.
It feels natural, fast and actually enjoyable to use.
Instead of forcing you into some rigid workflow, Flashtex just adapts to your style, whether you’re more of an Anki person, a Quizlet convert or someone starting fresh.
With spaced repetition built in, you study less but remember more.
Everything syncs automatically across iPhone, iPad and Mac, so you can revise on the bus, in the hallway before class or during that awkward 4 minute break between lectures.
Whether you’re memorizing anatomy, reviewing legal cases, solving physics problems, drilling algorithms or learning a new language, Flashtex keeps your study routine sharp without overwhelming you.
HOW IT WORKS
– Create your cards: Write flashcards exactly the way you think: LaTeX for maths & physics, Markdown for clean structure, handwriting for quick sketches or images when visuals help. Perfect for med school notes, case law references or step-by-step proofs.
– Build organized decks: Set up decks for every class, topic or exam. No limits, no clutter.
– Smart spaced repetition: Flashtex figures out when you should review each card so you don’t forget. You stay on top of things without drowning in constant revision.
– Study anywhere: iCloud keeps everything synced. Works offline too, so terrible campus Wi-Fi can’t stop you.
BUILT FOR
• Med students tracking endless anatomy & terminology
• Law students memorizing cases, definitions & frameworks
• STEM learners using LaTeX heavy content
• Language learners drilling vocab & grammar
• Anyone who came from Anki or Quizlet and wants something cleaner and simpler
• University level learners who want a serious study tool, not a toy
WHY YOU NEED FLASHTEX
• Create useful flashcards with LaTeX, Markdown, images, handwriting, whatever works for you
• Perfect for advanced subjects like medicine, law, physics, maths & CS
• Offline mode for studying anywhere
• Clear, simple progress stats
• Text-to-speech, perfect for vocab & language study
• Daily reminders so you don’t forget to study
• Easy import and export so your decks work with Anki, Markdown and CSV
• Distraction-free interface
EXAMPLE USE CASES
• Draw anatomy diagrams by hand and label them on the spot
• Format dense legal cases into clean Markdown flashcards
• Write physics and maths equations using LaTeX that actually renders correctly
• Create algorithm walkthroughs with text + diagrams
• Use text to speech to practice language vocab on the go
• Turn your messy lecture notes into structured decks that self update via spaced repetition
QUICKLY FIND & ORGANIZE
• Decks for each class or subject
• Cards scheduled for review today
• Tags and folders for huge study collections
• Important cards before exams or quizzes
SHARE YOUR STUDY MATERIAL
• Export decks to classmates or study groups
• Share flashcards in formats compatible with Anki/Quizlet style workflows
• Swap courses or vocab sets easily
FEATURES
• LaTeX & Markdown flashcards
• Handwriting support (Apple Pencil & touch)
• Spaced repetition built-in
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Offline learning
• Import/export in multiple formats
• Images & text-to-speech
• Widgets for home screen and lock screen
• Unlimited decks and cards
Privacy Policy: flashtex.app/privacypolicy Terms & Conditions: flashtex.app/terms

bluejetty:00187499:ios.description:
LOOM FOR iOS
Record your screen or camera with one tap. Share that content in an instant with a link. 
Loom for iOS is the fastest, easiest way to record content on-the-go and stay connected with your team. Whether you’re screen recording product demos, giving feedback, or simply sharing your thoughts, Loom makes it simple to stay in the loop with async video. 
TRUSTED BY THE BEST 
Over 14 million people across 200,000 companies use Loom to record, share, and review asynchronous video. From HubSpot, to Atlassian, to Netflix, Loom is the screen recording and collaboration tool of choice for top companies. 
EVERYTHING YOU NEED AND MORE 
Using Loom, you can collaborate with your team, add time-stamped comments and reactions to those videos, and save videos you’ve recorded to your device. Now, you can spend less time crafting the perfect email in-between meetings, and say it with video using Loom for iOS. 
KEY FEATURES 
• Record your screen, camera, microphone, and internal audio
• Automatically save videos to the cloud and share them instantly with a link
• Get notified when someone views, reacts, or comments on your video
• Leave time-based comments and emoji reactions
• Manage your Loom video library on-the-go and across devices
• Choose who can see your video with security and access controls
• Download recordings to your camera roll 
• Adjust video playback speed
• Edit and trim your video using the Loom web app
ABOUT LOOM
Loom is the leading video communication platform for async work. Engineered for simplicity and speed, you can record, watch, and share videos to move work forward whether you're at your desk or on the move. 
LOOM IN THE NEWS
"Why are we all trapped in enterprise chat apps if we talk 6x faster than we type, and our brain processes visual info 60,000x faster than text?...now is the time for Loom." – TechCrunch
"It fills this gap between writing an email and taking the time to have a meeting or conference...it's rare to have something that's low friction and high impact, while also adding personal connection." – Forbes
“Asynchronous video is catching on fast, and Loom thinks it's going to change the way we work. And maybe do everything else, too.” – Protocol

Pencil Bible turns Scripture into a canvas. Highlight verses, sketch in the margins, journal your reflections, and let every reading become part of your story — all with the natural feel of Apple Pencil.
Unlike iPad-only journaling apps, Pencil Bible works seamlessly on both iPhone and iPad — annotate on your tablet at home, then pick up right where you left off on your phone. Your Bible study goes everywhere you do.
Whether you're deep in study, journaling a quiet morning, or capturing a sermon note in the pew, Pencil Bible is built for how you actually meet with God.
25 translations free, forever:
No paywall on God's Word. Read NLT, NASB, AMP, KJV, ASV, BSB, WEB, TPT (New Testament and selected Old Testament books), OJB, WMB, DRA, MSB, YLT, Webster's, WEBC, CPDV, LBLA, NBLA, Reina-Valera 1960 (RVR1960), RV1909, NBV, Louis Segond (French), the Greek New Testament (SBLGNT and Textus Receptus), and the Hebrew Old Testament (WLC), all completely free.
Six premium translations are available as one-time add-ons: ESV, NIV, CSB, New King James Version (NKJV), NVI (Spanish) and NVI (Portuguese). Add-ons are not included in the subscription or Lifetime.
Your Bible, your way:
• Draw, highlight, and annotate directly on Scripture
• Full Apple Pencil Pro and PencilKit support
• Shapes, stickers, pictures and text box (NEW!)
• Seamless on iPad and iPhone — annotate on both
• Jesus' words in red
• Built-in search to find any verse instantly
• Dark Mode for late-night devotionals
• Left-hand mode and customizable fonts, backgrounds, and layouts
• Edit your Bible pages anytime — no need to start over
Perfect for:
• Daily devotionals and quiet time
• Sunday sermon and study notes
• Bible journaling, lettering, and creative worship
• Students and pastors taking margin notes
Free to read. Free to explore:
Read the Bible free, forever. On iPhone, writing and drawing on the page are free too. On iPad, journaling is free for 14 days from when you first open the app, with no payment details needed; after that, keep writing with a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Your support helps us serve more believers around the world.
Pencil Bible isn't just an app. It's your daily sanctuary, your digital journal, your space to meet with the One who wrote the Word.
The Word is alive. Now your Bible can be too. Download Pencil Bible today.
Apple Pencil features require a compatible iPad. Annotations are available on iPhone without a subscription.

listings.description:
Since 2022. The Bible you can write in.
--
Pencil Bible turns Scripture into a canvas. Highlight verses, sketch in the margins, journal your reflections, and let every reading become part of your story — all with the natural feel of Apple Pencil.

Unlike iPad-only journaling apps, Pencil Bible works seamlessly on both iPhone and iPad — annotate on your tablet at home, then pick up right where you left off on your phone. Your Bible study goes everywhere you do.

Whether you're deep in study, journaling a quiet morning, or capturing a sermon note in the pew, Pencil Bible is built for how you actually meet with God.

25 translations free, forever:
No paywall on God's Word. Read NLT, NASB, AMP, KJV, ASV, BSB, WEB, TPT (New Testament and selected Old Testament books), OJB, WMB, DRA, MSB, YLT, Webster's, WEBC, CPDV, LBLA, NBLA, Reina-Valera 1960 (RVR1960), RV1909, NBV, Louis Segond (French), the Greek New Testament (SBLGNT and Textus Receptus), and the Hebrew Old Testament (WLC), all completely free.
Six premium translations are available as one-time add-ons: ESV, NIV, CSB, New King James Version (NKJV), NVI (Spanish) and NVI (Portuguese). Add-ons are not included in the subscription or Lifetime.

Your Bible, your way:
• Draw, highlight, and annotate directly on Scripture
• Full Apple Pencil Pro and PencilKit support
• Shapes, stickers, pictures and text box (NEW!)
• Seamless on iPad and iPhone — annotate on both
• Jesus' words in red
• Built-in search to find any verse instantly
• Dark Mode for late-night devotionals
• Left-hand mode and customizable fonts, backgrounds, and layouts
• Edit your Bible pages anytime — no need to start over

Perfect for:
• Daily devotionals and quiet time
• Sunday sermon and study notes
• Bible journaling, lettering, and creative worship
• Students and pastors taking margin notes

Free to read. Free to explore:
Read the Bible free, forever. On iPhone, writing and drawing on the page are free too. On iPad, journaling is free for 14 days from when you first open the app, with no payment details needed; after that, keep writing with a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Your support helps us serve more believers around the world.

Pencil Bible isn't just an app. It's your daily sanctuary, your digital journal, your space to meet with the One who wrote the Word.

The Word is alive. Now your Bible can be too. Download Pencil Bible today.

Apple Pencil features require a compatible iPad. Annotations are available on iPhone without a subscription.

bluejetty:00168610:android.description:
Step back into a world where survival is a daily struggle, and every moment counts. In Stone Age Survival, you’re not just a bystander but the hero of an epic journey that takes you deep into the Stone Age—a time when survival, courage, and skill were everything. This 3D adventure places you in a harsh but thrilling prehistoric setting where you must grow from a lone wanderer to the leader of a powerful tribe.
Survival isn’t just a game mode—it’s your way of life. Navigate the wilds, gather essential resources, and build the foundation of a new civilization. Start by crafting basic shelters and tools, then progress to constructing a full settlement where your tribe can flourish. Every piece you build is a step towards a thriving society, giving you more options and possibilities in your journey.
Offline adventure meets immersive clicker gameplay. Whether you’re tapping to gather materials or managing your tribe’s daily needs, Stone Age Survival combines the excitement of idle gameplay with the strategic depth of world-building. Gather, build, and protect your settlement as you strive to craft the world around you.
The Stone Age is rich with untold dangers and opportunities. Hunt wild beasts, explore uncharted territories, and discover hidden secrets. As you progress, the challenges grow—but so do the rewards. Unlock new tools and abilities to better equip your tribe for the perils of prehistoric life. Experience the Jurassic world like never before, where you must adapt or face extinction.
Take charge and build a legacy in the ultimate survival game. Stone Age Survival offers a unique combination of survival, building, and offline adventure mechanics, perfect for those who love a deep, evolving experience. Go from crafting basic items to overseeing a flourishing civilization. With each new level, unlock advanced buildings, enhanced weapons, and new strategies to face the Stone Age’s most daunting obstacles.
Play anytime, anywhere—even offline. Stone Age Survival is designed for uninterrupted adventure. With its idle mechanics, the game keeps progressing even when you’re away, so your civilization grows while you handle other tasks. Return to find new resources, buildings, and surprises that await you in this ever-evolving clicker experience.
